article_content: SALT LAKE CITY — Incumbent Erin Mendenhall has won reelection as mayor of Utah’s capital in a ranked-choice voting contest that included a challenge from former Salt Lake City Mayor Rocky Anderson. Ballot results released Wednesday, which included all scannable ballots held by the Salt Lake County clerk, showed Mendenhall with 58% of the vote compared to Anderson’s 34%, according to the Salt Lake Tribune. 'As seemed pretty clear last night, these more final results clearly indicate that Mayor Mendenhall has won reelection,' Anderson said. 'I wish her the very best, and I hope she and her team succeed.' Mendenhall’s campaign confirmed that Anderson called the mayor Wednesday afternoon to formally concede. Although the mayoral position is officially nonpartisan, Salt Lake City is largely Democratic within a predominantly Republican state. At her election-night party Tuesday, Mendenhall told supporters she would 'regroup for a second term' with renewed energy and urgency. 'This election ends with voters saying loudly and clearly that they want Salt Lake City to keep moving forward together,' she said. 'Salt Lakers are not afraid of our incredible future — we’re excited by it. This election was a repudiation of cynicism and a rejection of the politics of fear.' An Oct. 24 debate featuring three mayoral candidates addressed key issues: conserving water, combating climate change, reducing crime, and addressing homelessness. Anderson, who served two terms from 2000 to 2008, criticized Mendenhall for not doing enough to ease the rising cost of housing. He proposed city-built mixed-income housing as a solution, contrasting with Mendenhall’s approach of collaborating more closely with private developers. This was the first Salt Lake City mayoral election since the city, along with several other Utah municipalities, adopted ranked-choice voting in 2021. Under this system, voters rank up to three candidates regardless of party affiliation. If no candidate receives a majority, the candidate with the fewest votes is eliminated, and their voters’ second and third choices are redistributed until one candidate achieves a majority.
translated_content: SALT LAKE CITY — Erin Mendenhall yang sedang menjabat telah memenangi pencalonan semula sebagai bandaraya ibu kota Utah dalam pertandingan undian pilihan berperingkat yang mencabar oleh mantan Bandaraya Salt Lake City, Rocky Anderson. Keputusan undi yang dikeluarkan pada Rabu, yang merangkumi semua ballot yang boleh dipindai oleh pejabat juruubah Salt Lake County, menunjukkan Mendenhall mendapat 58% undi berbanding 34% Anderson, menurut Salt Lake Tribune. 'Seperti yang sudah jelas semalam, keputusan akhir ini jelas menunjukkan bahawa Bandaraya Mendenhall telah memenangi pencalonan semula,' kata Anderson. 'Saya mendoakan yang terbaik untuknya, dan saya harap dia dan pasukannya berjaya.' Kempen Mendenhall mengesahkan bahawa Anderson telah menelepon bandaraya itu pada petang Rabu untuk secara rasmi mengaku kalah. Walaupun jawatan bandaraya secara rasmi tidak berpihak politik, Salt Lake City sebahagian besarnya berhaluan Demokrat di negara bagian yang sebahagian besar berhaluan Republikan. Di majlis malam pemilihan pada Selasa, Mendenhall memberitahu penyokongnya bahawa dia akan 'mengatur semula untuk penggal kedua' dengan tenaga dan kesungguhan yang baru. 'Pilihan raya ini berakhir dengan rakyat yang menyatakan dengan jelas bahawa mereka ingin Salt Lake City terus maju bersama-sama,' katanya. 'Orang Salt Lake tidak takut dengan masa depan luar biasa kita — mereka gembira dengannya. Pilihan raya ini adalah penolakan terhadap sikap sinis dan penolakan terhadap politik ketakutan.' Perdebatan pada 24 Oktober yang melibatkan tiga calon bandaraya membincangkan beberapa isu utama: menghemat air, memerangi perubahan iklim, mengurangkan kejahatan, dan menangani masalah orang tanpa rumah. Anderson, yang memegang dua penggal dari tahun 2000 hingga 2008, mengkritik Mendenhall kerana tidak cukup berusaha untuk mengurangkan kos perumahan yang meningkat. Beliau mencadangkan pembinaan perumahan campuran pendapatan oleh bandaraya sebagai penyelesaian, berbeza dengan pendekatan Mendenhall yang lebih rapat bekerjasama dengan pembangun swasta. Ini adalah pilihan raya bandaraya Salt Lake City yang pertama sejak bandaraya tersebut, bersama beberapa bandar lain di Utah, mengambil sistem undian pilihan berperingkat pada tahun 2021. Di bawah sistem ini, pengundi boleh menilai sehingga tiga calon tanpa mengira afiliasi parti. Jika tiada calon mendapat majoriti, calon yang mendapat undi paling sedikit akan disingkirkan, dan undi kedua dan ketiga pengundi mereka akan dialihkan sehingga satu calon mencapai majoriti.

article_content: Canadian teenagers send Lego man 80,000 feet into the air. By Daily Mail Reporter. Last updated at 12:49 PM on January 30, 2012. Aviation experts have warned space enthusiasts not to launch helium weather balloons into the sky — one could be enough to bring down a plane. Last week, two Canadian teenagers, Mathew Ho and Asad Muhammad, sent a Lego man into the stratosphere using a home-stitched parachute and spare parts sourced from Craigslist. The 17-year-olds from Toronto made headlines after their two-inch astronaut, clutching a Canadian flag, reached an altitude of 80,000 feet — three times the cruising altitude of a commercial jet. An airline pilot cautioned that copycats attempting similar experiments could endanger lives. Captain Barry Wiszniowski of the Air Canada Pilots Association’s safety division told the Toronto Star: 'A pilot might not have enough reaction time if such a balloon appeared unexpectedly. At aircraft speeds, the impact could resemble a bird strike and potentially cause severe damage — especially if debris is sucked into an engine.' The teens captured the entire 97-minute journey from a football field using four cameras programmed to take photos every 20 seconds. They attached the Lego man and cameras to a helium-filled balloon inside a styrofoam box equipped with a GPS receiver. The payload reached an estimated 24 kilometers above sea level, showing the toy floating above Earth’s curvature before beginning a 32-minute descent. The Lego man landed 122 kilometers from the launch site. After recovering the device, the teens uploaded two videos and 1,500 photos to their computer — and burst into cheers. Footage shows the Lego man spinning at an altitude higher than Mount Everest’s peak, followed by the balloon’s rupture and rapid descent. 'We never knew it would be this good,' Ho told the Star. Aviation authorities stress that unregulated weather balloons remain a potential hazard to air traffic.

article_content: A 16-year-old accused of murder has insisted he did not threaten his alleged victim and was 'shocked' by the stabbing. The teenager, who cannot be named due to his age, is on trial for the murder of Jack Norton — also known as Jack Lowe. The 18-year-old died in a grassy area locally known as Cookie Park in Darlaston on 7 December 2022. The accused and his co-defendant, 19-year-old Brandon Price from Walsall, both deny charges of murder and possessing a knife. The prosecution argues that while Price — who was 18 at the time — delivered the fatal stab wound, the youth, then aged 15, bears shared responsibility for allegedly egging him on. Price testified at Wolverhampton Crown Court on Friday that he fatally wounded Jack in self-defense after Jack attempted to strike him with a bottle. He claimed he pulled out a knife and stabbed Jack without realizing the severity of his actions. On Monday, the youth denied handing Price the knife. He also rejected claims by two of Jack’s friends — witnesses to the alleged attack — that he had made threats against Jack that night. He told the court he did not understand why Price stabbed Jack, and said he was walking home when the incident occurred. He described feeling 'shocked and scared' afterward. The youth denied cheering or whooping after the stabbing but acknowledged he might have been captured on audio saying the word 'kill' moments later. He explained: 'I was in shock and I was scared, so I was shouting at Brandon, “You killed him, you killed him.”' Prosecutor Rachel Brand KC rejected the youth’s account, asserting he had spent the entire evening provoking Jack. 'You wound up Brandon and gave him a knife because you wanted him to stab Jack Norton,' she said. 'That’s what you wanted all along — for some reason, you developed a grudge against him. You ran away laughing, and you stayed with Brandon rather than going home because the two of you were in this together from the start.' Both prosecution and defense are set to deliver closing arguments, followed by the judge’s summation. The trial continues.

article_content: (CNN) — Afghan President Hamid Karzai said Thursday that a recently negotiated security agreement with the United States should not be signed until after Afghanistan’s April elections. His remarks, delivered to thousands of tribal elders at a loya jirga — or grand assembly — in Kabul, contradict the position of U.S. officials. The loya jirga is tasked with deciding whether to approve or reject the Bilateral Security Agreement (BSA), which outlines a limited role for U.S. military forces in Afghanistan beyond 2014. U.S. State Department spokeswoman Jennifer Psaki told reporters in Washington that American authorities are seeking clarity on the intent behind Karzai’s statements. 'Broadly speaking, when we signed the Strategic Partnership Agreement last year, both countries committed to completing the BSA within one year. We, of course, know the math — that window is this month. We believe signing the BSA sooner rather than later is essential to give Afghans certainty about their future before the upcoming elections and to enable the United States and other partners to plan for a post-2014 U.S. presence,' she said. 'We need a timely conclusion to plan for any potential post-2014 presence — which means signing it by the end of the year,' Psaki added. If approved, the agreement would take effect on January 1, 2015, and remain in force until the end of 2024 and beyond, unless terminated by mutual consent with two years’ notice, according to a copy of the document posted online by the Afghan government and confirmed as authentic by a U.S. official. Military raids and airstrikes have long been a source of tension between the two nations, particularly following incidents in which noncombatants — including women and children — were killed. The proposed BSA includes language affirming respect for Afghanistan’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, and stipulates that U.S. forces 'shall not target Afghan civilians, including in their homes.' However, it does not address past civilian casualties. 'If you accept it and Parliament passes it, the BSA will be signed after our election — without any problem and with dignity,' Karzai said in Kabul. Karzai also addressed the state of trust between Afghanistan and the United States. 'My trust in America is not good. I don’t trust them, and they don’t trust me. The last 10 years have shown that I have fought with them, and they have launched propaganda campaigns against me,' he said. U.S. troops first entered Afghanistan following the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks orchestrated by al Qaeda, which was then based in the country. Since taking office, President Barack Obama has pledged — and in some cases implemented — reductions in U.S. troop levels, with the stated goal of ending the U.S. combat mission by the end of 2014. Approval of the BSA would allow American forces to remain in Afghanistan beyond that deadline. CNN's Greg Botelho contributed to this report.
translated_content: (CNN) — Presiden Afghanistan Hamid Karzai mengatakan pada hari Kamis bahawa perjanjian keselamatan yang baru dirundingkan dengan Amerika Syarikat sepatutnya tidak ditandatangani sehingga selepas pilihan raya Afghanistan pada bulan April. Pernyataannya, yang disampaikan kepada ribuan orang tua suku di loya jirga — atau majlis agung — di Kabul, bertentangan dengan posisi pegawai-pegawai Amerika. Loya jirga bertugas untuk memutuskan sama ada bersetuju atau menolak Perjanjian Keselamatan Bersama (BSA), yang merancang peranan terhad terhadap pasukan tentera AS di Afghanistan selepas 2014. Pegawai media Jabatan Luar Negeri Amerika, Jennifer Psaki, memberitahu wartawan di Washington bahawa pihak Amerika sedang mencari kejelasan tentang niat di sebalik pernyataan Karzai. 'Secara umum, apabila kami menandatangani Perjanjian Kemitraan Strategik tahun lalu, kedua-dua negara berkomitmen untuk menyelesaikan BSA dalam tempoh satu tahun. Kami, tentu saja, tahu matematiknya — jendela itu adalah bulan ini. Kami percaya bahawa menandatangani BSA lebih awal daripada lewat adalah penting untuk memberikan kepastian kepada rakyat Afghanistan mengenai masa depan mereka sebelum pilihan raya yang akan datang dan membolehkan Amerika Syarikat dan rakan-rakan lain merancang kehadiran AS selepas 2014,' katanya. 'Kami perlukan penyelesaian yang cepat untuk merancang sebarang kemungkinan kehadiran selepas 2014 — yang bermaksud menandatangani ia sebelum akhir tahun,' kata Psaki. Jika diluluskan, perjanjian itu akan berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2015, dan berterusan sehingga akhir 2024 dan seterusnya, kecuali jika dihentikan atas persetujuan bersama dengan notis dua tahun, menurut salinan dokumen yang diposting secara online oleh kerajaan Afghanistan dan disahkan sebagai autentik oleh seorang pegawai Amerika. Serangan udara dan serbuan tentera telah lama menjadi sumber ketegangan antara dua negara, terutamanya selepas kejadian-kejadian di mana warga awam — termasuk wanita dan kanak-kanak — terkorban. BSA yang dicadangkan menyertakan pernyataan yang menegaskan penghormatan terhadap kedaulatan dan integriti wilayah Afghanistan, serta menetapkan bahawa pasukan AS 'tidak akan menargetkan penduduk awam Afghanistan, termasuk di rumah mereka.' Namun, ia tidak membincangkan kes-kes korban awam sebelum ini. 'Jika anda menerimanya dan Parlimen meluluskannya, BSA akan ditandatangani selepas pilihan raya kami — tanpa sebarang masalah dan dengan maruah,' kata Karzai di Kabul. Karzai juga membincangkan keadaan kepercayaan antara Afghanistan dan Amerika Syarikat. 'Kepercayaan saya terhadap Amerika tidak baik. Saya tidak percaya pada mereka, dan mereka juga tidak percaya pada saya. Sepuluh tahun terakhir menunjukkan bahawa saya telah berlawan dengan mereka, dan mereka telah melancarkan kempen propaganda terhadap saya,' katanya. Pasukan Amerika pertama kali masuk ke Afghanistan selepas serangan teroris 11 September 2001 yang diatur oleh al Qaeda, yang pada masa itu berbasis di negara itu. Sejak mengambil jawatan, Presiden Barack Obama telah berjanji — dan dalam beberapa kes melaksanakan — pengurangan jumlah tentera AS, dengan tujuan menyatakan akhir misi pertempuran AS pada akhir 2014. Kelulusan BSA akan membenarkan pasukan Amerika kekal di Afghanistan melebihi batas waktu itu. CNN's Greg Botelho menyumbang kepada laporan ini.

article_content: On Thursday, Tata Motors announced a partnership between its electric mobility subsidiary, Tata Passenger Electric Mobility (TPEM), and Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) for the development of the Avinya series of premium pure electric vehicles. TPEM has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with JLR to license the latter's EMA (Electric Modular Architecture) platform for a royalty fee. This collaboration will enable TPEM to accelerate its entry into the high-end electric vehicle market while reducing development time and costs. As part of the knowledge and manufacturing process transfer, over 200 new jobs are expected to be created in the UK. Additionally, TPEM and JLR will enter into an Engineering Services Agreement (ESA) to support TPEM’s engineering requirements for the first Avinya model. JLR’s EMA platform will serve as the foundation for its own next-generation mid-sized pure electric SUVs, targeted for global markets starting in 2025. Anand Kulkarni, Chief Product Officer and Head of HV Programmes at TPEM, stated: 'Built on an architecture equipped with the latest advances in software, artificial intelligence, and new-age technologies, the Avinya will redefine global standards in efficiency and range.'

article_content: The UK government’s Rwanda asylum policy, designed to deter small boat crossings, has been declared unlawful by the UK’s highest court. The Supreme Court upheld a previous Court of Appeal ruling that the policy exposes individuals sent to Rwanda to potential human rights violations. As a result, the policy cannot proceed in its current form. Prime Minister Rishi Sunak stated the government will pursue a new treaty with Rwanda and is prepared to amend UK domestic laws to address the court’s concerns. The controversial plan—first announced by former Prime Minister Boris Johnson in April 2022—has faced legal challenges since its inception. The government has already spent £140 million on the scheme, but flights were halted in June 2022 after the Court of Appeal found the policy lacked adequate human rights protections. The Supreme Court’s unanimous decision confirmed that Rwanda’s asylum system lacks sufficient safeguards to ensure safety for relocated individuals. The court did not rule out transferring migrants to third countries outright but found substantial grounds to believe Rwanda might further deport individuals to unsafe locations. While acknowledging Rwanda’s 'good faith' in entering the agreement, the court expressed doubts about its short-term capacity to implement the necessary reforms to its asylum system. A Rwandan government spokesperson contested the ruling, asserting that Rwanda remains a safe third country, while emphasizing that the legality of the policy is ultimately a matter for the UK’s judiciary. The decision follows the dismissal of former Home Secretary Suella Braverman, a staunch advocate of the policy. She has urged Sunak to introduce emergency legislation to override legal challenges, including limiting the influence of the European Convention on Human Rights (ECHR). New Home Secretary James Cleverly affirmed that the government has been working for months to develop a legally robust solution, including elevating the existing memorandum of understanding to a binding treaty. He claims this will reassure both UK courts and international bodies that risks identified by the Supreme Court have been addressed. Some Conservative MPs, such as Lee Anderson, have called for the policy to be implemented regardless of the ruling, while others, like Natalie Elphicke, argue the policy is effectively dead and demand alternative approaches. Critics, including charity Asylum Aid, describe the policy as 'cruel and ineffective,' urging its abandonment. Since 2018, over 100,000 people have arrived in the UK via illegal Channel crossings. In 2022, 45,000 arrived by small boats; as of November 12, 2023, the figure for the year stood at fewer than 28,000, suggesting a decline.

Menteri Dalam Negeri baharu James Cleverly menegaskan bahawa kerajaan telah bekerja selama beberapa bulan untuk membangunkan penyelesaian yang kukuh secara undang-undang, termasuk meningkatkan memorandum persefahaman sedia ada kepada perjanjian mengikat. article_content: In a major move to tackle smartphone theft, top U.S. phone makers and carriers have agreed to build a 'kill switch' into every new smartphone sold after July 2015. This feature lets owners remotely lock their device and erase personal data if it’s lost or stolen — making it useless to thieves. The initiative, called the Smartphone Anti-Theft Voluntary Commitment, was launched by CTIA, the wireless industry’s main trade group, and has been endorsed by Apple, Google, Samsung, Microsoft, and all major U.S. carriers including AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile. Right now, users must manually set up tracking apps or ask their carrier to disable a stolen phone — a slow and inconsistent process. With the new system, sending a special text message will instantly disable the device, even if the thief resets it. Emergency calls will still work, and once recovered, the original owner can restore their data as much as possible. Although some experts and lawmakers once worried the kill switch could be exploited by hackers — especially targeting people in sensitive fields — public pressure and soaring theft rates have shifted opinions. Law enforcement leaders, including San Francisco’s DA George Gascon and New York’s AG Eric Schneiderman, welcomed the move but stressed it won’t end theft unless the feature is turned on by default and universally available. Several states like California and New York are pushing laws to make kill switches mandatory, and federal bills are under review. Meanwhile, companies like Samsung and Apple have already rolled out similar tools — Samsung’s Reactivation Lock and Apple’s Activation Lock — proving the technology works. Still, critics argue that leaving activation up to users creates a gap. As tech analyst Jeff Kagan noted, this industry-wide step likely came because lawmakers were preparing to force the issue. It’s not a perfect solution, but many see it as the most practical step forward yet.

Pemimpin penegakan undang-undang, termasuk Jaksa Agung San Francisco George Gascon dan Peguam Negara New York Eric Schneiderman, menyambut baik langkah ini tetapi menekankan ia tidak akan mengakhiri pencurian kecuali ciri ini dihidupkan secara lalai dan tersedia secara universal. article_content: By Sam Adams and Lee Moran. PUBLISHED: 11:53 EST, 3 April 2013. | UPDATED: 03:58 EST, 4 April 2013. Princess Cristina, the youngest daughter of Spain’s King Juan Carlos, has been named as a suspect in a €5 million corruption scandal involving her husband, Inaki Urdangarin. A court in Palma de Mallorca announced that Cristina, 47, will be questioned later this month over allegations that Urdangarin and his former business partner, Diego Torres, embezzled public funds through the Nóos Institute — a non-profit organization of which she was a board member. Prosecutors claim the pair used Urdangarin’s royal connections to secure public contracts and then overcharged local governments for sports events they organized. Urdangarin served as chairman of the Nóos Institute from 2004 to 2006. An investigation into the alleged fraud was launched last year; neither man has been formally charged. Until recently, there was no indication that Princess Cristina — mother of four and seventh in line to the throne — was involved. However, leaked emails between her and Urdangarin, obtained by Judge Jose Castro, have raised questions. According to Spanish newspaper El País, Urdangarin sent Cristina an email on February 20, 2003, asking her to review a draft message to the institute’s ‘contributors, clients and friends.’ The next day, he sent a nearly identical message to higher-profile recipients, including Queen Sofia and King Juan Carlos, seeking their input. While the emails do not prove her complicity, Judge Castro reportedly intends to question her further. The judge recently set joint bail of €8.2 million for Urdangarin and Torres, stating they ‘ignored public contracting rules as long as they achieved their aim — diverting public funds for personal benefit.’ Urdangarin, from a wealthy Basque family but not of noble birth, became Duke of Palma upon marrying Cristina, who holds the title Duchess of Palma. The couple has four children. Last year, the royal family distanced itself from Urdangarin, removing him from official duties and the royal website. Princess Cristina is the younger of King Juan Carlos’s two daughters; her older sister is Princess Elena, 49. Their brother, Prince Felipe, 45, is heir to the throne. The royal household has declined to comment as public support for the monarchy falls to a record low of 54%, according to recent polls. This controversy follows revelations that King Juan Carlos, 75, received a €2.2 million inheritance from his father, deposited into three Swiss bank accounts after his father’s death on April 1, 1993. Questions remain about whether he paid appropriate taxes on the sum. The king also faced widespread criticism last year for going on an elephant-hunting trip to Botswana while Spain struggled with high unemployment. The trip led to his resignation as honorary president of WWF Spain and an unprecedented public apology.

Putri Cristina, putri termuda Raja Juan Carlos dari Spanyol, telah dinamai sebagai tersangka dalam skandal korupsi senilai €5 juta yang melibatkan suaminya, Inaki Urdangarin. Pengadilan di Palma de Mallorca mengumumkan bahwa Cristina, 47 tahun, akan dipanggil untuk dimintai keterangan bulan ini terkait tuduhan bahwa Urdangarin dan mantan rekan bisnisnya, Diego Torres, menyelewengkan dana publik melalui Institut Nóos — sebuah organisasi nirlaba tempat dia menjadi anggota dewan. Jaksa menuduh pasangan itu memanfaatkan hubungan kerajaan Urdangarin untuk mendapatkan kontrak publik, lalu membebankan biaya berlebih kepada pemerintah daerah atas acara olahraga yang mereka selenggarakan. Urdangarin menjabat ketua Institut Nóos dari 2004 hingga 2006. Penyelidikan terhadap dugaan penipuan ini diluncurkan tahun lalu; kedua pria itu belum dituntut secara resmi. Hingga baru-baru ini, tidak ada indikasi bahwa Putri Cristina — ibu dari empat anak dan urutan ketujuh dalam garis suksesi tahta — terlibat. Namun, email yang bocor antara dia dan Urdangarin, yang diperoleh Hakim Jose Castro, telah memicu pertanyaan. Menurut surat kabar Spanyol El País, Urdangarin mengirimkan email kepada Cristina pada 20 Februari 2003, meminta agar dia meninjau draf pesan kepada ‘kontributor, klien, dan teman’ yang ingin dia kirimkan atas nama Institut tersebut. Keesokan harinya, ia mengirim pesan yang hampir identik ke penerima yang lebih tinggi, termasuk Ratu Sofia dan Raja Juan Carlos, meminta masukan. Meskipun email-email itu tidak membuktikan keterlibatannya, Hakim Castro dikabarkan berniat menggali lebih dalam lagi. Hakim baru-baru ini menetapkan jaminan bersama sebesar €8,2 juta untuk Urdangarin dan Torres, menyatakan bahwa mereka ‘mengabaikan aturan pengadaan publik selama mereka mencapai tujuan mereka — yaitu mengalihkan dana publik untuk keuntungan pribadi.’ Urdangarin, dari keluarga kaya Basque tetapi bukan bangsawan, menjadi Adipati Palma setelah menikahi Cristina, yang memegang gelar Duchess of Palma. Pasangan ini memiliki empat anak. Tahun lalu, keluarga kerajaan menjauhkan diri dari Urdangarin, menghapus namanya dari tugas resmi dan situs web kerajaan. Putri Cristina adalah putri bungsu Raja Juan Carlos; kakaknya adalah Putri Elena, 49 tahun. Saudara mereka, Pangeran Felipe, 45 tahun, adalah ahli waris tahta. Keluarga kerajaan menolak berkomentar, sementara dukungan publik terhadap monarki turun ke rekor terendah 54%, menurut jajak pendapat terbaru. Kontroversi ini menyusul pengungkapan bahwa Raja Juan Carlos, 75 tahun, menerima warisan €2,2 juta dari ayahnya, yang disimpan dalam tiga rekening bank Swiss setelah ayahnya meninggal pada 1 April 1993. Pertanyaan masih menggantung apakah dia membayar pajak yang tepat atas jumlah tersebut. Raja juga menghadapi kritik luas tahun lalu karena melakukan perjalanan berburu gajah ke Botswana saat Spanyol sedang kesulitan dengan pengangguran tinggi. Perjalanan itu menyebabkan pengunduran dirinya sebagai presiden kehormatan WWF Spanyol dan permintaan maaf tanpa preseden.

article_content: A charming Victorian cottage complete with period features and its very own steam train is expected to sell for more than £550,000 at auction. Old Station Cottage, a Grade II listed former railway station built in 1844, served passengers until the late 1970s before undergoing extensive renovation in 1988. Located in Mangotsfield, Bristol, the property includes a restored steam train and carriage situated on original railway tracks within the grounds. The home features four bedrooms, four reception rooms, and a triple garage, blending modern living with historical character. The former ticket office remains intact, and the garden is adorned with vintage signage, an old red phone box, and other railway memorabilia, reflecting its past as North Mangotsfield Railway Station and Dramway Toll House. Paul Lawrence of estate agency David James & Partners described it as 'a lovely family home' with a 'unique feel', noting that the layout still evokes the atmosphere of a traditional station. The property will be auctioned on December 3 and has already attracted significant interest from buyers.

article_content: Birmingham has been named among the top 10 most exciting destinations to visit in 2015 in a list compiled annually by the travel guidebook series Rough Guides. It is the only UK city selected by the publication's travel editors. Joining global highlights such as Johannesburg, Málaga, New Orleans, Hamburg, Wellington, Nizwa, Belgrade, Salta, and Yangon, Birmingham was chosen for its embrace of industrial heritage and vibrant cultural scene. The Bull Ring offers a wide range of retail experiences, while Edgbaston Cricket Ground will host the upcoming Test Match between England and Australia. Cadbury World celebrates Birmingham as the heart of the chocolate world and remains a popular family destination. With Birmingham New Street Station fully reopening in September 2015, the year presents an ideal opportunity to visit. Lottie Gross of Rough Guides said: 'Every year, our editors and authors compile a list of destinations we believe will stand out in the coming year. From the vibrant Bull Ring markets to the creative quarter in Digbeth, Birmingham earns its place with cultural variety, excellent shopping, and one of the UK’s liveliest live music scenes.' Emma Gray, Director of Marketing Services at Visit Birmingham, added: 'Being included in Rough Guides’ acclaimed shortlist reflects Birmingham’s growing global appeal. Last year, the city welcomed a record 34 million visitors and saw a 32% increase in international tourists — the highest rise in the UK.' In 2015, Birmingham unveiled major developments: the £600 million redevelopment of New Street Station, the Grand Central retail complex featuring a flagship John Lewis store, and Resorts World Birmingham — the UK’s first integrated destination leisure complex. Other key attractions include the Custard Factory, Edgbaston Cricket Ground, and Villa Park, which hosted two Rugby World Cup matches. Chris Montgomery, Network Rail’s project director for New Street Station, noted: 'Before the project, the station was dark, overcrowded, and unwelcoming. The first phase opened in April 2013, but when the full renovation completed in September 2015, visitors experienced a brighter, more spacious, and inviting gateway to the city.' Birmingham’s culinary reputation also shines: in 2012, it was ranked #19 in The New York Times’ '45 Places to Go' — the only English city outside London to make the list — thanks to chefs like Aktar Islam, Glynn Purnell, Richard Turner, and Luke Tipping.

Menyertai destinasi global seperti Johannesburg, Málaga, New Orleans, Hamburg, Wellington, Nizwa, Belgrade, Salta, dan Yangon, Birmingham dipilih kerana penghormatannya terhadap warisan industri dan suasana budaya yang hidup. Bull Ring menawarkan pelbagai pengalaman belian, manakala Edgbaston Cricket Ground menjadi tuan rumah Perlawanan Uji mendatang antara England dan Australia. Cadbury World memperingati Birmingham sebagai pusat dunia coklat dan tetap menjadi destinasi keluarga yang popular. Dengan pembukaan semula penuh Stesen Birmingham New Street pada September 2015, tahun ini merupakan masa yang ideal untuk melawat. Lottie Gross daripada Rough Guides berkata: 'Setiap tahun, editor dan penulis kami menyusun senarai destinasi yang kami percaya akan menonjol pada tahun hadapan. Dari pasaran Bull Ring yang hidup hingga kawasan kreatif di Digbeth, Birmingham layak berada di senarai ini dengan kepelbagaian budaya, perniagaan yang cemerlang, dan salah satu adegan muzik langsung paling hidup di UK.' Emma Gray, Pengarah Perkhidmatan Pemasaran di Visit Birmingham, menambah: 'Kemasukan Birmingham dalam senarai pendek Rough Guides yang diakui mencerminkan daya tarikan global Birmingham yang semakin meningkat. Tahun lepas, bandar ini menyambut 34 juta pelawat dan mengalami peningkatan 32% dalam pelawat antarabangsa — peningkatan tertinggi di UK.' Pada tahun 2015, Birmingham melancarkan pembangunan utama: pembangunan semula Stesen New Street sebanyak £600 juta, kompleks perniagaan Grand Central dengan kedai runcit utama John Lewis, dan Resorts World Birmingham — kompleks rekreasi integrasi pertama di UK. Destinasi utama lain termasuk Custard Factory, Edgbaston Cricket Ground, dan Villa Park, yang menjadi tuan rumah dua perlawanan Piala Dunia Rugbi. Chris Montgomery, pengarah projek Network Rail untuk Stesen New Street, menyatakan: 'Sebelum projek ini, stesen itu gelap, sesak, dan tidak mesra. Fasa pertama dibuka pada April 2013, tetapi apabila pembaharuan penuh selesai pada September 2015, pelawat mengalami gerbang pertama ke bandar yang lebih cerah, lebih luas, dan lebih mesra.' Reputasi kuliner Birmingham juga menonjol: pada tahun 2012, ia disenaraikan ke-19 dalam '45 Tempat untuk Dikunjungi' oleh The New York Times — satu-satunya bandar Inggeris di luar London yang masuk senarai — berterima kasih kepada chef seperti Aktar Islam, Glynn Purnell, Richard Turner, dan Luke Tipping.

article_content: According to a November 7 report by TechCrunch, Microsoft has expanded its Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub program to provide select early-stage startups with free access to high-performance 'supercomputing' resources on its Azure cloud platform. The initiative aims to reduce infrastructure cost barriers for startups developing, training, and running complex artificial intelligence models. The new no-cost Azure AI infrastructure offering includes GPU-powered virtual machine clusters optimized for AI workloads, featuring NVIDIA-based GPUs capable of handling computationally intensive tasks such as natural language processing and computer vision model training. Accepted startups will receive time-bound Azure credits equivalent to thousands of dollars per month, usable exclusively for AI-related workloads to support testing and refinement during early development phases when resources are most limited. Y Combinator, the prominent seed-stage startup accelerator, will be the first organization granted private preview access to these new supercomputing clusters. Microsoft cited Y Combinator’s proven track record of nurturing very early-stage ventures as the reason for selecting it as an initial partner. Microsoft will collaborate closely with Y Combinator to prioritize cluster access for AI-focused startups in its current winter cohort and among alumni developing new AI applications. The goal is to eliminate barriers to experimenting with innovative, resource-heavy AI use cases — such as large language models akin to ChatGPT — that demand substantial data and computational power. Lowering these barriers could empower more startups to develop transformative AI solutions. Annie Pearl, Vice President of Growth and Ecosystems at Microsoft, stated: 'The focus will be on tasks like training and fine-tuning use cases that unblock innovation.' Over time, Microsoft plans to extend preview access to additional startup accelerators and venture capital firms within its M12 portfolio. The long-term vision is to enable any promising early-stage AI startup to leverage the cloud resources necessary to build and iterate rapidly. Microsoft believes Azure’s technical strengths — including high-speed networking and hyper-scale data storage — provide the optimal foundation for developing next-generation AI systems. Although the free credits are time-limited, Microsoft hopes the program will attract startups to its platform and eventually convert them into paying customers. Competitors such as Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud also offer startup credit programs focused on AI, but Microsoft positions its initiative as uniquely targeted toward the most under-resourced, pre-seed startups. The program is not purely charitable: access is restricted by usage limits and duration, and is not designed for indefinite production deployments. Annie Pearl acknowledged the strategic intent: 'We believe that Azure is the best system for building AI solutions, and we’re prioritizing those that are building on Azure.' She added: 'While all cloud providers offer credits to startups, our approach attempts to address the broader needs of this community by allowing these credits to be applied to training and fine-tuning for earlier-stage startups.' By cultivating relationships with startups at their earliest stages, Microsoft aims to build a thriving ecosystem of innovators anchored to Azure and its AI capabilities, solidifying Azure’s position as the leading platform for future AI development. However, rival cloud providers are likely to continue competing aggressively for the same pool of cutting-edge startups. This program expansion underscores how major tech firms view AI as the next major computing paradigm and are investing heavily to shape its future. For startups, the initiative offers rare access to enterprise-grade resources, enabling them to compete technologically far beyond their size.

Inisiatif ini bertujuan untuk mengurangkan halangan kos infrastruktur bagi permulaan yang membangunkan, melatih, dan menjalankan model kecerdasan buatan yang kompleks. Tawaran infrastruktur AI Azure percuma baharu termasuk kluster mesin maya bertenaga GPU yang dioptimumkan untuk beban kerja AI, dengan GPU berasaskan NVIDIA yang mampu menangani tugas-tugas yang memerlukan pengiraan intensif seperti pemprosesan bahasa semula jadi dan latihan model penglihatan komputer. Permulaan yang diterima akan menerima kredit Azure berjangka masa setara dengan ribuan dolar sebulan, yang hanya boleh digunakan untuk beban kerja AI untuk menyokong pengujian dan penyempurnaan semasa fasa pembangunan awal apabila sumber paling terhad. Y Combinator, akselerator permulaan peringkat benih yang terkenal, akan menjadi organisasi pertama yang diberi akses pra-pelihat peribadi kepada kluster komputasi berkekuatan tinggi baharu ini. Microsoft merujuk kepada rekod terbukti Y Combinator dalam membina permulaan awal yang sangat awal sebagai sebab memilihnya sebagai rakan kongsi awal. Microsoft akan bekerjasama rapat dengan Y Combinator untuk mengutamakan akses kluster kepada permulaan yang berfokus pada AI dalam kohort musim sejuk semasa serta alumni YC yang membangunkan aplikasi dan perkhidmatan AI baharu. Matlamatnya adalah untuk menghapuskan halangan kepada eksperimen dengan kes penggunaan AI inovatif tetapi berat sumber — seperti model bahasa besar yang serupa dengan ChatGPT — yang memerlukan data dan kuasa pengkomputeran yang banyak. Mengurangkan halangan ini boleh memberdayakan lebih ramai permulaan untuk membangunkan penyelesaian AI yang transformasional. Annie Pearl, Naib Presiden Pertumbuhan dan Ekosistem di Microsoft, menyatakan: 'Fokus akan berada pada tugas-tugas seperti pelatihan dan penyesuaian semula kes yang membuka jalan kepada inovasi.' Seiring masa, Microsoft merancang untuk memperluaskan akses pra-pelihat infrastruktur AI Azure melalui perkongsian dengan akselerator permulaan dan firma modal ventura tambahan dalam portfolionya M12. Visi jangka panjangnya adalah untuk membolehkan mana-mana permulaan awal yang menjanjikan yang berfokus pada pembangunan AI memanfaatkan sumber awan yang diperlukan untuk membina dan berulang dengan cepat. Microsoft percaya kekuatan teknikal Azure — termasuk rangkaian berkelajuan tinggi dan penyimpanan data berskala hiper — memberikan asas terbaik untuk membangunkan sistem AI generasi seterusnya. Walaupun kredit percuma itu terhad masa, Microsoft berharap program ini akan menarik lebih ramai permulaan ke platformnya dan akhirnya menukar mereka kepada pelanggan komersial jangka panjang. Pesaing seperti Amazon Web Services dan Google Cloud juga menawarkan program kredit permulaan yang berfokus pada AI, tetapi Microsoft menempatkan inisiatifnya sebagai unik dalam menargetkan permulaan paling kurang sumber dan pra-benih. Program ini bukan semata-mata amal: akses dibatasi oleh had penggunaan dan tempoh, dan tidak direka untuk penyebaran pengeluaran tanpa batas. Annie Pearl mengakui niat strategik: 'Kami percaya bahawa Azure adalah sistem terbaik untuk membina penyelesaian AI, dan kami mengutamakan mereka yang membina di atas Azure.' Dia menambah: 'Sementara semua penyedia awan menawarkan kredit kepada permulaan, pendekatan kami cuba menangani keperluan yang lebih luas komuniti ini dengan membenarkan kredit ini digunakan untuk pelatihan dan penyesuaian semula bagi permulaan peringkat awal.' Dengan membangunkan hubungan dengan permulaan pada peringkat paling awal, Microsoft bertujuan untuk membina ekosistem inovator yang berkembang yang berpangkalan kepada Azure dan kemampuan AI-nya, memantapkan kedudukan Azure sebagai platform utama untuk pembangunan AI masa depan. Namun, penyedia awan pesaing kemungkinan besar akan terus bersaing secara agresif untuk menarik pasaran permulaan canggih yang sama. Pemekaran program ini menegaskan bagaimana syarikat-syarikat teknologi besar melihat AI sebagai paradigma pengkomputeran seterusnya dan bersedia berinvestasi besar-besaran untuk merealisasikan masa depan itu. Bagi permulaan, inisiatif ini menawarkan akses jarang kepada sumber peringkat perusahaan, membolehkan mereka bersaing secara teknologi jauh melebihi saiz mereka.

article_content: Steven Finn has turned a page on his painful Australian memories, delivering a stellar performance at the Gabba that has redefined his international career. Just over a year ago, Finn was struggling both with his bowling action and his confidence during a disastrous Ashes tour — a low point that culminated in him being sent home early after then-coach Ashley Giles labeled him 'unselectable.' That setback occurred right here in Brisbane, making his return all the more symbolic. On this occasion, Finn shone brightly, claiming career-best ODI figures of 5 for 33 against India, helping restrict them to a modest 153. His trademark steep bounce proved devastating, and England cruised to a nine-wicket victory thanks to composed, unbeaten knocks of 88 from Ian Bell and 56 from James Taylor. 'It’s almost exactly a year since I left Australia last time,' Finn said with a smile. 'That chapter is closed. I felt I’d already turned that corner months ago — all that’s behind me now.' While the memories of his earlier struggles remain — reinforced by familiar hotels and venues — Finn now embraces the challenge. 'I’m enjoying my time in Australia. Taking wickets here? That’s sweet.' His performance, alongside four wickets from the returning James Anderson and Bell’s elegant innings, secured Eoin Morgan’s first win as England captain. Morgan praised Finn, saying, 'He found rhythm early and exploited that bounce perfectly. Seeing him deliver like this — after everything he’s been through — makes me incredibly proud.' India captain MS Dhoni, who chose to bat first, lamented his team’s poor batting display: 'We didn’t play well. The pitch was uneven, and we failed to build partnerships. When a ball is there to score, you take it — but when it’s not, you guard your wicket.'

Kegagalan itu berlaku tepat di sini di Brisbane, menjadikan kehadirannya kali ini lebih bermakna. Pada kesempatan ini, Finn bersinar terang, mencatat angka ODI terbaik karier iaitu 5 untuk 33 melawan India, membantu mengurangkan mereka kepada jumlah rendah 153. Lompatan curam khasnya terbukti membinasakan, dan England berjaya menang dengan mudah sebanyak sembilan gawang menerusi pukulan tidak terbuang 88 dari Ian Bell dan 56 dari James Taylor. 'Ia hampir tepat setahun sejak saya meninggalkan Australia kali terakhir,' kata Finn sambil tersenyum. 'Bahagian itu sudah tertutup. article_content: On Friday night, Ruth Burgos took her one-year-old son, Thiago, to a Starbucks in Denver for coffee. Finding no changing table in the restroom, she changed his diaper on a seat in the seating area. A Starbucks employee approached Ruth and her husband, Alex, handed them a rag, and instructed them to clean up after themselves. Ruth said the interaction felt demeaning, noting that staff members laughed among themselves while observing. Offended by the response, Alex deliberately poured his venti coffee onto the floor and told the staff to clean up after him. The store then called Denver police, reporting a disturbance. Although strong words and hand gestures were exchanged, no arrests were made. Thiago, unaware of the commotion, gurgled happily and seemed amused by the flashing lights of the arriving police car. Ruth expressed frustration, stating, 'As a mother, you have to do what you have to do — wherever you have to do it.' Jami Dennis, president of Glendale-based ABC Nannies, commented that while public diaper changes should be a last resort, many family-friendly businesses lack adequate facilities. Starbucks later issued an apology, stating it values all customers being treated with dignity and respect.

Seorang pekerja Starbucks mendekati Ruth dan suaminya, Alex, memberikan sehelai kain lap dan menyuruh mereka membersihkan selepas penggunaan. Ruth mengatakan interaksi itu terasa merendahkan, apabila staf tertawa-tawa di antara mereka semasa memerhati. Terkesan dengan tindakan itu, Alex sengaja menuangkan kopi ventinya ke atas lantai dan menyuruh pihak kedai membersihkan selepas dirinya. Kedai itu kemudian memanggil polis Denver, melaporkan gangguan. Walaupun terdapat kata-kata kuat dan isyarat tangan, tiada tangkapan dibuat. Thiago, yang tidak sedar akan kegaduhan itu, bergurau dengan gembira dan nampak terhibur dengan lampu kelip polis yang datang. Ruth mengungkapkan rasa frustrasi, berkata, 'Sebagai seorang ibu, anda perlu melakukan apa yang perlu dilakukan — di mana sahaja anda perlu melakukannya.' Jami Dennis, presiden ABC Nannies yang berpusat di Glendale, mengulas bahawa walaupun pertukaran lampin awam seharusnya menjadi pilihan terakhir, ramai perniagaan mesra keluarga tidak mempunyai kemudahan yang mencukupi. Starbucks kemudiannya mengeluarkan permintaan maaf, menyatakan ia menghargai semua pelanggan diperlakukan dengan maruah dan hormat.

article_content: Former judge Sir Anthony Hooper has warned that government plans to overhaul legal aid could dismantle Britain’s globally respected justice system. Speaking on BBC Radio 4’s Today Programme, the retired Court of Appeal judge criticized a £220 million budget cut proposed by the Ministry of Justice, which would replace quality-based selection of solicitors with a price-driven tendering system. Under the new model, firms—including non-legal entities like the Stobart Group—would compete to offer the lowest bids for legal aid contracts. Sir Anthony argued that this shift would strip defendants of their longstanding right to choose their own solicitor and severely diminish the quality of legal representation. He expressed particular concern for vulnerable defendants, such as those with disabilities or mental health conditions, who might be assigned lawyers lacking the necessary expertise. 'The government talks about Robust Quality Assurance,' he said, 'but frankly, it sounds like gobbledygook.' Maura McGowan QC, Chair of the Bar Council, echoed these fears, stating that the reforms risk turning the UK’s internationally admired justice system into one where 'price trumps all.' Her organization’s 150-page response condemned price competitive tendering (PCT) as a blunt instrument that would devastate small law firms, reduce access for the poor, and erode the independence of the criminal defense bar. The Bar Standards Board raised additional alarms, warning that paying the same fee for a guilty plea and a full trial could incentivize lawyers to pressure clients into pleading guilty—even when innocent—to save time and maximize earnings. Baroness Ruth Deech, chair of the BSB, cautioned that these changes could compromise the fundamental right to a fair trial. In defense, Justice Secretary Chris Grayling insisted the legal sector must share the burden of austerity. He emphasized that professional lawyers would still be available, contracts would require adherence to quality benchmarks, and wealthier defendants—those earning over £100,000 annually—should pay for their own representation. Grayling noted that the UK spends roughly £1 billion annually on criminal legal aid, calling the reforms necessary to ensure better value for taxpayers. However, critics argue the changes are irreversible and will leave lasting damage to justice accessibility and equity.
translated_content: Hakim yang telah bersara, Sir Anthony Hooper, memperingatkan bahawa rancangan kerajaan untuk mengubah sistem bantuan undang-undang boleh menghancurkan sistem keadilan British yang dihormati di seluruh dunia. Berucap dalam rancangan Today BBC Radio 4, hakim mahkamah rayuan yang telah bersara itu mengkritik potongan belanjawan sebanyak £220 juta yang dicadangkan oleh Kementerian Keadilan, yang akan menggantikan pemilihan peguam berdasarkan kualiti dengan sistem tender berdasarkan harga. Di bawah model baharu ini, firma-firma—termasuk entiti bukan undang-undang seperti Stobart Group—akan bersaing untuk menawarkan tawaran harga terendah bagi kontrak bantuan undang-undang. Sir Anthony berpendapat bahawa perubahan ini akan menghilangkan hak pesalah yang telah lama dimiliki untuk memilih peguam mereka sendiri dan secara serius mengurangkan kualiti perwakilan undang-undang. Beliau menyatakan kebimbangan khusus terhadap pesalah rentan, seperti mereka yang mengalami kecacatan atau masalah kesihatan mental, yang mungkin dipilihkan peguam yang tidak memiliki kepakaran yang diperlukan. 'Kerajaan berbincang tentang Jaminan Kualiti yang Kuat,' katanya, 'tetapi, jujurnya, ia kedengaran seperti gobbledygook.' Maura McGowan QC, Ketua Majlis Bar, menyokong kebimbangan ini, menyatakan bahawa reformasi ini berisiko menukar sistem keadilan British yang dihormati di seluruh dunia menjadi satu di mana 'harga mengatasi segalanya.' Respons 150-muka surat organisasinya mengutuk tender persaingan harga (PCT) sebagai alat kasar yang akan merosakkan firma-firma undang-undang kecil, mengurangkan akses bagi golongan miskin, dan melemahkan kemerdekaan barisan pertahanan jenayah. Majlis Standard Bar mengangkat kebimbangan tambahan, memperingatkan bahawa pembayaran yuran yang sama untuk pengakuan bersalah dan percubaan penuh boleh mencetuskan insentif kepada peguam untuk menekan klien agar mengaku bersalah—walaupun tidak bersalah—untuk menjimatkan masa dan memaksimumkan pendapatan. Ketua BSB, Baroness Ruth Deech, memperingatkan bahawa perubahan ini boleh membahayakan hak asasi untuk mendapatkan perbicaraan yang adil. Sebagai pertahanan, Menteri Keadilan Chris Grayling menegaskan bahawa sektor undang-undang mesti berkongsi beban pengekangan kewangan. Beliau menekankan bahawa peguam profesional masih akan tersedia, kontrak akan memerlukan pematuhan terhadap piawaian kualiti, dan pesalah yang kaya—mereka yang berpendapatan lebih daripada £100,000 setahun—sepatutnya membayar perwakilan mereka sendiri. Grayling mencatat bahawa British mengeluarkan kira-kira £1 bilion setiap tahun untuk bantuan undang-undang jenayah, dan memanggil reformasi ini perlu demi memastikan nilai yang lebih baik untuk pembayar cukai. Namun, para kritikus berpendapat bahawa perubahan ini tidak boleh dipulihkan dan akan meninggalkan kesan jangka panjang terhadap akses dan keadilan dalam sistem keadilan.

article_content: LOS ANGELES, California (CNN) — It's no secret that 'American Idol' judge Simon Cowell is often unmerciful toward aspiring singers. On Wednesday night, during the elimination round of the popular singing competition, quirky, tattooed contestant Megan Joy Corkrey experienced that firsthand. Megan Joy — who dropped her last name — told Cowell she 'didn't really care' about his criticisms of her Tuesday night performance of Bob Marley's 'Turn The Lights Down Low,' which he described as 'boring, indulgent, and monotonous.' Those comments ultimately sealed her fate. Host Ryan Seacrest asked Cowell if he would use the 'save' rule in Megan's case. Cowell replied, 'Megan, with the greatest respect, when you said you don't care — neither do we. So I'm not going to pretend we're even considering saving you.' In an interview with CNN on Friday, Joy said, 'I don't care that Simon didn't like that song. I truly didn't then, and I still don't. I still loved it — I sang it the way I wanted to.' Despite the tension, Joy says she and Cowell remain on good terms. After the show, they laughed together, and he told her he enjoyed watching her perform. Furthermore, the self-described 'dork' says her 'American Idol' experience has opened new doors for her future. 'Before all this competition, I thought I was just going to be a stay-at-home mom,' Joy said. 'Now, I'm interested to see all sorts of things I could try and dabble in... I'm excited to see what's out there.' And those bizarre moments onstage Wednesday — when she flapped her arms and squawked like a bird? Joy says that's just her personality. 'I do a lot of sound effects all the time — bird noises, animal noises,' she said. 'On Wednesday, I had a feeling it might be me... so I decided I'd just be myself and have fun out there.'

article_content: By Mia De Graaf. PUBLISHED: 13:36 EST, 3 October 2013. | UPDATED: 14:06 EST, 3 October 2013. The widow of the poisoned former KGB spy Alexander Litvinenko has been denied legal funding to challenge the UK government’s decision not to hold a public inquiry into his death. Three judges at London’s High Court—Lord Justice Goldring, Lord Justice Treacy, and Mr Justice Mitting—refused to grant a 'protected costs' order. This means Marina Litvinenko, the only person legally eligible to challenge Home Secretary Theresa May’s ruling, could face financial ruin if she loses the case. The judges said they would deliver their full reasoning the following morning. Marina Litvinenko, pictured at court today, could lose nearly all her assets if she proceeds with the legal challenge. Alexander Litvinenko was poisoned with radioactive polonium-210 in tea at the Millennium Hotel in London in 2006. Ben Emerson QC, representing the widow, condemned the ruling, calling the case one of 'national and international significance.' He explained that his client supports the coroner’s view that a standard inquest would deliver an 'unjust and distorted' verdict inconsistent with existing evidence. Emerson told the court: 'Her Majesty’s Government holds evidence indicating at least a prima facie case that the murder was ordered by officials of the Russian government.' He described the killing as 'an act of nuclear terrorism on the streets of London.' He warned that an unsuccessful challenge could leave Mrs. Litvinenko with a £40,000 legal bill—nearly everything she owns. 'Mrs. Litvinenko regards her life as being on hold. It is extremely difficult for her to plan for the future until this matter is resolved,' he added. Since her husband’s death, Marina and their son Anatoly have tirelessly pursued the truth behind his killing. The family believes Litvinenko was working for MI6 at the time and was assassinated on Kremlin orders. Litvinenko, 43, died after drinking tea with two Russian men—one a former KGB officer—at the Millennium Hotel in London’s Grosvenor Square. Coroner Sir Robert Owen had called for a public inquiry, stating that evidence involving alleged Russian state involvement could not be properly examined in a standard inquest. Despite this, Home Secretary Theresa May ruled in May that the inquest should proceed normally, and any decision on a public inquiry should follow the inquest’s verdict. Marina Litvinenko responded by launching legal proceedings to challenge May’s decision. A further hearing will determine whether she is granted permission to pursue the judicial review.

article_content: Jonathan Joseph’s explosive performances for England have reignited comparisons to legendary centre Jeremy Guscott — a comparison made even more compelling after he scored two tries against Italy at Twickenham in February 2014. Mike Catt, England’s attacking skills coach and a former teammate of Guscott, has watched Joseph’s development closely since his days at London Irish. While acknowledging the similarities, Catt insists Joseph is a different kind of player. 'Jerry was a swerving outside centre who thrived in big gaps,' Catt explained. 'Nowadays, those holes are rare. What makes JJ special is his footwork and ability to escape tackles — you saw it last week and again on Saturday. That’s the X factor you need to break defenses down.' Joseph, 23, has now scored three tries in eight international appearances — a remarkable return. His first try came from a turnover near halfway, featuring a dazzling side-step and explosive acceleration. The second was a product of George Ford’s perfectly timed delayed pass, exploiting a gap in Italy’s defense. Though initially shifted to the wing due to Mike Brown’s early exit, Joseph has firmly established himself as a premier outside centre. Catt emphasized that Joseph’s strength lies not just in speed, but in gaining extra yards after contact — never being tackled behind the gain line. 'He’s lethal to defend against,' Catt said. 'If you give him the ball early, he’s nearly impossible to stop.' While Joseph’s rise is impressive, Manu Tuilagi — England’s bruising centre — remains a formidable contender. Catt stressed the importance of having contrasting styles: 'You need both. Tuilagi breaks defenses differently. To get his place back, he’ll need to show fireworks.' Despite a commanding 6-try win, England’s performance wasn’t flawless. Defensive lapses allowed Italy to score three times, and Jonny May squandered a clear three-on-one overlap. Coach Stuart Lancaster remained wary — a similar slow start against Ireland in Dublin could prove costly. Still, the emergence of Joseph, Ford’s brilliance, and the returns of Cipriani and Easter offered reasons for optimism. As Catt put it: 'It’s refreshing to see consistency again between a centre partnership. They’ll keep developing — and we’ll be watching.'

Mike Catt, jurulatih kemahiran serangan England dan mantan rakan sepasukan Guscott, telah memantau perkembangan Joseph sejak masa dia bersama London Irish. Apa yang menjadikan JJ istimewa ialah gerakan kakinya dan keupayaannya untuk terlepas daripada tangkapan — anda melihatnya minggu lepas dan sekali lagi pada hari Sabtu. Itulah faktor X yang diperlukan untuk memecahkan pertahanan.' Joseph, 23 tahun, kini telah mencatat tiga percubaan dalam lapan penampilan antarabangsa — pulangan yang luar biasa. Percubaan pertamanya datang daripada pergantian hampir di tengah padang, menampilkan langkah sisi yang cemerlang dan pecutan pantas. Percubaan kedua adalah hasil umpan tertunda sempurna dari George Ford, memanfaatkan jurang dalam pertahanan Itali. Walaupun awalnya dipindahkan ke sayap akibat kecederaan awal Mike Brown, Joseph telah menetapkan dirinya sebagai pusat luar utama. Catt menekankan bahawa kekuatan Joseph bukan sahaja dalam kelajuan, tetapi juga dalam mendapat meter tambahan selepas sentuhan — tidak pernah ditangkap di belakang garis keuntungan. 'Dia sangat mematikan untuk ditangani,' kata Catt. 'Jika anda memberi bola kepadanya awal, dia hampir mustahil dihentikan.' Walaupun kemunculan Joseph mengesankan, Manu Tuilagi — pusat kasar England — masih merupakan pesaing yang hebat. Catt menekankan kepentingan memiliki gaya yang berbeza: 'Anda perlukan keduanya. Kelemahan pertahanan membenarkan Itali mencatat tiga percubaan, dan Jonny May gagal memanfaatkan peluang tiga lawan satu yang jelas. Jurulatih Stuart Lancaster tetap berhati-hati — permulaan perlahan yang sama melawan Ireland di Dublin boleh menjadi bencana. Namun, kemunculan Joseph, kecemerlangan Ford, serta kembalinya Cipriani dan Easter memberi alasan untuk optimis. Seperti yang dikatakan Catt: 'Sungguh menyegarkan melihat konsistensi semula antara pasangan pusat. Mereka akan terus berkembang — dan kita akan memperhatikan.'

article_content: London (CNN) — No British politician has ever inspired both profound admiration and deep animosity like Margaret Thatcher. To her supporters, she was the Conservative warrior-queen who defeated both the 'enemy within' — the striking Yorkshire coal miners led by Arthur Scargill — and the 'enemy without' — General Galtieri’s Argentine forces that invaded the Falkland Islands in 1982. As Britain’s first and only female prime minister, she was also the first to win three consecutive general elections. In Parliament, Thatcher dismissed dissent with unwavering resolve. For a decade from 1979, she dominated British politics. While the left struggled to unify against her right-wing agenda of austerity, privatization, and union restrictions, the most vocal opposition came not from politicians, but from comedians, satirists, and musicians who ridiculed her with wit, energy, and fury. The deep societal divisions of the era were captured in 'Ghost Town' by The Specials — a haunting ska anthem that echoed through cities like London, Birmingham, Liverpool, and Leeds as riots broke out in 1981. Its lyrics — 'This town's becoming like a ghost town / Government leaving the youth on the shelf' — reflected widespread disillusionment. Songwriter Jerry Dammers later said the song was born from his disdain for Thatcher’s policies: 'It was our political reflection on a decade that wasn’t good. Her policies helped create this decay. Britain is no longer self-sufficient, and we no longer pay our way in the world.' Other protest songs followed: The Jam’s 'Town Called Malice,' Elvis Costello’s 'Stamp the Dirt Down,' and Morrissey’s 'Margaret on the Guillotine' voiced not just policy objections, but personal revulsion. Music critic Dorian Lynskey, author of '33 Revolutions Per Minute: A History of Protest Songs,' noted that Thatcher’s confrontational rhetoric fueled artistic backlash. 'She singled out enemies — unions, benefit recipients, Argentines, the left — and spoke of them as if they were adversaries in war. Calling miners 'the enemy within' was unprecedented. Politicians didn’t talk like that. And that stung.' Though Thatcher was ousted in 1990 by her own party, not by artists, Lynskey argues that cultural expression mattered. 'Just as Picasso’s 'Guernica' didn’t stop the Spanish Civil War, it gave voice to outrage. Art makes people feel less alone. It informs. It heals.' Fashion, film, TV, and nightlife also flourished in the wake of punk’s rebellion. Designer Katherine Hamnett famously wore a T-shirt reading '58% Don't Want Pershing' to a 1983 Downing Street reception — a protest against U.S. nuclear missiles in the UK. When Thatcher reportedly responded, 'We don’t have Pershing here, we have cruise missiles,' Hamnett replied: 'I thought it was a good photo opportunity.' Satire thrived too. 'Spitting Image,' the puppet show that aired from 1984 to 1996, turned Thatcher into a ranting, foaming-at-the-mouth caricature. Co-creator Roger Law said the goal was to 'lance a bubble every week' — exposing government actions disguised as policy. 'There was no smiley Thatcher. Why would there be? She never smiled.' One infamous sketch showed her ordering steak raw — and telling her ministers, 'They’ll have the same as me' — mocking their subservience. Law believes Thatcher’s legacy is one of lasting harm: 'She threw people to the dogs. You see it now — the underclass, the collapse of public services, the end of accessible education. My generation got free art school because we had talent. Try getting that today. That was her aim.' Yet some argue her impact on culture was indirect. Jason Cowley of the New Statesman suggested that both Thatcherites and punks shared a radical desire to break from tradition — 'a fundamental discontinuity with the past.' Even those who hated her politics embraced the same rebellious, DIY ethos she championed in economics. Hamnett dismisses claims that Thatcher fostered creativity: 'She did nothing for the arts. She designed her own frumpy clothes. If she’d been a fashion designer, it wouldn’t have been hard — she’d have been terrible.' Thatcher’s death in 2013 at age 87 left Britain divided — a nation still wrestling with the consequences of her revolution.
translated_content: London (CNN) — Tidak ada seorang politikus Britania pun yang pernah menginspirasi penghormatan mendalam dan kebencian mendalam seperti Margaret Thatcher. Bagi para pendukungnya, dia adalah ratu pejuang Konservatif yang mengalahkan 'musuh di dalam' — para penambang batu bara Yorkshire yang mogok dipimpin oleh Arthur Scargill — dan 'musuh di luar' — pasukan Argentina Jenderal Galtieri yang menyerbu Kepulauan Falkland pada tahun 1982. Sebagai perdana menteri wanita pertama dan satu-satunya di Britania, dia juga orang pertama yang memenangkan tiga pemilu berturut-turut. Di Parlemen, Thatcher mengabaikan semua suara protes dengan tekad tak tergoyahkan. Selama satu dekade sejak 1979, dia mendominasi politik Britania. Sementara pihak kiri berjuang untuk bersatu melawan agenda kanan-ekstremnya tentang penghematan anggaran, privatisasi, dan pembatasan serikat buruh, oposisi paling vokal datang bukan dari politisi, tetapi dari komedian, satiris, dan musisi yang menertawakan dirinya dengan kecerdasan, energi, dan kemarahan. Perpecahan sosial yang mendalam pada masa itu tertangkap dalam lagu 'Ghost Town' oleh The Specials — sebuah antologi ska yang suram yang bergema di kota-kota seperti London, Birmingham, Liverpool, dan Leeds saat kerusuhan meletus pada tahun 1981. Liriknya — 'Kota ini menjadi seperti kota hantu / Pemerintah meninggalkan kaum muda di tepi jalan' — mencerminkan kekecewaan luas. Penulis lagu Jerry Dammers kemudian mengatakan lagu itu lahir dari kebencian terhadap kebijakan Thatcher: 'Ini adalah refleksi politik kami atas dekade yang tidak baik. Kebijakannya membantu menciptakan kehancuran ini. Britania tidak lagi mandiri, dan kita tidak lagi mampu membayar utang kita sendiri.' Lagu protes lain menyusul: 'Town Called Malice' oleh The Jam, 'Stamp the Dirt Down' oleh Elvis Costello, dan 'Margaret on the Guillotine' oleh Morrissey menyuarakan bukan hanya ketidaksetujuan terhadap kebijakan, tetapi kebencian pribadi terhadap dirinya. Kritikus musik Dorian Lynskey, penulis buku '33 Revolutions Per Minute: A History of Protest Songs,' mencatat bahwa retorika konfrontatif Thatcher memicu reaksi artistik. 'Dia menunjuk musuh-musuh — serikat buruh, penerima tunjangan, Argentina, sayap kiri — dan berbicara tentang mereka seolah-olah mereka adalah lawan dalam perang. Menyebut para penambang sebagai 'musuh di dalam' belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya. Politikus tidak bicara seperti itu. Dan itu menyakitkan.' Meskipun Thatcher digulingkan pada tahun 1990 oleh partainya sendiri, bukan oleh seniman, Lynskey berpendapat bahwa ekspresi budaya tetap penting. 'Seperti 'Guernica' karya Picasso yang tidak menghentikan Perang Saudara Spanyol, ia memberikan suara pada kemarahan. Seni membuat orang merasa tidak sendirian. Ia memberi informasi. Ia menyembuhkan.' Busana, film, TV, dan kehidupan malam juga berkembang pesat di belakang pemberontakan punk. Desainer Katherine Hamnett terkenal memakai kaos bertuliskan '58% Tidak Mau Pershing' di sebuah resepsi di Downing Street tahun 1983 — protes terhadap rudal nuklir AS di Inggris. Ketika Thatcher dikabarkan menjawab, 'Kami tidak punya Pershing di sini, kami punya cruise missile,' Hamnett menjawab: 'Saya pikir ini kesempatan foto yang bagus.' Satir juga berkembang pesat. 'Spitting Image,' acara boneka yang tayang dari 1984 hingga 1996, menggambarkan Thatcher sebagai karikatur yang marah-marah dan mulut berbusa. Salah satu penciptanya, Roger Law, mengatakan tujuannya adalah 'menembus gelembung setiap minggu' — mengungkap tindakan pemerintah yang disamarkan sebagai kebijakan. 'Tidak ada Thatcher yang tersenyum. Mengapa harus ada? Dia tidak pernah tersenyum.' Salah satu sketsa terkenal menunjukkan dia memesan steak mentah — dan berkata kepada para menterinya, 'Mereka akan dapat yang sama seperti saya' — mengejek ketergantungan mereka. Law percaya warisan Thatcher adalah kerusakan yang berkelanjutan: 'Dia melemparkan banyak orang ke anjing. Anda lihat sekarang — kelas bawah, runtuhnya layanan publik, berakhirnya pendidikan yang terjangkau. Generasi saya mendapatkan sekolah seni gratis karena punya bakat. Coba dapatkan itu hari ini. Itu tujuannya.' Namun, beberapa berpendapat dampaknya terhadap budaya bersifat tidak langsung. Jason Cowley dari New Statesman menyatakan bahwa kedua kelompok — pendukung Thatcher dan kaum punk — berbagi hasrat radikal untuk memutuskan hubungan dengan masa lalu — 'putus asa total dengan masa lalu.' Bahkan mereka yang membenci politiknya mengadopsi semangat pemberontak dan DIY yang sama yang dia promosikan dalam ekonomi. Hamnett menyangkal klaim bahwa Thatcher mendorong kreativitas: 'Dia tidak melakukan apa-apa untuk seni. Dia merancang pakaian sendiri yang kusam. Jika dia menjadi desainer mode, tidak akan sulit — dia akan buruk.' Kematian Thatcher pada tahun 2013 di usia 87 tahun meninggalkan Britania terbelah — sebuah bangsa yang masih berjuang dengan konsekuensi revolusinya.

article_content: A young harbor seal was captured on camera playing hide-and-seek with a Labrador dog in a heartwarming moment filmed along the River Thames in Greenwich, London. The rare encounter was recorded by Nicola White and David Nolan using their mobile phone as they walked their 13-year-old Labrador, Mischa, by the river earlier this month. Within seconds of filming, the seal leapt out of the water and landed on the riverwalk beside Mischa. Over the course of a four-minute, 35-second video, the seal and dog engaged in a playful game of hide-and-seek — the seal diving beneath the surface and reappearing, while Mischa chased it eagerly. David Nolan described how the seal followed them along the shoreline, seemingly mistaking Mischa for another seal due to her light coloring. At Morden Wharf, the seal emerged from the water and continued interacting with the dog, as shown in the video. The pair noticed a numbered identification tag on the seal and later traced it to the RSPCA Seal Sanctuary in East Winch, Kings Lynn, Norfolk, where the female seal had been rehabilitated after being orphaned. She was released back into the wild two years ago — a testament to the sanctuary’s successful care program. Nolan noted that this was the third time they had encountered the same seal, most recently the previous weekend. He added that the presence of such wildlife reflects the improving cleanliness of the Thames. The seal exhibited no aggression — only curiosity — and seemed eager to engage. The video, titled 'Greenwich Thames Seal Playing with Dog 2nd Feb 2013,' was uploaded by White on February 3 and has since garnered over 5,000 views and enthusiastic comments. One viewer shared a similar experience, recalling the same seal playing around their workboat near Chalkstones. Another commented on the rarity of such a tame seal returning regularly to the Thames, calling the footage 'amazing to watch.'

article_content: A Taiwanese whisky called Kavalan has stunned experts in blind tastings by beating legendary Scottish single malts — and now, for the first time, it’s hitting UK supermarket shelves. Once crowned ‘New World Whisky of the Year’ by renowned critic Jim Murray in The Whisky Bible and featured in Ian Buxton’s iconic whisky guide, Kavalan has earned gold medals and global praise. Starting next week, Tesco will begin selling it in 50 stores across Britain at £40 per bottle, as part of a broader push into premium spirits. Sales of high-end whiskies — those priced above £40 — have jumped 70% in the last year, reflecting a growing trend where consumers, even amid economic uncertainty, are choosing to splurge on better-quality drinks at home. Tesco’s whisky buyer, Oliver Stevens, says Kavalan’s smooth, complex flavor profile — full of honey, ripe fruit, and warm spice — has already won over skeptical connoisseurs. 'It’s not just a novelty,' he adds. 'People are trading up, treating themselves — and Kavalan fits perfectly.' The launch also includes other luxury Scotches: Glenmorangie Signet at £120, The Glenlivet 16 Year Old Nadurra at £45, and the award-winning Old Pulteney 21-Year-Old at £80. But Kavalan stands out — not just for its origin, but for its character. Tasters describe its golden hue, sweet apple-like aroma, and silky texture as evoking childhood memories of fruity ice lollies. Paired with an elegant bottle, it’s become a conversation starter and a must-have for anyone serious about their home bar.

Pernah dinobatkan sebagai 'Whisky Dunia Baru Tahun Ini' oleh kritikus terkenal Jim Murray dalam The Whisky Bible dan dimasukkan ke dalam panduan whisky ikonik Ian Buxton, Kavalan telah memenangkan berbagai medali emas dan pujian global. Mulai minggu depan, Tesco akan mulai menjualnya di 50 toko di Inggris dengan harga £40 per botol, sebagai bagian dari ekspansi lebih luas ke pasar minuman premium. Penjualan whisky premium — yang harganya di atas £40 — melonjak 70% dalam setahun terakhir, mencerminkan tren tumbuh di mana konsumen, bahkan di tengah ketidakpastian ekonomi, memilih menghabiskan lebih banyak untuk minuman berkualitas lebih baik di rumah. Pembeli whisky Tesco, Oliver Stevens, mengatakan profil rasa halus dan kompleks Kavalan — penuh dengan madu, buah matang, dan rempah-rempah hangat — sudah berhasil memenangkan hati para penikmat yang awalnya skeptis. 'Ini bukan sekadar fenomena sementara,' tambahnya. 'Orang-orang beralih ke produk lebih baik, memanjakan diri — dan Kavalan sangat cocok.' Peluncuran ini juga mencakup beberapa Scotch mewah lainnya: Glenmorangie Signet seharga £120, The Glenlivet 16 Tahun Nadurra seharga £45, dan Old Pulteney 21 Tahun yang memenangkan penghargaan seharga £80. Tetapi Kavalan menonjol — bukan hanya karena asalnya, tetapi juga karena karakternya. Para pencicip menggambarkan warna keemasannya, aroma apel manis, dan teksturnya yang lembut sebagai pengingat kenangan masa kecil tentang es loli buah. Dengan desain botol yang elegan, ia menjadi pembicaraan menarik dan wajib dimiliki oleh siapa pun yang serius tentang perapian minuman mereka.

article_content: The Algerian foreign minister on Thursday dismissed claims that Muammar Gadhafi was in Algeria, stating it was never an option. 'Of course not,' Mourad Medelci told French radio network Europe 1 when asked whether Gadhafi had sought refuge there. 'The idea that Mr. Gadhafi could come knocking on our door was never considered.' Medelci also provided further details on Gadhafi’s family seeking refuge in Algeria. 'I believe the information released regarding some of his family members, who were received in Algeria due to extreme circumstances — primarily humanitarian reasons — caused widespread panic,' he said. Gadhafi’s wife, two sons, and other relatives fled to Algeria, intensifying mistrust between the rebel-led Libyan government and its powerful neighbor. While Algeria framed the move as a humanitarian gesture, it provoked anger from the National Transitional Council (NTC), with one official labeling it 'an aggressive act.' The NTC has accused Algeria of supporting the Gadhafi regime. Algeria also lodged complaints with the United Nations over damage to its embassy shortly after rebel forces entered Tripoli. Medelci confirmed that Algeria would eventually recognize the NTC as Libya’s legitimate government. 'The NTC has said it intends to establish a government representative of all regions. Once that is done, we will recognize it,' he said during the radio interview. CNN’s Saskya Vandoorne contributed to this report.
translated_content: Menteri Luar Negeri Algeria pada hari Kamis menyangkal klaim bahwa Muammar Gadhafi berada di negaranya, menyatakan itu tidak pernah menjadi pilihan. 'Pemikiran bahwa Tuan Gadhafi bisa datang mengetuk pintu kami tidak pernah dipertimbangkan.' Medelci juga memberikan rincian lebih lanjut mengenai keluarga Gadhafi yang mencari perlindungan di Algeria. 'Saya percaya informasi yang dirilis mengenai beberapa anggota keluarganya, yang diterima di Algeria karena keadaan ekstrem — terutama alasan kemanusiaan — menyebabkan kepanikan luas,' katanya. Istri Gadhafi, dua putranya, dan kerabat lainnya melarikan diri ke Algeria, memperdalam ketidakpercayaan antara pemerintah pemberontak Libya dan tetangga kuatnya. Sementara Algeria menyebut tindakan ini sebagai sikap kemanusiaan, hal itu memicu kemarahan Dewan Transisi Nasional (NTC), dengan salah satu pejabat menyebutnya sebagai 'tindakan agresif.' NTC menuduh Algeria mendukung rezim Gadhafi. Algeria juga mengajukan keluhan kepada PBB mengenai kerusakan terhadap kedutaannya tak lama setelah pasukan pemberontak memasuki Tripoli. Medelci menegaskan bahwa Algeria pada akhirnya akan mengakui NTC sebagai pemerintah sah Libya. 'NTC mengatakan mereka berniat membentuk pemerintah yang mewakili semua wilayah. Setelah itu dilakukan, kami akan mengakuinya,' katanya dalam wawancara radio tersebut. Kontribusi laporan ini dari Saskya Vandoorne, CNN.
