article_content: (CNN) — The bloodied bodies were stuffed and tangled in the back of a pickup truck, like garbage. Men lifted them one by one and hurled them from a bridge into a river below, as curses echoed through the air. 'Brother of a whore!' they shouted as the corpses splashed and the water turned red. 'Animals!' 'Dogs!' At one point, a voice mockingly asked, 'This is a soldier?' This scene, allegedly filmed in Syria, appeared in a video on YouTube, where images of anti-government unrest and violence have surfaced consistently since the uprising began in mid-March. CNN could not verify the video’s authenticity, but it reflects the deep hostility of the nearly five-month-old conflict between regime forces and anti-government protesters. It remains unclear who the victims were — whether among the roughly 1,600 civilians or 370 security personnel killed since the unrest began. The video’s uploader claims the bodies are anti-government fighters being disposed of by thugs loyal to President Bashar al-Assad. Meanwhile, Syrian state television broadcast the same footage, asserting the victims are members of the Syrian secret police, killed by Iraqi fighters allied with the opposition and dumped by protesters. A banner in the video identifies the location as Hama, over the Orontes River. But Syrian activist Razan Zaitouneh noted that the river is typically dry at this time of year, casting doubt on the location. However, one prominent anti-government activist — who spoke anonymously due to safety concerns — told CNN the state TV version may be accurate: the dead were indeed Syrian secret police killed by Iraqi fighters who joined the rebellion. He emphasized that these individuals do not represent the broader protest movement. Violent fringe elements have emerged during the unrest. A recent report by the International Crisis Group confirmed that while some opposition groups have taken up arms, 'the vast majority of casualties have been peaceful protesters, and the vast majority of the violence has been perpetrated by the security services.' The activist warned that the video’s release is a double-edged sword: while it alerts peaceful demonstrators to the presence of extremists, it also bolsters the regime’s narrative that it is fighting 'armed gangs.' This, he said, risks weakening international resolve to pressure the Syrian government.
translated_content: (CNN) — Mayat-mayat berdarah disekat dan terkelind di belakang sebuah truk, seperti sampah. Lelaki-lelaki mengangkat mayat-mayat itu satu per satu dan melemparkannya dari jambatan ke sungai di bawah, sementara umpatan memenuhi udara. 'Saudara pelacur!' mereka berteriak ketika mayat-mayat itu menyentuh air dan air menjadi merah. 'Hai binatang!' 'Anjing!' Pada satu ketika, suara bertanya secara sinis, 'Ini seorang askar?' Adegan ini, yang dikatakan difilmkan di Syria, muncul dalam video di YouTube, di mana gambar-gambar kekacauan dan kekerasan antipemerintah telah muncul secara konsisten sejak pergolakan bermula pada pertengahan Mac. CNN tidak dapat mengesahkan keaslian video tersebut, tetapi ia menggambarkan permusuhan mendalam dalam konflik hampir lima bulan antara pasukan rejim dan penyokong anti-pemerintah di Syria. Tidak jelas siapa mangsa-mangsa itu — sama ada di antara kira-kira 1,600 awam atau 370 anggota keselamatan yang dibunuh sejak pergolakan bermula. Pengunggah video menyatakan mayat-mayat itu adalah pejuang anti-pemerintah yang dibuang oleh penjenayah yang setia kepada Presiden Bashar al-Assad. Sementara itu, televisyen negara Syria menyiarkan video yang sama, menyatakan bahawa mayat-mayat itu adalah anggota polis rahsia Syria yang dibunuh oleh pejuang Iraq yang bergabung dengan pihak oposisi dan dibuang oleh pengunjuk rasa. Sebuah papan tanda dalam video itu menyatakan lokasi kejadian di Hama, di atas Sungai Orontes. Tetapi aktivis Syria Razan Zaitouneh mencatat bahawa sungai itu biasanya kering pada masa ini tahun, meragui lokasi kejadian. Namun, seorang aktivis anti-pemerintah terkemuka — yang berbicara secara anonim kerana kekhawatiran keselamatan — memberitahu CNN versi televisyen negara mungkin benar: mayat-mayat itu memang anggota polis rahsia Syria yang dibunuh oleh pejuang Iraq yang menyertai pemberontakan. Dia menekankan bahawa individu-individu ini tidak mewakili gerakan perlawanan yang lebih luas. Unsur-unsur ekstremis bersenjata telah muncul semasa kekacauan ini. Laporan baru-baru ini oleh Kumpulan Krisis Antarabangsa mengesahkan bahawa walaupun beberapa kelompok oposisi telah mengambil senjata, 'majoriti besar korban adalah pengunjuk rasa damai, dan majoriti besar kekerasan dilakukan oleh perkhidmatan keselamatan.' Aktivis itu memperingatkan bahawa pendedahan video ini adalah pedang dua mata: sementara ia memperingatkan pengunjuk rasa damai tentang kehadiran unsur-unsur ekstremis, ia juga memperkuat naratif rejim bahawa ia sedang memerangi 'geng bersenjata.' Ini, katanya, berisiko melemahkan tekad antarabangsa untuk menekan kerajaan Syria.

article_content: Heather Carroll, a 30-year-old mother from rural Alabama, recently welcomed six healthy babies — a rare set of sextuplets — after a grueling yet successful pregnancy. Born via scheduled C-section at Brookwood Medical Center on Father’s Day weekend, the infants — five girls and one boy — arrived within just three minutes of each other, weighing between 1 pound 10 ounces and 2 pounds 5 ounces. All six are now breathing independently and thriving. To sustain the pregnancy, Heather followed an intense nutritional regimen, consuming roughly 6,000 calories daily — tracked meticulously and supplemented with nutrient-rich shakes and IV drips. Despite standing only 5 feet 2 inches and gaining 35 pounds during gestation, she endured months of bed rest, including her 30th birthday, while feeling each baby’s movements clearly — one on each hip, three pressing low on her pelvis, and another shifting up and down. Named alphabetically after the labels used in early ultrasounds — Abbie, Brooklyn, Chloe, David, Ellie, and Faith — the babies were delivered by a coordinated team of 51 medical professionals, each assigned to a specific infant. Dr. Bill McKenzie, her obstetrician, praised her strength, calling her 'country tough' and noting her unwavering faith amid daunting odds. Heather and her husband Mitchell, a maintenance mechanic, had faced years of infertility, including four miscarriages and a diagnosis of polycystic ovary syndrome. Their first child, 22-month-old Grant, was conceived through intrauterine insemination — the same method used for this pregnancy, though sextuplets are exceptionally uncommon. The community in Plantersville has rallied around the family: friends are expanding their home, local businesses are donating diapers and formula, and even a car dealership may gift them a van. The church where Mitchell volunteers as youth pastor is enlarging its nursery, and Heather’s doctor hosted a surprise baby shower. Dr. McKenzie emphasized that every additional day in the womb increased the babies’ survival chances by 4%, making their timely arrival critical. Mitchell, overwhelmed with joy, spent his first Father’s Day moving between incubators, wearing five pink and one blue visitor badge. 'Everything this morning was perfect,' he said. Heather, who once feared she couldn’t handle even one child, now finds herself at the center of national attention. 'I just kept thinking, how are we going to care for six?' she recalled. But with love, medical excellence, and a tight-knit community, the Carrolls are ready for the challenge ahead.
translated_content: Heather Carroll, seorang ibu berusia 30 tahun dari Alabama pedesaan, baru-baru ini menyambut enam bayi yang sehat — satu set sextuplet yang langka — setelah kehamilan yang melelahkan namun berhasil. Bayi-bayi itu — lima perempuan dan satu laki-laki — dilahirkan melalui operasi caesar terjadwal di Brookwood Medical Center pada akhir pekan Hari Ayah, dan tiba dalam waktu hanya tiga menit, dengan berat antara 1 pon 10 ons hingga 2 pon 5 ons. Semua enam bayi kini bernapas secara mandiri dan berkembang dengan baik. Untuk mendukung kehamilan, Heather mengikuti rejim nutrisi intensif, mengonsumsi sekitar 6.000 kalori setiap hari — dilacak secara teliti dan disuplementasi dengan shake bergizi dan infus IV. Meskipun tingginya hanya 5 kaki 2 inci dan bertambah 35 pon selama kehamilan, ia bertahan selama berbulan-bulan istirahat total, termasuk ulang tahunnya yang ke-30, sambil merasakan gerakan masing-masing bayi dengan jelas — satu di setiap pinggul, tiga menekan rendah di panggul, dan satu lagi bergerak naik turun. Diberi nama secara alfabetis berdasarkan label yang digunakan dalam USG awal — Abbie, Brooklyn, Chloe, David, Ellie, dan Faith — bayi-bayi itu dilahirkan oleh tim medis yang terkoordinasi terdiri dari 51 profesional, masing-masing ditugaskan untuk satu bayi. Dr. Bill McKenzie, dokter kandungannya, memuji kekuatannya, menyebutnya 'tahan banting ala pedesaan' dan mencatat imannya yang tak goyah di tengah peluang yang sangat kecil. Heather dan suaminya, Mitchell, seorang mekanik pemeliharaan, telah menghadapi tahun-tahun kesuburan yang sulit, termasuk empat keguguran dan diagnosis sindrom ovarium polikistik. Anak pertama mereka, Grant yang berusia 22 bulan, dikandung melalui inseminasi intrauterin — metode yang sama digunakan untuk kehamilan ini, meskipun kelahiran sextuplet sangat jarang terjadi. Komunitas di Plantersville telah bersatu mendukung keluarga ini: teman-teman sedang memperluas rumah mereka, bisnis lokal memberikan popok dan susu formula, bahkan dealer mobil mungkin memberi mereka sebuah van. Gereja tempat Mitchell menjadi pengurus remaja sedang memperbesar ruang penitipan anak, dan dokter Heather mengadakan pesta bayi kejutan. Dr. McKenzie menekankan bahwa setiap hari tambahan di dalam rahim meningkatkan peluang bertahan hidup bayi-bayi itu sebesar 4%, sehingga kelahiran tepat waktu sangat penting. Mitchell, yang sangat bahagia, menghabiskan Hari Ayah pertamanya berpindah-pindah di antara inkubator, mengenakan lima lencana merah muda dan satu lencana biru. 'Semuanya pagi ini sempurna,' katanya. Heather, yang dulu khawatir tidak bisa merawat satu anak saja, kini berada di pusat perhatian nasional. 'Yang saya pikirkan hanyalah, bagaimana kami bisa merawat enam bayi?' kenangnya. Tetapi dengan cinta, keahlian medis, dan komunitas yang erat, keluarga Carroll siap menghadapi tantangan di depan.

article_content: A taxi driver in Newcastle has been left unable to work after his vehicle was destroyed in a collision with a £100,000 Audi R8 driven by Newcastle United footballer Loic Remy. Andrew Watson, 36, from South Shields, was driving his Fiat Scudo with three passengers when the accident occurred less than half a mile from St James' Park on Saturday, October 5, around 9:40 PM. According to Watson, Remy’s car pulled out from a busy junction directly in front of him, forcing him to brake hard — but the collision was unavoidable. All occupants of the taxi sustained minor injuries and were taken to hospital for assessment. Watson’s vehicle was declared a total loss. Witnesses reported seeing Remy, who was on loan from Queens Park Rangers, hobbling away from the scene. His teammates and friends later expressed concern he might have been injured ahead of Newcastle’s upcoming derby against Sunderland. Watson, a father of three who says he isn’t a football fan, added: 'Friends hope I haven’t damaged Remy for the derby... but I’m not into football.' Northumbria Police confirmed the incident and stated the road was briefly closed for vehicle recovery. Newcastle United declined to comment when approached by MailOnline.

Andrew Watson, 36, dari South Shields, sedang memandu Fiat Scudonya bersama tiga penumpang apabila kejadian berlaku kurang separuh batu dari St James' Park pada Sabtu, 5 Oktober, sekitar jam 9:40 malam. Menurut Watson, kereta Remy keluar dari persimpangan sibuk secara langsung di hadapannya, memaksa dia untuk menekan brek dengan kuat — tetapi perlanggaran itu tidak dapat dielakkan. Semua penumpang teksi mengalami luka ringan dan dibawa ke hospital untuk pemeriksaan. Kenderaan Watson dinyatakan sebagai kerugian penuh. Saksi melaporkan melihat Remy, yang dipinjamkan daripada Queens Park Rangers, berjalan tersentak-sentak keluar dari tempat kejadian. Polis Northumbria mengesahkan kejadian itu dan menyatakan jalan raya ditutup seketika untuk proses pemulihan kenderaan. Newcastle United enggan memberi komen apabila dihubungi oleh MailOnline.

article_content: In 2012, a court in Ipswich sentenced Anthony Jarrard, a 50-year-old guitarist from Essex, to a year in prison after uncovering a decade-long scheme to defraud the UK welfare system. Despite claiming unemployment and severe health issues, Jarrard was actively earning income through guitar lessons, instrument repairs, and performances with his local band, Shady Deal. He also owned a home in Braintree since 1998 and accumulated over £160,000 in savings — well above the £16,000 cap for benefit eligibility. His deception came to light following a 2009 shoplifting incident at a Halfords store in Lowestoft, where police discovered a bank card registered under a fake name. Initially claiming he’d found it, Jarrard later confessed he created the account to avoid paying the poll tax — a revelation that triggered a full financial investigation. Authorities found he had been receiving council tax relief, jobseeker’s allowance, income support, and incapacity benefit since 1995. In 2003, when he first applied for council tax benefit, he already had £69,000 saved. Over the next seven years, he collected £70,000 in public funds while hiding his true financial status. At sentencing, Judge John Devaux remarked that Jarrard wasn’t driven by drugs or gambling, but by a relentless pursuit of money — calling it an 'addiction to money.' His defence lawyer acknowledged the band’s modest success, joking they weren’t the Rolling Stones. Despite claims of a quiet life, the court concluded his lifestyle was sustained by fraud. In June 2012, a confiscation order of £157,495 was issued under the Proceeds of Crime Act, requiring Jarrard to repay £30,338 to the Department for Work and Pensions and £4,507 to Braintree District Council. Suffolk Police praised the outcome as a strong example of holding fraudsters accountable for their illicit gains.

article_content: Seamus Heaney, the Nobel Prize-winning Irish poet and literary giant, passed away at the age of 74 in Dublin on August 30, 2013, following a brief illness. Renowned for his warm presence, commanding voice, and deeply human poetry, Heaney inspired generations — particularly through his belief that poetry should be learned by heart. Alongside Ted Hughes, he co-edited 'The Rattle Bag,' a landmark anthology since 1982 that became Britain’s most cherished schoolbook for poetry. Though he wrote in English and was celebrated globally, Heaney fiercely identified as Irish. He declined the position of Poet Laureate after Hughes’s death and famously rejected inclusion in a British poetry anthology with the lines: 'Be advised, my passport’s green / No glass of ours was ever raised / To toast the Queen.' Born in 1939 on a family farm in County Derry, Heaney experienced profound loss early: his four-year-old brother Christopher was killed by a car in 1953. This tragedy became the haunting core of his poem 'Mid-term Break,' where he wrote: 'A four foot box, a foot for every year.' Heaney’s poetry stood apart from the experimental styles of his time. He favored clarity, rhythm, and emotional honesty over abstraction. Critics who prized obscurity dismissed him as simplistic, but Heaney insisted: 'Formal verse is easier. It’s freedom.' A devoted husband and father of three, Heaney shared a lifelong partnership with his wife Marie, whom he met in 1962. Their bond was forged in evenings of poetry, folk songs, and Irish homemade potato spirit (poteen) with friends like Ted Hughes and Assia Wevill. Though he avoided direct political involvement, Heaney wrote moving elegies for victims of the Troubles and refused to glorify violence. His words, however, shaped history — notably, Bill Clinton quoted Heaney’s 'hope and history rhyme' during the Northern Ireland peace process. Heaney admired the quiet dignity of rural life, often comparing his writing to digging turf — 'digging out words with the nib of his pen.' He despised what he saw as the bleakness of Philip Larkin’s poetry, arguing that a poet’s duty was to 'play music to the gods,' not drum on a kitchen sink. Even in his final years, Heaney remained deeply loved. At a public reading, a young fan tearfully wished she could hug him — a sentiment that captured the rare intimacy his poetry created. Through his work, Heaney didn’t just offer comfort; he rekindled a nation’s love for the English language.
translated_content: Seamus Heaney, penyair Ireland yang memenangi Hadiah Nobel dan tokoh sastra besar, meninggal pada usia 74 tahun di Dublin pada 30 Ogos 2013 setelah sakit singkat. Terkenal kerana kehadirannya yang hangat, suara yang mengagumkan, dan puisi yang sangat manusiawi, Heaney menginspirasi generasi — terutama melalui keyakinannya bahawa puisi harus dihafal. Bersama Ted Hughes, beliau menyunting 'The Rattle Bag,' antologi penting sejak 1982 yang menjadi buku pelajaran paling disayangi di Britain untuk puisi. Walaupun beliau menulis dalam bahasa Inggeris dan dirayakan secara global, Heaney sangat mengidentifikasi dirinya sebagai orang Ireland. Beliau menolak jawatan Penyair Laureat selepas kematian Hughes dan dengan tegas menolak kemasukan karyanya ke dalam antologi penyair Britain dengan ayat: 'Ketahuilah, pasport saya hijau / Tidak ada gelas kami yang pernah diangkat / Untuk bersulang kepada Ratu.' Lahir pada 1939 di sebuah pertanian keluarga di County Derry, Heaney mengalami kehilangan mendalam sejak kecil: adiknya yang berumur empat tahun, Christopher, tewas tertabrak kereta pada 1953. Tragedi ini menjadi inti suram puisinya 'Mid-term Break,' di mana beliau menulis: 'Peti empat kaki, satu kaki untuk setiap tahun.' Puisi Heaney berbeza daripada gaya eksperimen zamannya. Beliau lebih memilih kejelasan, irama, dan kejujuran emosi daripada abstraksi. Para kritikus yang menghargai kerumitan menganggapnya ringkas, tetapi Heaney bersikeras: 'Puisi formal lebih mudah. Ini adalah kebebasan.' Seorang suami yang setia dan ayah kepada tiga anak, Heaney menjalin hubungan seumur hidup dengan isterinya Marie, yang ditemuinya pada 1962. Ikatan mereka dibina di malam-malam penuh puisi, lagu rakyat, dan minuman keras kentang tempatan Ireland (poteen) bersama rakan-rakan seperti Ted Hughes dan Assia Wevill. Walaupun mengelakkan keterlibatan politik langsung, Heaney menulis elegi yang menyentuh hati untuk mangsa-mangsa Troubles dan menolak memuliakan kekerasan. Namun, kata-katanya membentuk sejarah — khasnya, Bill Clinton mengutip 'hope and history rhyme' milik Heaney semasa ucapan beliau mengenai proses perdamaian Ireland Utara. Heaney mengagumi ketenangan hidup luar bandar, sering membandingkan penulisan beliau dengan menggali gambut — 'menggali perkataan dengan hujung pen.' Beliau membenci apa yang dianggapnya sebagai kesuraman puisi Philip Larkin, berhujah bahawa tugas seorang penyair ialah 'memainkan muzik untuk para dewa,' bukan mengetuk-ngetuk wastafel dapur. Bahkan di tahun-tahun terakhirnya, Heaney tetap sangat dicintai. Di sebuah acara bacaan puisi, seorang penggemar muda menangis, ingin memeluknya — sebuah perasaan yang menangkap kedekatan langka yang dicipta puisinya. Melalui karyanya, Heaney tidak hanya menawarkan keselesaan; beliau membangkitkan semula cinta bangsa terhadap bahasa Inggeris.

article_content: Style, beauty, and a certain je ne sais quoi run in the blood of these glamorous Hollywood mother-daughter pairs. Goldie Hawn rose to fame through romantic comedies that showcased her wit and acting talent — qualities her daughter Kate Hudson has mirrored in her own career. Beyond shared talent, both embrace a relaxed, California-cool aesthetic. Blythe Danner, an acclaimed actress, passed down her elegance and artistry to her Oscar-winning daughter, Gwyneth Paltrow. Though Gwyneth’s style leans toward modern chic rather than her mother’s classic sophistication, she credits Blythe as a source of timeless inspiration: 'In her, I see the incredible beauty of someone who has lived a life.' Rumer Willis inherited not only Demi Moore’s striking features but also access to her mother’s iconic wardrobe — yet she’s carved out her own bold, edgy identity that stands apart from Demi’s refined persona. With Madonna as her mother, Lourdes Leon faces immense expectations — but she’s proving herself as a creative force in her own right, co-designing a clothing line for Macy’s. Madonna says, 'She reminds me of me when I was younger. She just goes for it and tries different things.' Susan Sarandon and Eva Amurri both shine on screen and on the red carpet. Eva, known for her roles in 'Californication' and 'How I Met Your Mother,' wears vibrant designs by friend and designer Chris Benz — a taste nurtured since childhood, thanks to her mother taking her to runway shows by Todd Oldham and Diane von Furstenberg. Charlotte Gainsbourg, daughter of Jane Birkin — whose name graces the iconic Hermès Birkin bag — has become a French style icon in her own right. As a celebrated actress, singer, and muse for Nicolas Ghesquière at Balenciaga, she continues her mother’s legacy in fashion and art. Isabella Rossellini and her daughter Elettra Wiedemann, both descendants of cinematic legend Ingrid Bergman, share more than lineage — they’re also joint spokeswomen for Lancôme, a rare honor. Meryl Streep and Mamie Gummer may share similar facial structure and hair color, but their fashion choices diverge: Streep favors elegant, vintage-inspired gowns, while Mamie opts for sleek, contemporary silhouettes. With three films releasing this year, Mamie is stepping into the spotlight — and the red carpet — just as her mother did. Bianca Jagger, a 1970s style pioneer and Studio 54 staple, inspired her daughter Jade, now a renowned jewelry designer who carries forward her mom’s effortless glamour and exotic allure. Katie Holmes and her daughter Suri Cruise are constantly photographed together — whether attending ballet class, shopping for makeup, or enjoying ice cream. As a designer, Katie is mentoring her young daughter to become a true fashionista.

article_content: Nebraska lawmakers, meeting in an emergency session this week, are poised to revise a controversial safe-haven law by imposing a strict 30-day age limit for relinquishing children at hospitals. Since the law’s enactment in September, 35 children have been abandoned at Nebraska hospitals — none of whom were infants, according to state officials. Nearly all — 29 out of 35 — were older than 10, with several teenagers flown in from other states including Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Indiana, and Iowa. The state Senate voted 41 to 6 on Wednesday to eliminate the previous version, which had no age restriction, and replace it with the new 30-day limit. Lawmakers fear the current law is being exploited by parents nationwide who cannot care for older children, overwhelming Nebraska’s already strained child welfare system. With 6,600 children currently in state custody — one of the highest per capita rates in the U.S. — officials warn that expanding this burden further is unsustainable. Gov. Dave Heineman urged parents not to bring teenagers to Nebraska, stating, 'You are saying you no longer support them. You no longer love them.' Social workers reported heartbreaking scenes: children begging not to be left, some running away from hospitals after being dropped off. One mother, Tysheema Brown, drove from Georgia to leave her teenage son, saying, 'Do not judge me as a parent. I love my son... there is just no help.' State Senator Tom White called the phenomenon 'an extraordinary cry for help' from families lacking resources elsewhere. While Nebraska was the last state to adopt a safe-haven law, every other state included an age limit — a gap lawmakers now aim to close. The revised bill is expected to pass final approval this week and be signed by the governor on Friday.

Sejak undang-undang ini dilaksanakan pada bulan September, 35 kanak-kanak telah ditinggalkan di hospital-hospital Nebraska — tiada seorang pun daripadanya adalah bayi, menurut pihak berkuasa negeri. Hampir kesemua — 29 daripada 35 — berumur lebih daripada 10 tahun, dengan beberapa remaja dibawa dari negeri lain termasuk Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Indiana, dan Iowa. Dewan Undangan Negeri telah mengundi 41 kepada 6 pada Rabu untuk membatalkan versi sebelumnya, yang tidak mempunyai had umur, dan menggantikannya dengan had 30 hari yang baru. Ahli parlimen bimbang undang-undang semasa ini sedang dieksploitasi oleh ibu bapa di seluruh negara yang tidak mampu merawat kanak-kanak yang lebih tua, membebani sistem kesejahteraan kanak-kanak Nebraska yang sudah tertekan. Dengan 6,600 kanak-kanak kini dalam penjagaan negara — kadar per kapita tertinggi di antara negeri-negeri di AS — pihak berkuasa memperingatkan bahawa memperluaskan beban ini lebih lanjut adalah tidak boleh diterima. Gabenor Dave Heineman mendesak ibu bapa supaya tidak membawa remaja ke Nebraska, dengan menyatakan, 'Kamu sedang berkata kamu tidak lagi menyokong mereka. Kamu tidak lagi mencintai mereka.' Pekerja sosial melaporkan adegan yang menyedihkan: kanak-kanak memohon agar tidak ditinggalkan, sebahagian melarikan diri dari hospital selepas ditinggalkan. Seorang ibu, Tysheema Brown, memandu dari Georgia untuk meninggalkan anak lelaki remajanya, dengan berkata, 'Jangan hukum saya sebagai ibu. Saya mencintai anak saya... tiada bantuan sama sekali.' Senator Negara Tom White memanggil fenomena ini 'seruan luar biasa untuk pertolongan' daripada keluarga yang kurang sumber di tempat lain. Walaupun Nebraska adalah negeri terakhir yang mengambil undang-undang tempat selamat, setiap negeri lain termasuk had umur — jurang yang kini ingin ditutup oleh ahli parlimen. Rancangan undang-undang yang diperbaiki dijangka akan diluluskan akhir minggu ini dan ditandatangani oleh gabenor pada Jumaat.

article_content: Kevin Pietersen has insisted he would consider any offer to return to the England setup, as selectors met on Friday to decide the squad for next year’s World Cup. His international career appeared over after he was dropped following England’s heavy Ashes defeat last winter and the subsequent release of his controversial autobiography. Yet, as the selectors deliberated, Pietersen tweeted that his phone is ‘on’ — and when asked if he’d take a call from the national team, he replied: ‘Of course!’ Pietersen recently scored a blistering 66 for Melbourne Stars in the opening match of Australia’s Big Bash League, demonstrating that the 34-year-old still possesses match-winning ability. However, it is almost certain he will not be named in England’s 16-man squad for the upcoming Tri-series in Australia, which also includes India and the host nation. That squad will later be trimmed to 15 players for the World Cup. Meanwhile, Alastair Cook’s future as England’s ODI captain remains uncertain amid poor form. Cook is taking nothing for granted, acknowledging he has no ‘divine right’ to lead the team to the World Cup in Australia and New Zealand. The selectors are reviewing England’s 5-2 defeat in Sri Lanka as part of their evaluation process, with the final squad announcement expected Saturday morning. Despite this, ECB managing director Paul Downton has strongly hinted that Cook, who turns 30 on Christmas Day, is likely to retain the captaincy.

Kerjaya antarabangsa beliau kelihatan berakhir selepas beliau dikeluarkan setelah kekalahan telak England dalam Ashes musim sebelum ini dan penerbitan autobiografi kontroversialnya. Namun, semasa pemilih sedang membincangkan pilihan mereka, Pietersen menulis di Twitter bahawa telefonnya ‘aktif’ — dan apabila ditanya sama ada beliau akan menjawab panggilan daripada pengurusan pasukan kebangsaan, beliau menjawab: ‘Tentu saja!’ Pietersen baru-baru ini mencatatkan 66 lari pantas untuk Melbourne Stars dalam perlawanan pembuka Liga Big Bash Australia, menunjukkan bahawa pemain berusia 34 tahun itu masih memiliki keupayaan untuk menang. Walau bagaimanapun, hampir pasti beliau tidak akan dimasukkan ke dalam skuad 16 orang England untuk siri Tri yang akan datang di Australia, yang juga melibatkan India dan negara tuan rumah. Skuad itu akan dikurangkan kepada 15 pemain untuk Piala Dunia. Sementara itu, masa depan Alastair Cook sebagai kapten ODI England masih tidak pasti disebabkan bentuk permainan yang lemah. Cook tidak mengambil apa-apa sebagai pasti, mengakui bahawa beliau tidak mempunyai ‘hak ilahi’ untuk memimpin pasukan ke Piala Dunia di Australia dan New Zealand. Pemilih sedang mengkaji kekalahan England 5-2 di Sri Lanka sebagai sebahagian daripada proses penilaian mereka, dengan pengumuman skuad lawatan dijangka pada Sabtu pagi. Walaupun begitu, pengarah urusan ECB, Paul Downton, telah memberi isyarat kuat bahawa Cook, yang akan berusia 30 pada Hari Natal, kemungkinan besar akan kekal sebagai kapten.

article_content: If you've added puzzle games like Wordle and Connections to your daily routine over the past year, prepare for another compelling habit: Puzzmo is here. This new web platform transforms the classic newspaper puzzle page into a sleek, responsive experience that works seamlessly across phones, tablets, and desktops. Users can sign up for free today, with an optional $40 annual subscription unlocking exclusive content such as experimental games and global leaderboards. Puzzmo is the brainchild of game designer Zach Gage—known for hits like Knotwords and Good Sudoku—and collaborator Orta Therox. After years of development, Gage envisioned a one-stop destination for his puzzle catalog, aiming to outshine established rivals like The New York Times by blending addictive gameplay with community-driven features. Ahead of its soft launch, Gage walked us through the platform’s design philosophy. The goal wasn’t just to add another game hub to the internet—but to recreate the quiet, serendipitous joy of flipping through a newspaper’s puzzle section. When you log in, you’re greeted by a magazine-style layout of puzzle widgets. Clicking one opens that day’s challenge; your progress is saved and visible when you return, just like pencil marks lingering on a printed page. The launch lineup includes six games: three from Gage’s existing repertoire—Really Bad Chess, TypeShift, and SpellTower—and three new titles. Flipart challenges players to fit shapes into a grid; Wordbind, an anagram game, is currently exclusive to subscribers. Most notable is Cross|Word, Gage’s innovative take on the classic crossword. Instead of cryptic clues alone, each hint offers a clear, contextual nudge—for example, clarifying 'Dough that’s inedible?' as 'Dollars, pounds, yen, etc.' This isn’t about making puzzles easier—it’s about demystifying crossword culture for newcomers and older players unfamiliar with modern slang. Gage emphasizes cultural relevance: 'We’re not doing crosswords about golf and yachts. We want puzzles that feel alive today.' The hint system serves a dual purpose: helping beginners while giving veteran solvers access to fresh, contemporary references. Beyond individual play, Puzzmo is built for connection. Global leaderboards track top scores, a community feed highlights daily achievements, and an integrated chat lets players exchange tips. Even more groundbreaking: live multiplayer. With a single click, you can invite a friend to solve the same Flipart puzzle in real time—perfect for couples or families sharing a morning ritual. Unlike competitors who rotate puzzles, Puzzmo’s collection grows over time. Future additions include Knotwords and Good Sudoku—all permanently available. Gage’s vision is clear: to build not just a game platform, but a social space where puzzle lovers gather, compete, and bond—just like in online worlds such as Roblox or Minecraft, but tailored for quiet, thoughtful play.

Sistem petunjuk ini berfungsi dua kali: membantu pemula sambil memberi penyelesaian lama akses kepada rujukan kontemporari yang segar. Selain permainan individu, Puzzmo direka untuk menyatukan orang. article_content: A recent global analysis of internet attack traffic reveals that China is the origin of 43% of observed malicious activity — the highest share among all nations. This finding comes from Akamai Technologies, a U.S.-based cybersecurity firm, which tracked connections across approximately 200 sensor nodes worldwide. Indonesia follows in second place with 15%, rebounding after a temporary surge in 2013. The majority of these attacks target Port 80, the standard gateway for web servers, indicating attempts to exploit vulnerabilities in common web software. Importantly, Akamai’s editor David Belson clarifies that these figures reflect only the traffic detected by their monitoring system — not the entire internet — and should not be interpreted as evidence of state-sponsored activity. The report coincides with growing concern over Shellshock, a critical flaw in the Bash shell, a core component of Linux, macOS, and other Unix-like systems. This vulnerability could allow hackers to take control of internet-connected devices such as smart lights, thermostats, or even door locks. Belson likens port scanning to dialing a company’s main phone number and testing random extensions — Port 80 is simply the most frequently tried. He emphasizes that individual users can significantly reduce their risk by keeping software updated, enabling automatic patches, running reputable antivirus programs, and avoiding suspicious websites. While the scale of attacks is substantial, experts agree that proactive maintenance remains the most effective defense.

Penemuan ini datang dari Akamai Technologies, sebuah syarikat keselamatan siber berpusat di AS, yang mengesan sambungan melalui kira-kira 200 nod pengesanan di seluruh dunia. Indonesia berada di tempat kedua dengan 15%, bangkit semula selepas lonjakan sementara pada tahun 2013. Kebanyakan serangan ini menargetkan Port 80, pintu masuk piawai untuk pelayan web, yang menunjukkan cubaan memanfaatkan kelemahan dalam perisian web yang biasa digunakan. Penting untuk ditekankan, editor Akamai, David Belson, menjelaskan bahawa angka-angka ini hanya mencerminkan trafik yang dikesan oleh sistem pemantauan mereka — bukan keseluruhan internet — dan tidak sepatutnya ditafsirkan sebagai bukti aktiviti yang disokong negara. Laporan ini sejajar dengan kebimbangan yang semakin meningkat terhadap Shellshock, satu kelemahan kritikal dalam shell Bash, komponen asas Linux, macOS, dan sistem Unix lain. Kelemahan ini boleh membenarkan penyerang mengawal peranti yang bersambung ke internet seperti lampu pintar, termostat, atau bahkan kunci pintu. Belson menyamakan pengimbasan port dengan memanggil nombor telefon utama sebuah syarikat dan mencuba ekstensi rawak — Port 80 hanyalah yang paling kerap dicuba. Dia menekankan bahawa pengguna individu boleh mengurangkan risiko mereka secara signifikan dengan memastikan perisian sentiasa dikemas kini, mengaktifkan pembaikian automatik, menjalankan program anti-malware yang boleh dipercayai, dan mengelakkan laman web mencurigakan. Walaupun skala serangan besar, pakar bersetuju bahawa penyelenggaraan proaktif tetap menjadi pertahanan paling berkesan.

article_content: The days of fumbling through conversations in a foreign language may soon be behind us. Microsoft has unveiled Skype Translator — a groundbreaking feature designed to enable real-time, two-way voice and text translation during video calls. With this innovation, individuals speaking different languages can now converse naturally over Skype, as the software instantly converts spoken words into subtitles and synthesized speech in the listener’s native tongue. Though first introduced two years ago, earlier versions suffered from unacceptable inaccuracies. However, recent advances in neural network-based speech recognition have slashed error rates by more than 30%, making the technology viable for public use. Skype, which boasts over 300 million users worldwide and facilitates approximately 2 billion minutes of daily conversation, is accessible across computers, smartphones, tablets, and even smart TVs. It enables free international calls over the internet, bypassing traditional phone charges. Built on Microsoft’s advanced speech recognition and translation APIs — the same core technology underpinning services like Microsoft Translator — Skype Translator demonstrated seamless English-German dialogue in a live demo, translating speech instantly with natural-sounding voices and accurate subtitles. Microsoft acknowledges that the technology is still in its infancy, but envisions a future where language barriers dissolve completely — a 'Star Trek'-style universal translator that may not be as far off as it seems. By the end of 2014, Skype Translator will launch as a beta app for Windows 8.1. Release timelines for other platforms remain unannounced.

article_content: A Louisiana man who wore aluminum foil under a baseball cap to block perceived microwave signals was arrested after threatening to burn down four high schools. Shane Kersey, 35, left threatening voicemails targeting Fisher High and Marrero Academy in Jefferson Parish, along with two schools in Plaquemines Parish. Sheriff’s spokesman Colonel John Fortunato confirmed the threats were received early Wednesday morning, triggering lockdowns and the evacuation of one school. Investigators traced the calls through recordings on the schools’ answering systems and identified Kersey’s phone number. When contacted, Kersey admitted to making the calls and stated he was at a friend’s home in Gretna, where he was subsequently arrested. Kersey explained that the aluminum foil worn under his baseball cap was intended to prevent microwave signals from entering his head. Authorities conducted searches at all four schools and found no weapons or incendiary devices. Kersey has an extensive criminal history, including prior arrests for drug possession, burglary, aggravated battery, criminal trespassing, theft, and illegal weapon possession. He was charged with two counts of terrorizing and is also a fugitive from Plaquemines Parish on an outstanding burglary warrant. Marrero Academy posted a notice stating that at 5:56 a.m., a threatening call was recorded on their answering machine. The school immediately activated its crisis protocol: students were diverted, the campus was locked down, and authorities were notified. After receiving clearance, normal operations resumed, prioritizing student safety above all.

article_content: In 2007, Egyptian writer Ahmed Mourad released his debut novel, 'Vertigo' — a gripping tale of corruption and cover-ups set against the backdrop of Hosni Mubarak’s Egypt. What made this bold move even more extraordinary? Mourad was, at the same time, Mubarak’s personal photographer, spending his days capturing the president’s public image while penning scathing critiques of his regime in secret. 'I’d be with Mubarak in the morning,' Mourad recalls, 'and writing against him by night.' He admits it was the riskiest choice of his life, but one he couldn’t ignore. 'If something happened to me,' he says, 'it was meant to be.' Throughout the 2011 uprising that toppled Mubarak after 18 tense days, Mourad remained by the president’s side — unable to join the crowds in Tahrir Square, though deeply affected. He describes those weeks as 'horrible,' but declines to elaborate, promising instead to one day tell the full story in a memoir. Mubarak, now on trial for allegedly ordering the deaths of protesters and embezzlement, denies all charges. Mourad believes it took real courage to write about the regime while it was still in power — but now that it’s fallen, the act feels almost safe. Still, he waits for the right moment. 'When things settle,' he says, 'I’ll write what I saw: the good, the bad, the human side. No one is just evil.' He recalls how Mubarak started as a leader striving to serve, but over his final decade, grew complacent, obsessed with comfort and control — becoming, in Mourad’s words, 'a scarecrow, not a president.' 'Vertigo,' which sold over 11,000 copies in Egypt, follows a society photographer caught in a deadly nightclub massacre and the subsequent silence enforced by power. Its English publisher calls it a revelation of the dark underbelly of Mubarak-era Cairo. Mourad followed it with another political novel — now being turned into a movie — but his next project will step away from corruption themes. Today, Mourad still holds his official government post, waiting for a new president to arrive. He doesn’t believe the system died with Mubarak. 'Corruption didn’t leave with him,' he says. 'It’s still here — inside us. We removed a man, but not the mindset.' With Egypt’s parliamentary elections underway and presidential polls coming next year, Mourad hopes the next leader won’t become a god-like figure. 'Since the Pharaohs, every ruler has been treated like a deity,' he says. 'That has to end. The next president must never forget Tahrir Square — or what happened to Mubarak.'
translated_content: Pada tahun 2007, penulis Mesir Ahmed Mourad menerbitkan novel pertamanya, 'Vertigo' — sebuah kisah mendebarkan tentang korupsi dan penyamaran yang berlatar belakang Mesir di bawah Hosni Mubarak. Apa yang membuat langkah berani ini lebih luar biasa? Mourad pada masa yang sama adalah juru foto peribadi Mubarak, menghabiskan waktu siangnya merekam citra presiden sambil menulis kritikan pedas terhadap rejimnya di malam hari. 'Saya bersama Mubarak di pagi hari,' kenang Mourad, 'dan menulis menentangnya di malam hari.' Dia mengakui itu adalah keputusan paling berisiko dalam hidupnya, tetapi satu yang tidak bisa dia abaikan. 'Jika sesuatu terjadi pada saya,' katanya, 'itu sudah ditakdirkan.' Sepanjang pemberontakan 2011 yang menjatuhkan Mubarak selepas 18 hari tegang, Mourad tetap berada di sisi presiden — tidak mampu menyertai orang ramai di Lapangan Tahrir, walaupun sangat terkesan. Dia menggambarkan minggu-minggu itu sebagai 'mengerikan,' tetapi enggan memberi butiran, menjanjikan untuk menceritakan keseluruhan kisahnya dalam memoar suatu hari nanti. Mubarak, yang kini diadili atas dakwaan secara tidak sah mengarahkan pembunuhan pengunjuk rasa dan penyelewengan dana, membantah semua tuduhan itu. Mourad percaya ia memerlukan keberanian sejati untuk menulis tentang rejim semasa ia masih berkuasa — tetapi kini rejim telah jatuh, tindakan itu terasa hampir selamat. Namun, dia menunggu masa yang tepat. 'Apabila segalanya tenang,' katanya, 'saya akan tulis apa yang saya lihat: yang baik, yang buruk, sisi manusiawinya. Tiada siapa itu benar-benar jahat.' Dia ingat bagaimana Mubarak bermula sebagai pemimpin yang berusaha melayani, tetapi dalam dekad terakhirnya, menjadi lengah, terobsesi dengan keselesaan dan kuasa — menjadi, dalam perkataan Mourad, 'seorang patung jerami, bukan seorang presiden.' 'Vertigo,' yang menjual lebih daripada 11,000 salinan di Mesir, mengikuti seorang juru foto masyarakat yang terperangkap dalam pembunuhan beramai-ramai di kelab malam dan ketiadaan suara yang dipaksakan oleh kuasa. Penerbit bahasa Inggerisnya menyebutnya sebagai ungkapan gelap di balik kehidupan di Mesir era Mubarak. Mourad mengikuti novel ini dengan karya politik kedua — kini sedang diadaptasi menjadi filem — tetapi projek seterusnya akan berpindah dari tema korupsi. Hari ini, Mourad masih memegang jawatan rasmi kerajaan, menunggu presiden baru tiba. Dia tidak percaya sistem itu mati bersama Mubarak. 'Korupsi tidak pergi bersamanya,' katanya. 'Ia masih ada — di dalam kita semua. Kita telah menghapuskan seorang lelaki, tetapi bukan minda itu.' Dengan pemilihan parlimen Mesir sedang berlangsung dan pilihan raya presiden dijadualkan tahun depan, Mourad berharap pemimpin seterusnya tidak akan menjadi tokoh seperti dewa. 'Sejak zaman Firaun, setiap pemimpin telah diperlakukan seperti dewa,' katanya. 'Itu mesti berhenti. Presiden seterusnya tidak boleh melupakan Tahrir Square — atau apa yang berlaku kepada Mubarak.'

article_content: By Louise Eccles, Rebecca English, and Martin Robinson. Published: 12:22 EST, 12 February 2013. Updated: 09:33 EST, 13 February 2013. The Duke and Duchess of Cambridge faced renewed criticism over privacy after Italian and Australian magazines published photographs of a pregnant Kate in a bikini. Numerous global publishers are preparing to release similar images. Palace sources denounced the images as a ‘violation’ of privacy. The photos, taken on the secluded Caribbean island of Mustique, show the couple walking along the beach during a private holiday. MailOnline reports that publishers in the United States, France, and Germany have acquired the photo set for more than £100,000 in total. Italian gossip magazine Chi—which previously caused outrage by publishing images of Princess Diana as she lay dying—ran the pictures prominently on its cover. Australian magazine Woman’s Day also published the photos, including images of Kate’s sister, Pippa, in a bikini, claiming they were captured by a tourist on a public beach. Woman’s Day editor Fiona Connolly defended the decision, stating: 'Kate is on a public beach, surrounded by other holidaymakers, and she looks fabulous. We don’t treat royals as a protected species here.' However, Mustique is a private island where paparazzi are officially banned. Its residents and visitors expect complete privacy. Kate, approximately four months pregnant, wears a bright blue halter-neck bikini with her growing bump clearly visible. Prince William, dressed in blue shorts and sunglasses, has an arm protectively around her back. Chi’s front-page headline reads: 'Kate and William — Honeymoon for Three.' St James’s Palace condemned the impending international publication as a 'clear breach of privacy.' Connolly contrasted the situation with last year’s invasive topless photos of Kate, stressing: 'There’s no photographer hiding in the bushes. She’s not in a private villa.' She added: 'In Australia, we see pregnant women in bikinis every day. Our readers will celebrate these images—they show Kate looking healthy and radiant, unlike the fragile woman we saw leaving hospital.' It remains unclear how much Woman’s Day paid for exclusive Australian rights, but Connolly claimed: 'Everyone but the UK has or will publish these pictures.' This is not the first time an Australian magazine has breached royal privacy. In 2008, New Idea revealed Prince Harry’s deployment to Afghanistan, endangering him. article_content: When you've swiped left on every potential soulmate on Tinder and exhausted your options on Happn, where do you turn? Maybe it's time to flirt with your opponent on a gaming app. That's exactly what Maria Jernslett, 22, and Erlend Finboe Svendsen did — meeting not on a dating app, but on Ruzzle, a competitive word puzzle game. The Norwegian couple first crossed paths in 2012 when they both selected 'play with a random player' at the exact same moment and were matched against each other. After two months of daily games, Erlend finally sent Maria a message: 'Take it easy.' It was the start of something more. What began as friendly banter about high scores quickly evolved into deep conversations about life, dreams, and personal struggles. 'We found comfort talking to a complete stranger,' Maria said. 'No one knew our real names — just our Ruzzle nicknames.' Despite being glued to their phones, they grew to miss each other between messages. In the summer of 2013, Erlend was invited to a music festival near Maria’s hometown in southern Norway. They decided to meet in person — and it was love at first sight. 'We talked all night,' Maria recalled. 'We’ve been together ever since.' Though they’ve lived apart — Maria studying in London, Erlend pursuing an MSc in Finance at Durham University — their bond has only strengthened. Both families agree they’re a perfect match and have urged them to marry. Now, the couple plans to move in together in London this May and tie the knot soon after. They’ve already shared unforgettable trips to Spain and Paris — milestones in a relationship that began with a simple tap on a smartphone screen.

article_content: Thames Water has ignited widespread anger after announcing it will not pay corporation tax for up to a decade. As Britain’s largest water supplier, the company has already faced criticism for accumulating over £1 billion in unpaid taxes. Despite reporting soaring profits—sales rose 8% to £976.5 million and pre-tax profits jumped 20% to £134.2 million between April and September—finance director Stuart Siddall stated, 'It will be seven to ten years until we pay tax.' The company’s tax deferral is enabled by government rules allowing deductions for major infrastructure investments, particularly its planned £4.2 billion super-sewer project beneath London. Last month, regulators at Ofwat rejected Thames Water’s proposed 8% bill increase, finding no justification for the hike. Critics have condemned the move. Labour’s Margaret Hodge, chair of the Commons Public Accounts Committee, called it 'deeply unfair,' stressing that Thames Water—owned by an Australian consortium—has an 'obligation to pay their fair share in tax.' Tax expert Richard Murphy, known for exposing Starbucks’ tax avoidance, warned, 'The reality is that much of this will never be paid. They are never going to stop spending on infrastructure, which means they will probably never pay tax.' In response, Thames Water said it will use any savings from capital allowances to support customers struggling to pay their bills.

Walaupun melaporkan keuntungan yang meningkat tajam—penjualan naik 8% kepada £976.5 juta dan keuntungan sebelum cukai meningkat 20% kepada £134.2 juta antara April dan September—pengarah kewangan Stuart Siddall menyatakan, 'Ia akan mengambil masa tujuh hingga sepuluh tahun sebelum kami membayar cukai.' Penangguhan cukai syarikat ini diizinkan oleh peraturan kerajaan yang membenarkan potongan untuk pelaburan infrastruktur utama, terutamanya projek 'super-sewer' £4.2 bilion di bawah London. Bulan lepas, penguasa di Ofwat menolak cadangan kenaikan 8% dalam bil Thames Water, mendapati tiada bukti yang mencukupi untuk kenaikan tersebut. Kritik telah dilontarkan terhadap langkah ini. Margaret Hodge dari Parti Buruh, ketua Jawatankuasa Perakaunan Awam Dewan Rakyat, memanggilnya 'tidak adil secara mendalam,' menekankan bahawa Thames Water—yang dimiliki oleh konsorsium Australia—mempunyai 'kewajiban untuk membayar bahagian yang adil dalam cukai.' Pakar cukai Richard Murphy, yang dikenali kerana mendedahkan penghindaran cukai oleh Starbucks, memperingatkan, 'Kenyataannya, sebahagian besar ini tidak akan pernah dibayar. Mereka tidak akan pernah berhenti membelanjakan wang untuk infrastruktur, yang bermakna mereka mungkin tidak akan pernah membayar cukai.' Sebagai respons, Thames Water berkata ia akan menggunakan sebarang simpanan daripada pemotongan modal untuk menyokong pelanggan yang mengalami kesukaran membayar bil mereka.

article_content: Business taxes in Britain will be the lowest in the G20 if the Conservatives win next year’s election, David Cameron pledged yesterday. In one of the most striking commitments of his final conference speech before voters head to the polls, the Prime Minister promised to keep corporation tax at the lowest level in the G20. Chancellor George Osborne has already reduced the main rate of corporation tax to 21%, down from 30% in 2007. He plans to cut it further to 20% next year — a move that would make Britain’s business tax rate lower than China’s, currently the lowest statutory rate among G20 nations. Rival European economies — particularly Germany and France — have watched with growing concern as Britain pursues a low-tax strategy to attract global investment. A survey earlier this year found that 63% of the 1,344 chief executives polled worldwide ranked government tax policy as a top consideration when deciding where to locate their businesses. Economists argue that Britain’s tax incentives are drawing larger international firms, boosting investment and safeguarding jobs. Mr. Cameron stated that the government’s long-term economic plan has enabled businesses to create thousands of decent jobs. 'Look how far we’ve come,' he told the conference. 'Today, there are 1.8 million more jobs in the UK than in 2010. We are creating more jobs in Britain than in the entire rest of Europe combined.' He added: 'When Britain is getting back to work, it can only mean one thing — the Conservatives are back in government.' Cameron vowed that a future Conservative government would ensure the highest employment rate of any major economy, so that 'all those who can work are able to work' — enabling families to provide for themselves and their children. He credited the government’s actions — cutting red tape and lowering taxes — for attracting global investment. 'Companies are coming from all over the world to invest and create jobs here. That’s not happened by accident.' Cameron made a direct appeal to multinational corporations: 'We have cut your taxes — now you must pay what you owe.' He announced new measures to prevent profit shifting and tax avoidance, targeting firms like Google and Starbucks. Simon Walker of the Institute of Directors praised the pledge but stressed that tax cuts must be paired with simplification of the tax code. 'Taxes must be simpler, as well as lower.' John Cridland of the CBI and Terry Scuoler of the EEF echoed support, calling the commitment a strong signal to businesses. Amid the economic messaging, Cameron emotionally honored his late son Ivan, who died in 2009 at age six, and paid tribute to 91-year-old D-Day veteran Patrick Churchill, who received a standing ovation from delegates.

Kanselir George Osborne telah mengurangkan kadar utama cukai korporat kepada 21%, turun daripada 30% pada 2007. Beliau merancang untuk mengurangkannya lagi kepada 20% tahun depan — langkah yang akan menjadikan kadar cukai perniagaan Britain lebih rendah daripada China, yang kini memiliki kadar cukai statutori paling rendah di kalangan negara-negara G20. Ekonomi pesaing di Eropah — terutamanya Jerman dan Perancis — telah memperhatikan dengan kebimbangan yang semakin meningkat kerana Britain mengejar strategi cukai rendah untuk menarik pelaburan global. Satu tinjauan awal tahun ini mendapati bahawa 63% daripada 1,344 pengarah eksekutif yang diundi secara sedunia menjadikan dasar cukai kerajaan sebagai pertimbangan utama apabila memutuskan di mana untuk meletakkan perniagaan mereka. Ekonom berpendapat bahawa insentif cukai Britain menarik syarikat antarabangsa yang lebih besar, meningkatkan pelaburan dan melindungi pekerjaan. Tuan Cameron menyatakan bahawa pelan ekonomi jangka panjang kerajaan telah membolehkan perniagaan mencipta ribuan pekerjaan yang layak. 'Lihat betapa jauh kita telah sampai,' katanya kepada konvensyen. 'Hari ini, terdapat 1.8 juta lebih banyak pekerjaan di UK berbanding tahun 2010. Kami sedang mencipta lebih banyak pekerjaan di Britain daripada keseluruhan Eropah digabungkan.' Beliau menambah: 'Apabila Britain kembali bekerja, ia hanya bermaksud satu perkara — Konservatif kembali berkuasa.' Cameron berjanji bahawa kerajaan Konservatif akan memastikan kadar pekerjaan tertinggi di mana-mana ekonomi utama, supaya 'semua yang boleh bekerja dapat bekerja' — membolehkan keluarga memberi nafkah kepada diri mereka sendiri dan anak-anak mereka. Beliau mengaitkan tindakan kerajaan — mengurangkan peraturan dan menurunkan cukai — dengan penarikan pelaburan global. 'Syarikat-syarikat datang dari seluruh dunia untuk melabur dan mencipta pekerjaan di sini. Ini bukan berlaku secara kebetulan.' Cameron membuat seruan langsung kepada syarikat-syarikat multinational: 'Kami telah menurunkan cukai anda — sekarang anda harus membayar apa yang anda wajib bayar.' Beliau mengumumkan langkah-langkah baru untuk mencegah pemindahan untung dan pengelakan cukai, menargetkan syarikat-syarikat seperti Google dan Starbucks. Simon Walker dari Institut Pengarah memuji komitmen itu tetapi menekankan bahawa potongan cukai mesti disertai dengan penyederhanaan kod cukai. 'Cukai mesti lebih ringkas, selain lebih rendah.' John Cridland dari CBI dan Terry Scuoler dari EEF menyokong komitmen itu, memanggilnya isyarat positif yang jelas kepada perniagaan. Di tengah-tengah mesej ekonomi, Cameron secara emosional menghormati anak lelakinya yang telah meninggal, Ivan, yang meninggal pada tahun 2009 pada usia enam tahun, dan menghormati veteran Perang Dunia II, Patrick Churchill, yang berusia 91 tahun, dan menerima tepukan meriah daripada peserta.

article_content: Maj. Gen. Abdul-Aziz Jassem al-Shallal, head of Syria’s military police, has defected from President Bashar Assad’s regime and publicly joined the opposition uprising. In a video broadcast on Al Arabiya TV, he declared his support for 'the people’s revolution,' becoming one of the highest-ranking officials to switch sides during the 21-month conflict. Al-Shallal condemned the Syrian military, stating it had abandoned its duty to protect citizens and instead become 'a gang for killing and destruction.' He accused the armed forces of destroying cities and villages and committing massacres against unarmed civilians protesting for freedom. His defection comes as rebel forces gain ground, capturing government bases near Damascus and other regions. Meanwhile, civilian casualties continue to mount. Reports indicate that government shelling in northeastern Syria killed at least 20 people, including women and up to eight children. Thousands of Syrian soldiers have defected since the conflict began, many citing attacks on civilians as their motivation. The uprising, which started as peaceful demands for reform, has since escalated into a brutal civil war. Anti-regime activists estimate more than 40,000 people have been killed over the past 21 months.

article_content: Kevin Jones is the kind of dad you really don’t want to cross. The father from Louisville, Kentucky, was stunned to discover his 10-year-old daughter had been secretly lying about her age online. Despite being only 5 feet 11 inches tall and just 10 years old, the girl — unnamed by The Mail Online — appeared far more mature than her years and had created social media profiles posing as a 15-year-old, even claiming to have a boyfriend. Upon learning the truth, Jones decided to teach her a lesson — one that would be seen by many. He dressed her in a pink outfit, placed barrettes and bows in her hair, gave her a child’s princess backpack, and had her wear a shirt that read: 'I am 10 years old.' He posted photos of the outfit on Facebook with the caption: 'She claims to be in love and going out with a boyfriend — which is completely against my rules!!! I uncovered that she’s been doing this for quite some time. Here’s the consequence behind her actions.' The post, published on October 21, quickly went viral, amassing nearly 250,000 likes and over 77,000 shares. Many parents applauded Jones, calling him a strong and responsible father. One commenter wrote: 'You did the right thing. I bet she got in line real quick. Keep it up. You’re an awesome dad. She’ll thank you later when she’s not pregnant at 12 and has a fighting chance in this world.' article_content: CNN — Mississippi's governor declared a state of emergency on Thursday for 12 counties after a severe weather system swept across the southern half of the state overnight Wednesday and Thursday. The storms, which included two confirmed tornadoes, damaged at least 108 homes and injured 24 people, according to the Mississippi Emergency Management Agency's Emergency Operations Center. Simpson County, about 40 miles southeast of Jackson, was hit hardest. A tornado touched down there around 4 a.m. Thursday, said Katherine Gunby, a spokeswoman for the agency. Sixty homes were damaged and 20 people were injured in the county. Seventeen individuals were treated at local hospitals, and three were transported to the University of Mississippi Medical Center in Jackson. Condition reports for the injured were not immediately available. Another tornado was reported in Lauderdale County in eastern Mississippi, where one business was destroyed and 11 homes and one business were damaged, according to the agency. The state of emergency declared by Governor Haley Barbour 'will allow state resources to be deployed throughout the affected areas to assist local governments as they respond to this disaster,' said Mike Womack, director of the Emergency Management Agency, in a written statement. Damage to homes was also reported in Jasper, Jones, and Lawrence counties. Power lines and trees were downed in Adams, Amite, Lincoln, and Madison counties. Three injuries were reported in Jones County and one in Jasper County, though no further details were provided. The tornadoes destroyed Corinth Baptist Church in Simpson County, leaving only its doors standing. 'The church means so much to this community,' Pastor Jay Westbrooks told CNN affiliate WAPT. 'We're going to survive. The building is destroyed, but the church is alive. We're going to come back and rebuild. The weather's not going to stop us.' The Mississippi Department of Transportation and utility companies are working to restore power, Gunby said. Although the state of emergency was initially declared for nine counties, it will be extended to any additional counties that report damage, the agency said.

Ribut-ribut tersebut, yang termasuk dua tornado yang disahkan, merosakkan sekurang-kurangnya 108 rumah dan melukakan 24 orang, menurut Pusat Operasi Keadaan Kecemasan Agensi Pengurusan Keadaan Kecemasan Mississippi. Daerah Simpson, sejauh kira-kira 40 batu di tenggara Jackson, adalah yang paling teruk terkesan. Sebuah tornado menyentuh bumi di sana sekitar jam 4 pagi Khamis, kata Katherine Gunby, jurucakap agensi itu. Enam puluh rumah rosak dan 20 orang cedera di daerah itu. Tujuh belas orang dirawat di hospital tempatan, dan tiga orang dihantar ke Pusat Perubatan Universiti Mississippi di Jackson. Laporan keadaan pesakit tidak tersedia segera. Tornado lain dilaporkan berlaku di Daerah Lauderdale di timur Mississippi, di mana satu pejabat hancur dan 11 rumah serta satu pejabat rosak, menurut agensi itu. 'Kekeliruan kecemasan' telah diperbaiki menjadi 'keadaan kecemasan' — kesalahan terjemahan. 'Kekeliruan' bererti 'confusion', bukan 'emergency'. Koreksi: 'Keadaan kecemasan yang dideklarasikan oleh Gabenor Haley Barbour akan membenarkan sumber negara digunakan di seluruh kawasan yang terkesan bagi membantu kerajaan tempatan dalam merespon bencana ini,' kata Mike Womack, pengarah Agensi Pengurusan Keadaan Kecemasan, dalam pernyataan bertulis. Kerosakan kepada rumah juga dilaporkan di daerah Jasper, Jones, dan Lawrence. Saluran kuasa dan pokok-pokok tumbang di daerah Adams, Amite, Lincoln, dan Madison. Tiga kes cedera dilaporkan di Daerah Jones dan satu di Jasper, tetapi tiada butiran lanjut diberikan. Tornado-tornado itu menghancurkan Gereja Baptis Corinth di Simpson County, meninggalkan hanya pintu-pintunya berdiri. 'Gereja ini sangat bermakna kepada komuniti ini,' kata Pendeta Jay Westbrooks kepada WAPT, afiliasi CNN. 'Kami akan bertahan. Bangunan ini rosak, tetapi gereja masih hidup. Kami akan kembali dan membangunkannya semula. Cuaca tidak akan menghentikan kami.' Jabatan Pengangkutan Mississippi dan syarikat-syarikat utiliti sedang bekerja untuk memulihkan kuasa, kata Gunby. Walaupun keadaan kecemasan awalnya dideklarasikan untuk sembilan daerah, ia akan diperluaskan kepada mana-mana daerah tambahan yang melaporkan kerosakan, kata agensi itu.

article_content: In a landmark moment for Georgia’s democracy, power is transitioning peacefully through elections — the first time since independence that this has happened without unrest. President Mikheil Saakashvili, who rose to fame during the 2003 Rose Revolution, publicly acknowledged defeat after preliminary results showed the Georgian Dream coalition leading. In a televised address, he pledged to respect the outcome, even as his decade-long rule came to an end under the weight of mounting criticism over authoritarian practices and shocking revelations of abuse in Georgian prisons. His popularity, once strong, has eroded significantly. The incoming prime minister, Bidzina Ivanishvili, is a self-made billionaire whose fortune was built in Russia during the 1990s through investments in mining, banking, and real estate. Born in rural western Georgia, Ivanishvili is now among the world’s wealthiest individuals, with assets exceeding half of Georgia’s entire GDP. Known for his unconventional lifestyle, he owns a private zoo featuring penguins and a zebra, and maintains a multi-million-dollar art collection — including pieces by Picasso and Lichtenstein — stored in London vaults, while displaying faithful replicas in his futuristic Tbilisi mansion. During the campaign, opponents accused Ivanishvili of seeking to realign Georgia with Russia and abandon Western partnerships. He firmly rejected these claims, telling CNN that his goal is simply to mend broken ties with Moscow — not to reject Europe or NATO. 'We must show Russia that our path toward NATO and the EU doesn’t threaten its interests,' he said. Russia, which still occupies two Georgian regions, stayed silent throughout the vote but later, Prime Minister Dmitry Medvedev suggested the new political landscape could bring more responsible leadership. If this shift leads to improved relations without undoing Georgia’s democratic gains, it may truly mark a turning point in the nation’s history.

Presiden Mikheil Saakashvili, yang naik ke kuasa semasa Revolusi Mawar 2003, mengakui kekalahan secara awam selepas keputusan awal menunjukkan koalisi Georgian Dream memimpin. Dalam ucapan di televisyen nasional, beliau berjanji menghormati hasil tersebut, walaupun kerajaannya selama satu dekad berakhir di bawah tekanan kritikan terhadap amalan autoritarian dan penemuan mengerikan mengenai penyalahgunaan di penjara Georgia. Popularitinya, yang dahulunya kuat, telah menurun ketara. Perdana Menteri baru, Bidzina Ivanishvili, adalah miliardir autodidak yang membangunkan kekayaannya di Rusia pada tahun 1990-an melalui pelaburan dalam perlombongan, perbankan, dan hartanah. Dilahirkan di kawasan pedesaan barat Georgia, Ivanishvili kini termasuk antara individu terkaya di dunia, dengan aset melebihi separuh daripada keseluruhan PDB Georgia. Dikenali dengan gaya hidupnya yang tidak biasa, beliau memiliki kebun binatang peribadi yang mempunyai penguin dan zebra, serta koleksi seni bernilai jutaan dolar — termasuk karya oleh Picasso dan Lichtenstein — yang disimpan di brankas London, sementara replika tepat dipamerkan di istana kaca futuristiknya di Tbilisi. Semasa kempen, lawan-lawannya menuduh Ivanishvili ingin mengembalikan Georgia ke lingkungan pengaruh Rusia dan meninggalkan perkongsian Barat. Beliau menolak tegas dakwaan itu, memberitahu CNN bahawa matlamatnya hanyalah memperbaiki hubungan yang retak dengan Moskow — bukan menolak Eropah atau NATO. 'Kita perlu menunjukkan kepada Rusia bahawa jalan kita ke arah NATO dan EU tidak mengancam kepentingannya,' katanya. Rusia, yang masih menduduki dua wilayah Georgia, tetap diam sepanjang pilihan raya tetapi kemudian, Perdana Menteri Dmitry Medvedev mencadangkan bahawa lanskap politik baru boleh membawa kepimpinan yang lebih bertanggungjawab. Jika perubahan ini membawa kepada peningkatan hubungan tanpa membatalkan pencapaian demokrasi Georgia, ia mungkin benar-benar menandakan titik balik dalam sejarah negara itu.

article_content: (Real Simple) — Use this handy seasonal shopping calendar, curated by consumer and retail experts, to plan your holiday purchases wisely. October 28 to November 9: Around Halloween, some retailers promote 'early Black Friday' sales featuring select 'doorbusters'—such as off-brand electronics discounted by roughly 30%. But don’t get too excited. According to Brad Wilson, founder of BradsDeals.com, these are often just standard weekly promotions repackaged for the holiday season. Real Simple: 34 Stocking Stuffers Under $30 — Only buy if the item is discounted by at least 20% AND you were already planning to purchase it. Check Sunday newspaper ads or retailer websites for details, but wait until the following Monday to buy online. Competitors may have matched—or even undercut—the prices by then. Real Simple: One-Day Holiday Shopping Plan November 25 to 27: Black Friday remains the busiest day for brick-and-mortar stores, though major online retailers like Amazon.com host extended weekend events with 'lightning deals'—short-term price drops. Last year, a $230 video camera dropped to $110. These deals often disappear within hours or sell out completely, so monitor homepage announcements closely. Real Simple: Inexpensive Ideas for Holiday Party Food November 28: Cyber Monday lives up to its hype. This is the prime day for sweeping online discounts across nearly all categories. From budget to luxury brands, retailers offer broad promotions—not just on specific items. According to Dan de Grandpre, CEO of DealNews.com, expect sitewide discounts of 30% to 40%. Last year, BananaRepublic.com offered 15% off everything; UrbanOutfitters.com slashed 40% off men’s and women’s outerwear. Other participants included Old Navy, Kate Spade New York, Nordstrom, Lord & Taylor, and Barneys New York. Real Simple: How to Make the Holidays More Affordable December 21 to 24: This is the ideal window to buy high-ticket items like televisions, furniture, and fine jewelry. As Christmas approaches, unsold premium goods are heavily discounted—but inventory dwindles rapidly. Remember: Even great deals may come with expensive overnight or two-day shipping fees that erode your savings. For in-store shoppers, review these Christmas shopping tips before heading to the mall. article_content: In a rare and dramatic encounter captured in snowy Hokkaido, Japan, a white-tailed eagle tried to snatch food from a group of Japanese red-crowned cranes — and ended up fleeing in defeat. The cranes, normally hunted by raptors, had gathered to scavenge what little food remained after heavy snowfall buried their usual sources like berries and fish. Surrounded by a blanket of white, their bright crimson head plumage stood out sharply against the winter landscape. When the eagle swooped in, expecting an easy meal, it was met with fierce resistance from the outnumbered but determined cranes. The bird of prey made several attempts to steal food, but each time, the cranes stood their ground, flapping wings and lunging in unison. After a tense mid-air clash with one of the cranes, the eagle gave up and flew off, clearly outmatched. Amateur photographer Masatsugu Ohashi, 41, who has been photographing wildlife for eight years, witnessed the entire event. He described the cranes’ behavior as unexpectedly courageous, noting that eagles usually dominate such encounters. 'It was thrilling to see them fight back,' he said. 'For once, the prey won.'

Burung-burung crane, yang biasanya menjadi mangsa raptor, telah berkumpul untuk mengutip sisa makanan yang tinggal selepas hujan salji tebal menutupi sumber makanan biasa mereka seperti buah-buahan dan ikan. Dikelilingi oleh sejubah putih, bulu merah cerah di kepala mereka menonjol dengan jelas terhadap lanskap musim sejuk. Apabila helang itu melayap masuk, mengharapkan hidangan mudah, ia disambut dengan perlawanan sengit daripada burung-burung crane yang lebih sedikit bilangannya tetapi penuh keteguhan. Selepas pertembungan udara yang tegang dengan salah satu burung crane, helang itu menyerah dan terbang pergi, jelas kalah. article_content: The solar-powered plane set to attempt a round-the-world flight without fuel next year has been unveiled. Pilots Bertrand Piccard and André Borschberg said Solar Impulse 2 represents a dramatic improvement over the single-seater prototype that first flew five years ago. They claim the technology has advanced enough that the new design could theoretically remain airborne indefinitely. With a wingspan of 72 meters (236 feet), it is eight meters longer than the first prototype — even longer than the wings of a Boeing 747 jumbo jet — yet it weighs only 2.3 metric tons (2.54 tons), about the same as a large car. Its massive wings are covered with 7,200 solar cells that charge batteries during the day, enabling flight through the night. The updated plane was revealed at the Payerne Air Force Base in Switzerland. It features enhanced batteries to store energy absorbed by the solar cells, lighter materials, more efficient electric motors, and what Borschberg described as a 'business-class seat' for pilot comfort. Although the journey will be divided into several stages, the aircraft’s slow speed requires multi-day flights over oceans, meaning the pilot must endure extended periods in the air. More than 80 companies contributed cutting-edge technologies to the project, aiming to showcase the potential of clean energy solutions. Borschberg estimated the circumnavigation would take approximately 20 flying days, spread over several months. Solar Impulse is the result of a partnership between Piccard, a psychiatrist and explorer who secured funding and promoted clean tech, and Borschberg, an engineer and entrepreneur who led the technical team of 80. After 12 years of calculations, simulations, construction, and testing, Solar Impulse 2 is poised to become the first aircraft to fly around the world using only solar power. The planned journey, starting in March 2015 from the Gulf region, will cross the Arabian Sea, India, Burma, China, the Pacific Ocean, the United States, the Atlantic Ocean, and Southern Europe or North Africa before returning to the departure point. Landings will occur every few days to rotate pilots and host public events for governments, schools, and universities. 'A vision counts for nothing unless it is backed up by action,' said Bertrand Piccard, founder and chairman of Solar Impulse. 'With eight world records set by Solar Impulse 1 — the first solar aircraft to fly at night, cross two continents, and traverse the United States — we proved clean technologies can achieve the impossible.' 'Now we need to go further,' added André Borschberg, co-founder and CEO. 'Solar Impulse 2 has virtually unlimited autonomy. But we must also ensure the pilot is as sustainable as the aircraft. This journey is as much a human feat as a technological one.' To complete the flight, Solar Impulse 2 must fly nonstop for five consecutive days and nights over oceans — a first for any aircraft. The cockpit measures 3.8 cubic meters and is designed for a pilot to live in for up to a week. However, for maximum energy efficiency, it is neither pressurized nor heated — adding a significant endurance challenge.
translated_content: Pesawat bertenaga surya yang akan cuba penerbangan mengelilingi dunia tanpa bahan bakar tahun depan telah dilancarkan. Pilot-pilot Bertrand Piccard dan André Borschberg mengatakan Solar Impulse 2 merupakan peningkatan besar berbanding prototaip pesawat satu tempat duduk yang pertama kali terbang lima tahun lalu. Mereka mengklaim teknologi ini telah maju cukup jauh sehingga reka bentuk baharu ini boleh secara teori terbang tanpa henti. Dengan rentang sayap 72 meter (236 kaki), ia 8 meter lebih panjang daripada prototaip pertama — lebih panjang lagi daripada sayap pesawat Boeing 747 — tetapi hanya berat 2.3 tan metrik (2.54 tan), sama dengan kereta besar. Sayapnya yang besar ditutupi dengan 7,200 sel surya yang mengisi bateri semasa siang hari, membolehkan penerbangan semalaman. Pesawat yang dikemaskini ini diperkenalkan di Pangkalan Tentera Udara Payerne di Switzerland. Ia memiliki bateri yang ditingkatkan untuk menyimpan tenaga yang diserap oleh sel surya, bahan yang lebih ringan, motor elektrik yang lebih cekap, dan apa yang Borschberg gambarkan sebagai 'tempat duduk kelas perniagaan' untuk keselesaan pilot. Walaupun perjalanan ini akan dibahagikan kepada beberapa peringkat, kelajuan perlahan pesawat ini memerlukan penerbangan berterusan selama beberapa hari di atas lautan, bermakna pilot perlu menanggung tempoh yang panjang di udara. Lebih daripada 80 syarikat menyumbangkan teknologi canggih kepada projek ini, bertujuan untuk memperlihatkan potensi penyelesaian tenaga bersih. Borschberg menganggarkan penerbangan mengelilingi dunia akan mengambil kira-kira 20 hari penerbangan, tersebar dalam beberapa bulan. Solar Impulse adalah hasil kerjasama antara Piccard, seorang psikiatri dan penjelajah yang mendapatkan pendanaan dan mempromosikan teknologi bersih, dan Borschberg, seorang jurutera dan usahawan yang memimpin pasukan teknikal 80 orang. Selepas 12 tahun pengiraan, simulasi, pembinaan, dan ujian, Solar Impulse 2 sedang bersiap menjadi pesawat pertama yang boleh terbang mengelilingi dunia menggunakan hanya tenaga surya. Perjalanan yang dirancang, bermula pada Mac 2015 dari kawasan Teluk, akan melintasi Laut Arab, India, Burma, China, Samudra Pasifik, Amerika Syarikat, Samudra Atlantik, dan Eropah Selatan atau Afrika Utara sebelum kembali ke titik keberangkatan. Pendaratan akan berlaku setiap beberapa hari untuk mengganti pilot dan mengadakan acara awam untuk kerajaan, sekolah, dan universiti. 'Visi tidak bermakna apa-apa jika tidak disokong oleh tindakan,' kata Bertrand Piccard, penemu dan ketua Solar Impulse. 'Dengan lapan rekod dunia yang dicatat oleh Solar Impulse 1 — pesawat solar pertama yang boleh terbang semalaman, melintasi dua benua, dan menyeberangi Amerika Syarikat — kami membuktikan teknologi bersih boleh mencapai yang mustahil.' 'Sekarang kita perlu melangkah lebih jauh,' tambah André Borschberg, penemu bersama dan CEO. 'Solar Impulse 2 mempunyai autonomi yang hampir tanpa had. Tetapi kita juga perlu memastikan pilot sama sustain seperti pesawatnya. Perjalanan ini adalah pencapaian manusia sekaligus teknologi.' Untuk menyelesaikan penerbangan, Solar Impulse 2 perlu terbang tanpa henti selama lima hari dan malam berturut-turut di atas lautan — pencapaian pertama bagi mana-mana pesawat. Kokpitnya berukuran 3.8 meter padu dan direka untuk pilot tinggal selama sehingga seminggu. Namun, demi kecekapan tenaga maksimum, kokpit tersebut tidak ditekan atau dipanaskan — menambah cabaran ketahanan yang signifikan.
