article_content: In Tel Aviv, Israel, a daughter’s well-intentioned gift turned into an unimaginable loss. Annat — who chose to withhold her full name — surprised her elderly mother by replacing her decades-old, tattered mattress with a brand-new one. What she didn’t know was that her mother had spent years secretly stashing nearly $1 million in cash inside the worn-out bed. The next morning, after the old mattress was hauled away with the trash, the mother revealed the truth. By then, the garbage truck had already taken it to one of Tel Aviv’s two major landfills. Annat immediately alerted authorities, sparking a frantic search. Dump site manager Yitchak Burba confirmed that his team is working nonstop to sift through tons of waste in hopes of recovering the mattress. The story, widely covered by Israeli media, attracted hundreds of treasure hunters, prompting increased security at the sites. Despite the staggering loss, both women responded with extraordinary calm. Annat’s mother told her, 'Leave it. The heart is crying, but we could have been in a car accident or diagnosed with a terminal illness.' Annat echoed this sentiment, saying, 'It’s a very sad story, but I’ve been through worse. Life is about accepting both the good and the bad.'

Yang tidak diketahuinya, ibunya telah menyimpan hampir $1 juta dalam bentuk uang tunai di dalam kasur tua itu selama bertahun-tahun. Keesokan harinya, setelah kasur lama dibuang bersama sampah, ibunya mengungkapkan kebenarannya. Pada saat itu, truk sampah sudah membawanya ke salah satu dari dua tempat pembuangan akhir utama di Tel Aviv. Annat langsung melaporkan ke pihak berwenang, memicu pencarian gencar. Manajer tempat pembuangan akhir, Yitchak Burba, memastikan timnya bekerja tanpa henti untuk menyaring ton sampah demi mencoba memulihkan kasur itu. Cerita ini, yang banyak diliput media Israel, menarik ratusan pencari harta karun, sehingga keamanan diperketat di lokasi tersebut. Meskipun kehilangan itu sangat besar, kedua wanita itu merespons dengan ketenangan luar biasa. Ibunya Annat berkata padanya, 'Biarkan saja. Hati sedih, tapi kita bisa saja mengalami kecelakaan mobil atau didiagnosis menderita penyakit mematikan.' Annat menanggapi dengan sikap yang sama, 'Ini kisah yang sangat sedih, tapi saya sudah melewati hal yang lebih buruk. Hidup adalah tentang menerima hal baik dan buruk.'

article_content: Miley Cyrus isn’t changing who she is—she’s simply becoming more herself. What many called a dramatic shift after her 2013 VMA performance was, to her, just a natural evolution. In a new MTV documentary, 'Miley: The Movement,' viewers get an intimate look at her life over four months, from backstage laughter with her mom to unexpected reunions with pop icons like Britney Spears. Far from being a chaotic rebellion, Cyrus describes her actions as carefully crafted moments designed to reflect her truth. She admits to moments of doubt, especially after releasing 'We Can't Stop,' wondering if anyone would even notice. But she pushed forward anyway—and the song reached No. 1. Her mother, Tish, is her anchor. Whether it’s pre-show nerves or media scrutiny, Tish is always there—not as a manager, but as a mom who shares every high and low. 'If I win, she wins,' Miley says. Pharrell Williams, who encouraged her to cut her hair, reminds us that Miley didn’t emerge from a vacuum. Raised by Billy Ray, influenced by Dolly Parton, and immersed in hip-hop culture, her expression is a mirror of America itself. When her VMA entrance fell apart, she was devastated—not because she’s dramatic, but because every detail matters to her. 'If I’m going to do it,' she says, 'it has to be unforgettable.' The documentary doesn’t answer everything: where was her dad? Her ex? The role of producer Mike Will Made It? But it does show a young woman owning her journey—messy, bold, and brilliantly intentional.

Dalam dokumentari MTV baharu, 'Miley: The Movement', penonton mendapat pandangan rapat tentang kehidupannya selama empat bulan, dari ketawa di belakang tabir bersama ibunya hingga pertemuan tak disangka dengan ikon pop seperti Britney Spears. Jauh daripada pemberontakan kacau, Cyrus menggambarkan tindakannya sebagai momen-momen yang dirancang teliti untuk mencerminkan kebenaran dirinya. Dia mengaku pernah meragui diri, terutamanya setelah merilis lagu 'We Can't Stop', bertanya sama ada ada orang yang akan memperhatikan. Tetapi dia terus maju—dan lagu itu mencapai tangga nombor satu. Ibunya, Tish, adalah sandaran utamanya. Sama ada gugup sebelum pentas atau tekanan media, Tish sentiasa di sana—bukan sebagai pengurus, tetapi sebagai ibu yang berkongsi setiap kemenangan dan kegagalan. 'Jika saya menang, dia juga menang,' kata Miley. Pharrell Williams, yang menyarankan agar dia memotong rambutnya, mengingatkan kita bahawa Miley tidak muncul secara tiba-tiba. Dibesarkan oleh Billy Ray, dipengaruhi oleh Dolly Parton, dan tenggelam dalam budaya hip-hop, ekspresinya adalah cerminan Amerika itu sendiri. Apabila perkenalan di VMA gagal, dia sedih—bukan kerana dia dramatik, tetapi kerana setiap butiran penting baginya. 'Jika saya hendak melakukannya,' katanya, 'ia mesti tak terlupakan.' Dokumentari ini tidak menjawab semua soalan: di mana ayahnya? Bekas tunangnya? Peranan penghasil Mike Will Made It? Tetapi ia menunjukkan seorang wanita muda yang mengambil alih perjalanannya—kacau, berani, dan sangat tersengaja.

article_content: Washington (CNN) — President Barack Obama and his family attended Easter Sunday worship at Shiloh Baptist Church, a congregation founded by freed slaves in 1863. Upon entering, the First Family received a standing ovation from the congregation. They joined in singing with the choir, accompanied by a live band featuring guitar, keyboard, and drums. Reverend Wallace Charles Smith greeted the Obamas and shared that the congregation prays for them each Sunday. During the offering, President Obama and his daughters placed donations in envelopes provided at their seats. After a two-hour service, the First Family departed as the service drew to a close. Since moving into the White House in January 2009, the Obamas have occasionally attended church services. Last Easter, they worshipped at a Methodist church.

article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) — A former CIA director criticized President Obama on Sunday for releasing four Bush-era memos detailing interrogation techniques, arguing the move compromised national security. Michael Hayden, who served as CIA director under President George W. Bush from 2006 to 2009, said publicly disclosing the memos provided terrorist organizations like al-Qaeda with valuable insight into the limits of U.S. interrogation methods. 'What we have described for our enemies in the midst of a war are the outer limits that any American would ever go to in interrogating an al-Qaeda terrorist. That’s very valuable information,' Hayden said during an appearance on Fox News Sunday. 'By taking certain techniques off the table, we’ve made it harder — in countless scenarios I can imagine — for CIA officers to defend the nation,' he added. However, Senators Claire McCaskill (D-Missouri) and Lindsey Graham (R-South Carolina) argued that such techniques should never have been permitted in the first place. McCaskill called them 'a powerful recruitment tool for those who seek to harm our country.' White House Chief of Staff Rahm Emanuel dismissed Hayden’s claim that the release gave al-Qaeda new intelligence, noting, 'One reason the president decided to release this information is because it was already public.' 'Go get the New York Review of Books — it’s there,' Emanuel said on ABC’s This Week. Hayden said he contacted senior White House officials to voice his objections before the memos were released. He also noted that four former CIA directors and current Director Leon Panetta opposed the disclosure. The memos concluded that tactics such as waterboarding, sleep deprivation, and slapping did not constitute torture unless intended to cause severe pain. Shortly after taking office in January 2009, Obama banned the use of these 'enhanced interrogation techniques,' stating they 'undermine our moral authority and do not make us safer.' The Obama administration has pledged not to prosecute CIA officers who carried out these methods, and Emanuel added that those who crafted the policy 'should not be prosecuted either.' In a sharp editorial, The New York Times called for the impeachment of Jay Bybee, a federal appeals court judge who authored one of the memos while serving in the Justice Department. 'These memos make it clear that Mr. Bybee is unfit for a job that requires legal judgment and a respect for the Constitution,' the paper stated, adding that the memos were written to grant legal immunity for acts that were clearly illegal, immoral, and contrary to America’s foundational values. When asked about the impeachment call on Fox News Sunday, McCaskill said, 'I think we have to look at it.' She supported not prosecuting CIA officers but expressed concern about Bybee still serving on the federal bench. Graham, however, warned that prosecuting lawyers for providing legal advice — even if flawed — sets a dangerous precedent. 'It would be a disaster to go back and try to prosecute a lawyer for giving legal advice that you disagreed with to a former president,' Graham said. Hayden warned that releasing the memos erodes the legal foundation of CIA operations, shifting legitimacy from law to politics, which could cause officers to hesitate in carrying out vital missions. 'The really dangerous effect is that you’ll have agency officers stepping back from the kinds of things the nation expects them to do... You’re going to have this agency — on the front line of defending you — pulling back from the line,' he said. Hayden maintained that the techniques yielded critical intelligence and improved national security, predicting the memo release would trigger further investigations and disclosures. McCaskill countered that banning such methods will ultimately strengthen the U.S. reputation. Graham agreed that permitting enhanced interrogation was a mistake, adding, 'I always thought waterboarding would come back to haunt the country — and quite frankly, it has.'

Michael Hayden, yang berkhidmat sebagai ketua CIA di bawah Presiden George W. Bush dari 2006 hingga 2009, berkata bahawa pengumuman terbuka memorandum itu memberikan organisasi teroris seperti al-Qaeda wawasan berharga mengenai had-had kaedah interogasi AS. 'Apakah yang kami huraikan kepada musuh kami di tengah-tengah peperangan adalah had luar yang mana seorang Amerika sekalipun akan lakukan dalam interogasi seorang teroris al-Qaeda. Ini adalah maklumat yang sangat berharga,' kata Hayden semasa penampilannya di Fox News Sunday. 'Dengan mengeluarkan teknik tertentu daripada senarai, kami telah membuatnya lebih sukar — dalam pelbagai skenario yang saya bayangkan — bagi pegawai CIA untuk mempertahankan negara,' tambahnya. Namun, Senator Claire McCaskill (D-Missouri) dan Lindsey Graham (R-South Carolina) berpendapat bahawa teknik-teknik tersebut seharusnya tidak pernah dibenarkan sejak awal. McCaskill menyebutnya sebagai 'alat rekrutmen yang kuat bagi mereka yang ingin menyakiti negara kita.' Ketua Staf Putih Rahm Emanuel menolak dakwaan Hayden bahawa pembebasan itu memberi al-Qaeda maklumat baru, dengan mencatat, 'Satu sebab presiden memutuskan untuk membebaskan maklumat ini ialah kerana ia sudah awam.' 'Pergilah dapatkan New York Review of Books — ia ada di sana,' kata Emanuel di ABC’s This Week. Hayden berkata beliau menghubungi beberapa pejabat tinggi Putih untuk menyatakan keberatan sebelum memorandum itu dikeluarkan. Beliau juga mencatat bahawa empat bekas ketua CIA dan Ketua Semasa Leon Panetta menentang pembebasan tersebut. Memorandum-memorandum itu menyimpulkan bahawa taktik seperti penyiksaan air, kurang tidur, dan menampar tidak dianggap sebagai penyiksaan selagi tidak bertujuan menyebabkan kesakitan yang teruk. Segera selepas mengambil jawatan pada Januari 2009, Obama melarang penggunaan teknik 'interogasi diperkuat' ini, menyatakan bahawa ia 'melemahkan otoriti moral kita dan tidak menjadikan kita lebih selamat.' Pemerintahan Obama telah berjanji tidak akan menuntut kes terhadap pegawai CIA yang melaksanakan teknik-teknik ini, dan Emanuel menambah bahawa mereka yang merancang dasar itu 'juga tidak patut dituntut.' Dalam editorial tajam, New York Times menyerukan pemecatan Jay Bybee, seorang hakim mahkamah rayuan persekutuan yang menulis salah satu memorandum itu semasa berkhidmat di Jabatan Kehakiman. 'Memorandum-memorandum ini membuatkan jelas bahawa Tuan Bybee tidak layak untuk jawatan yang memerlukan penilaian undang-undang dan penghormatan terhadap Perlembagaan,' kata surat khabar itu, menambah bahawa memorandum-memorandum itu ditulis untuk memberi kekebalan undang-undang terhadap tindakan yang jelas-jelas haram, tidak bermoral, dan bertentangan dengan nilai asas negara kita. Semasa diminta pendapat mengenai seruan pemecatan itu di Fox News Sunday, McCaskill berkata, 'Saya rasa kita perlu tinjau perkara ini.' Beliau menyokong tidak menuntut pegawai CIA tetapi mengungkapkan keprihatinan tentang Bybee yang masih berada di mahkamah persekutuan. Namun, Graham memperingatkan bahawa menuntut peguam yang memberi nasihat undang-undang — walaupun salah — menetapkan preseden yang berbahaya. 'Ia akan menjadi bencana jika kita kembali dan cuba menuntut peguam kerana memberi nasihat undang-undang yang anda tidak setuju dengan presiden dahulu,' kata Graham. Hayden memperingatkan bahawa pembebasan memorandum itu melemahkan asas undang-undang operasi CIA, mengalihkan legitimasi dari undang-undang kepada politik, yang boleh menyebabkan pegawai enggan melaksanakan misi penting. 'Kesan yang benar-benar berbahaya ialah anda akan mendapat pegawai agensi mundur dari jenis-jenis tindakan yang negara harapkan mereka lakukan... Anda akan lihat agensi ini — di garisan depan mempertahankan anda — menarik diri dari garisan,' katanya. Hayden menegaskan bahawa teknik-teknik itu menghasilkan maklumat penting dan meningkatkan keselamatan negara, meramalkan bahawa pembebasan memorandum itu akan memicu penyiasatan dan pendedahan lanjut. McCaskill berlawan bahawa melarang teknik seperti ini akhirnya akan memperkuat reputasi AS. Graham bersetuju bahawa membenarkan interogasi diperkuat adalah kesilapan, menambah, 'Saya selalu fikir penyiksaan air akan kembali menghantui negara — dan sebenarnya, ia sudah melakukannya.'

article_content: Peter Moores was forced onto the defensive yesterday as he attempted to explain the all-too-familiar story of Australian domination over an England side led by a captain desperately struggling for form. On Saturday, England were transported back to their worst Ashes nightmare, outclassed by a rampant Australia at the start of the World Cup — yet again making last-minute changes. This time, Ravi Bopara was dropped at the eleventh hour from a squad that was supposed to have had maximum preparation time before challenging for their elusive first 50-over title. Australia’s Mitchell Marsh celebrated after dismissing England captain Eoin Morgan in their World Cup opener. England coach Peter Moores defended his players but acknowledged they must improve significantly. As a result, Gary Ballance returned for his first one-day international in six months, while James Taylor — who had impressed in both Sri Lanka and here before Christmas — was pushed down to No. 6. Chris Woakes, who dropped century-maker Aaron Finch in the first over at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, was further hampered by the decision to remove the new ball from him for only the second time in 16 ODIs. A thumping defeat at the hands of the favorites is far from fatal to England’s chances, but the apparent disarray in planning raised serious concerns. England are not meant to be experimenting now, especially after the Ashes were brought forward — to their considerable cost — to allow cohesive preparation ahead of their 11th attempt to win a World Cup. Yet Moores passionately denied that England panicked ahead of their high-stakes Valentine’s Day clash with the hosts, while also backing Morgan to emerge from a woeful run threatening to undermine his authority. 'It’s a red herring,' Moores said when asked if late changes unsettled the team before the 111-run defeat. 'I can categorically say no. You don’t drop a catch because you think you should open the bowling. Both Gary and James are versatile — they can bat at three or six, and James was very comfortable where he was.' Still, Moores hinted that England’s young, inexperienced side may have frozen under pressure before 85,000 spectators facing a ferocious Australian attack. 'The players must ask: Did we play the style and brand of cricket we wanted? If not, we need to examine how we deliver it. Each individual must ask if they got the best out of themselves.' Morgan, named captain just before the World Cup after England abandoned Alastair Cook in white-ball cricket, has become England’s biggest concern. His form over the past year has been worse than Cook’s before his dismissal. 'Eoin will be as frustrated as anyone,' Moores said after Morgan’s fourth duck in five innings. 'He wants a score — of course he does. But he handles himself well, is practicing hard, and doing everything right. This is a moment for support, for self-belief — his quality will return.' Moores cited Morgan’s century against Australia in the first game of the Tri-Series as proof he’s not under the same prolonged pressure Cook faced before being dropped after a 5-2 loss to Sri Lanka. 'There’s a difference. For Alastair, it was over time. For Eoin, it’s been less than a month since he scored a brilliant hundred in Sydney — full of brute power, placement, and perfect pacing. He needs to keep it simple and back himself. He’s not the type to hide from this. He knows he must perform.' Moores also admitted England’s bowling was fundamentally flawed — leaking too many runs in the death overs, conceding over 100 runs in the final 10 overs on Saturday. 'It wasn’t just execution. Our plans weren’t good enough. We let ourselves be drawn into the width of the square boundaries and overused short balls. We’ve underused yorkers.' There was some encouragement in Taylor’s performance in his new role. The Nottingham batsman was denied a century by a controversial umpiring error — confusion over the Decision Review System led to Jimmy Anderson being run out when the ball should have been dead after an upheld lbw appeal. 'We all felt for him,' Moores said. 'He played brilliantly. There’s nothing we can do — the decision was made, and we respected the umpires.' It’s still early to enter 'inquest' mode. England, a side that has prioritized Test cricket and must now play catch-up, aren’t expected to challenge the giants immediately. But they’ll need to show marked improvement when they face New Zealand — another formidable side on home soil — in Wellington on Friday. 'We know we faced a side at the peak of their game on Saturday,' Moores added. 'But we also know we must close the gap. The next time we play Australia will likely be in the knockout stages.' For now, England’s only goal: make sure they reach those knockout stages.

Pada Sabtu, England dibawa kembali kepada mimpi buruk Ashes terburuk mereka, dikalahkan secara telak oleh Australia yang ganas pada permulaan Piala Dunia — sekali lagi membuat perubahan terakhir. Kali ini, Ravi Bopara dikeluarkan pada saat terakhir daripada skuad yang sepatutnya mendapat masa persiapan maksimum sebelum mencabar gelaran 50-overs pertama mereka yang sukar diraih. Mitchell Marsh dari Australia merayakan setelah membuang kapten England, Eoin Morgan, dalam pembukaan Piala Dunia mereka. Pelatih England, Peter Moores, membela pemainnya tetapi mengakui mereka perlu meningkatkan secara ketara. Akibatnya, Gary Ballance kembali bermain dalam pertandingan ODIs pertamanya dalam enam bulan, manakala James Taylor — yang telah memberikan tampilan mengesankan di Sri Lanka dan di sini sebelum Natal — dipindahkan ke posisi No. 6. Chris Woakes, yang gagal menangkap pemukul abadi Aaron Finch pada over pertama di Melbourne Cricket Ground, semakin terjejas oleh keputusan untuk mengambil bola baharu darinya untuk kali kedua sahaja dalam 16 pertandingan ODI. Kekalahan telak di tangan pasukan unggulan jauh dari membunuh peluang England untuk membuat kesan dalam turnamen ini, tetapi kekeliruan dalam perancangan menimbulkan kebimbangan serius tentang kemajuan mereka. England tidak sepatutnya mencuba-cuba sekarang, terutamanya selepas Ashes dipercepatkan — dengan kos besar — untuk memberi mereka peluang terbaik membentuk rancangan yang padu sebelum percubaan ke-11 mereka untuk memenangi Piala Dunia. Namun, Moores menafikan dengan gigih bahawa England panik sebelum pertandingan bermaruah Hari Valentine mereka dengan tuan rumah, sambil menyokong Morgan untuk bangkit daripada rentetan bentuk buruk yang mengancam otoritinya. 'Ia adalah hal yang tidak relevan,' kata Moores apabila ditanya sama ada perubahan terakhir mengganggu England sebelum kekalahan 111 lari itu. 'Saya boleh katakan tanpa ragu-ragu: tidak. Anda tidak gagal menangkap kerana anda fikir anda harus membuka bowling. Kedua-dua Gary dan James akan berkata mereka fleksibel. Mereka boleh memukul di posisi tiga atau enam, dan James sangat selesa di tempatnya.' Namun, Moores memberi isyarat bahawa pasukan muda, berpotensi tetapi kurang pengalaman England mungkin terkejut di hadapan 85,000 penonton menghadapi serangan ganas Australia. 'Pemain-pemain perlu bertanya: Adakah kami memainkan gaya dan jenama permainan yang kami inginkan? Jika tidak, kita perlu melihat bagaimana kita melakukannya. Setiap individu perlu bertanya jika mereka mencapai potensi terbaik mereka.' Morgan, yang dilantik sebagai kapten tepat sebelum Piala Dunia apabila England akhirnya berhenti menyokong Alastair Cook dalam kriket satu hari, telah menjadi kebimbangan terbesar England, terutamanya kerana bentuknya dalam setahun terakhir lebih buruk daripada orang yang digantikannya. 'Eoin akan sekecewa mana-mana orang,' kata Moores selepas empat kali gagal mencatat lari (duck) dalam lima giliran. 'Dia ingin mencatat lari. Tentu saja dia ingin. Tetapi dia menangani dirinya dengan baik, berlatih keras, dan melakukan segalanya dengan cara yang betul. Ini adalah masa untuk sokongan, untuk percaya pada diri sendiri, dan yakin bahawa bentuknya akan kembali dan kualitinya akan muncul.' Moores merujuk kepada abad Morgan melawan Australia dalam perlawanan pertama Siri Tri sebagai bukti bahawa dia tidak berada di bawah tekanan jangka panjang seperti yang dihadapi Cook sebelum England menghentikannya selepas kekalahan 5-2 oleh Sri Lanka. 'Ada perbezaan. Untuk Alastair, ia berlaku sepanjang masa. Untuk Eoin, ia baru kurang daripada sebulan sejak dia mencatat abad cemerlang di Sydney — penuh kuasa kasar, penempatan sempurna, dan irama permainan. Dia perlu menjaga perkara mudah dan percaya pada dirinya untuk berbuat demikian. Dia bukan jenis lelaki yang bersembunyi daripada ini. Dia tahu dia perlu keluar dan berprestasi.' Moores juga mengakui bahawa bowling England salah secara mendasar — bocor terlalu banyak lari pada akhir giliran satu hari, dan mengizinkan lebih daripada 100 lari dalam 10 giliran terakhir pada Sabtu. 'Ia bukan hanya tentang eksekusi,' kata pelatih England. 'Rancangan kami tidak sebaik yang sepatutnya. Tidak ada gunanya bersembunyi daripadanya. Saya rasa dalam permainan ini, pemain-pemain terjebak dalam lebar batas lapangan dan berfikir bahawa (bola pendek) adalah pilihan terbaik mereka. Kami kurang gunakan yorker.' Terdapat beberapa harapan dalam tampilan Taylor di posisinya yang baru. Pemukul Nottingham itu ditolak mencatat abad akibat ralat pengadil kontroversial — kekeliruan sistem Ulasan Keputusan menyebabkan Jimmy Anderson diberi out apabila bola sepatutnya mati selepas rayuan lbw yang diterima. 'Kami semua turut prihatin untuknya,' kata Moores. 'Dia bermain dengan sangat baik. Tiada apa yang boleh kita lakukan — keputusan sudah dibuat, dan kami menghormati pengadil.' Masih terlalu awal untuk masuk ke mod 'inquest'. England, pasukan yang memprioritaskan kriket ujian dan kini mesti mengejar ketertinggalan, tidak diharapkan untuk menantang pasukan besar segera. Tetapi mereka pasti mengharapkan peningkatan yang ketara apabila mereka menghadapi New Zealand — pasukan kuat lain di tanah sendiri — di Wellington pada Jumaat. 'Kami tahu kami menghadapi pasukan di puncak bentuk mereka pada Sabtu,' tambah Moores. 'Tetapi kami juga tahu kami mesti menutup jurang itu. Ketika kami bermain semula melawan Australia, kemungkinan besar ia akan berlaku di peringkat kalah mati.' Untuk sekarang, satu-satunya matlamat England: pastikan mereka sampai ke peringkat kalah mati itu.

article_content: On March 18, 2012, 27-year-old David Doherty — son of reality TV personality Paddy Doherty — crashed his Mitsubishi Shogun into a parked Renault van on the A55 in North Wales, killing passenger James Loveridge, a 38-year-old father of four. Four others were seriously injured, including van driver Victor McClelland, who spent two weeks in a coma and sustained life-threatening injuries such as a shattered pelvis, broken neck, and brain hemorrhage. At the time, Doherty was already banned from driving and lacked insurance. He claimed he mistook the lay-by for a slip road, but investigators concluded he was likely impaired. Instead of helping the victims, he fled the scene, stole a nearby Land Rover, and drove away — again, without a license or insurance. Police arrived moments later, but he evaded them, making it impossible to test him for alcohol. Despite initially denying he was driving, DNA found on the airbag of his wrecked Shogun and inside the stolen Land Rover proved conclusively that he was behind the wheel. He later admitted to causing death by careless driving, driving while disqualified, failing to stop, and failing to report the accident. Judge Niclas Parry condemned Doherty’s actions as 'sheer wickedness,' noting that he showed no concern for human life — even after realizing his passenger was dead or gravely injured. The judge highlighted that Doherty’s pattern of reckless behavior, including prior convictions for dangerous driving and fleeing police in Manchester, made this offense particularly aggravated. The crash occurred while Doherty was on bail for a separate incident involving a violent brawl between his family and the Joyce family, which had erupted outside a Manchester courthouse just weeks before. During that altercation, Paddy Doherty’s ear was bitten off — an event widely publicized, adding to the media spotlight on the family. Though Doherty expressed remorse, the court stressed that no sentence could compensate for the irreversible loss suffered by the victims. James Loveridge’s death, and the lifelong trauma endured by McClelland and others, remain a devastating consequence of avoidable choices.

Empat orang lain cedera serius, termasuk pemandu van, Victor McClelland, yang mengalami koma selama dua minggu dan mengalami kecederaan serius seperti pinggul hancur, leher patah, dan perdarahan otak. Pada masa itu, Doherty sudah dilarang memandu dan tidak mempunyai insurans. Dia mengaku bahawa dia keliru dan menyangka tempat berhenti itu adalah jalan keluar, tetapi penyiasat menyimpulkan bahawa beliau kemungkinan dalam keadaan mabuk. Alih-alih membantu mangsa, beliau melarikan diri dari tempat kejadian, mencuri sebuah Land Rover terdekat, dan terus memandu — sekali lagi tanpa lesen atau insurans. Polis tiba beberapa saat kemudian, tetapi beliau mengelakkan mereka, menjadikan mustahil untuk menguji beliau untuk alkohol. Walaupun awalnya menafikan bahawa beliau adalah pemandu, bukti DNA yang ditemui di beg udara kereta Shogun yang rosak dan di dalam Land Rover yang dicuri membuktikan secara pasti bahawa beliau adalah pemandunya. Beliau kemudian mengaku bersalah atas kesalahan menyebabkan kematian akibat memandu tanpa berhati-hati, memandu tanpa lesen, gagal berhenti, dan gagal melaporkan kemalangan. Hakim Niclas Parry mengutuk tindakan Doherty sebagai 'kejahatan semata-mata', menekankan bahawa beliau tidak menunjukkan sebarang perhatian terhadap nyawa manusia — walaupun setelah sedar bahawa penumpangnya telah mati atau cedera serius. Hakim juga menyoroti pola tingkah laku tidak bertanggungjawab Doherty, termasuk kesalahan sebelum ini seperti memandu dengan berbahaya dan melarikan diri daripada polis di Manchester, yang membuat kes ini lebih serius. Kemalangan itu berlaku semasa Doherty sedang dibebaskan sementara bagi kes terpisah yang melibatkan pergaduhan kejam antara keluarganya dan keluarga Joyce, yang meletus di luar mahkamah Manchester beberapa minggu sebelumnya. Semasa pergaduhan itu, telinga Paddy Doherty digigit — suatu peristiwa yang mendapat liputan luas, menambah perhatian media terhadap keluarga tersebut. Walaupun Doherty menunjukkan penyesalan, mahkamah menekankan bahawa tiada hukuman yang boleh menggantikan kerugian abadi yang dialami mangsa. Kematian James Loveridge dan trauma seumur hidup yang dialami McClelland dan yang lain tetap menjadi konsekuensi malang akibat pilihan yang boleh dielakkan.

article_content: Two individuals who deceived the UK government into granting them asylum status and claimed £134,438 in benefits by using false identities now face jail. Mohammed Zakariya Wadiwala, 42, and his wife Zenabbibi, 44, entered Britain in 2007 under the alias 'Sheikh' instead of their real surname, Wadiwala, to claim asylum from India. They claimed to have lost all identification and feared persecution due to their interfaith marriage — he is Muslim, she is Hindu — alleging that one of their children was killed because of cultural tensions. In reality, they arrived with valid passports in their true names. Had authorities known their real identities, they would likely have been deported within months. Instead, their fraudulent asylum claim stretched for years, during which they received up to £2,000 monthly in housing and living benefits for themselves and their five children. In total, they collected £134,438 in public funds before being arrested in 2012. At Preston Crown Court, both pleaded guilty to fraud, possession of false identity documents, and making false statements to immigration officers. Judge Ian Leeming QC noted that the prolonged claim resulted in excessive benefit payments and indicated that custodial sentences are likely. Upon serving any prison term, they will almost certainly be deported. Wadiwala claimed he changed his name in India to escape threats to his life, stating that Hindu extremists had attempted to kill him and kidnap his wife after her conversion to Islam. However, prosecutors argued this was a cover for financial gain, noting their documents were verifiable and their actions constituted a coordinated fraud.

Mereka mengaku kehilangan semua dokumen dan bimbang dianiaya akibat perkahwinan antara agama — dia beragama Islam, dia beragama Hindu — serta mendakwa salah seorang anak mereka dibunuh kerana perbezaan budaya. Sebenarnya, mereka tiba dengan pasport sah atas nama sebenar mereka. Sekiranya pihak berkuasa mengetahui identiti sebenar mereka, mereka kemungkinan besar akan dieks-tradisi dalam tempoh beberapa bulan. Sebaliknya, permohonan pelarian palsu mereka berterusan selama bertahun-tahun, di mana mereka menerima sehingga £2,000 sebulan dalam faedah perumahan dan hidup untuk diri mereka sendiri dan lima orang anak mereka. Secara keseluruhan, mereka memperoleh £134,438 dalam dana awam sebelum ditangkap pada tahun 2012. Di Mahkamah Crown Preston, kedua-duanya mengaku bersalah atas penipuan, memiliki dokumen identiti palsu, dan membuat pernyataan palsu kepada pegawai imigresen. Hakim Ian Leeming QC mencatat bahawa permohonan yang diperpanjang menyebabkan pembayaran faedah yang berlebihan dan menunjukkan bahawa hukuman penjara adalah mungkin. Selepas menjalani sebarang hukuman penjara, mereka hampir pasti akan dieks-tradisi. Wadiwala mendakwa beliau menukar namanya di India untuk melarikan diri daripada ancaman terhadap nyawanya, menyatakan bahawa ekstremis Hindu cuba membunuhnya dan menculik isterinya selepas pertukaran agamanya kepada Islam. Namun, pendakwa berhujah bahawa ini merupakan tuduhan palsu untuk keuntungan kewangan, menekankan bahawa dokumen mereka boleh disahkan dan tindakan mereka membentuk penipuan yang terancang.

article_content: The wife of seven-time Formula One champion Michael Schumacher says he is slowly improving after spending six months in a coma following a severe skiing accident in the French Alps on December 29, 2013. Nearly four weeks ago, Schumacher was transferred from the hospital in Grenoble — where he had received care since late December 2013 — to the University Hospital in Lausanne, closer to his family home. The 45-year-old is now undergoing what doctors described as a prolonged rehabilitation phase. This week marked Corinna Schumacher’s first public appearance since the accident in Meribel. Speaking to the German women’s magazine Neue Post, she said, 'It's getting better — slowly, certainly, but it's improving.' Separately, it was confirmed by Swiss authorities that Michael Schumacher’s private medical records were illegally accessed and stolen in a breach affecting his family’s privacy.

Hampir empat minggu yang lalu, Schumacher dipindahkan dari hospital di Grenoble — tempat beliau menerima rawatan sejak akhir Disember 2013 — ke Hospital Universiti Lausanne, yang lebih dekat dengan rumah keluarganya. Lelaki berusia 45 tahun ini kini sedang menjalani fasa rehabilitasi yang panjang, seperti yang dinyatakan oleh doktor. Minggu ini menandakan penampilan awam pertama Corinna Schumacher sejak kemalangan itu berlaku di Meribel. Berbicara kepada majalah wanita Jerman, Neue Post, beliau berkata, 'Ia semakin baik — perlahan, tentu saja, tetapi ia membaik.' Secara berasingan, pihak berkuasa Swiss mengesahkan bahawa rekod perubatan peribadi Michael Schumacher telah diakses dan dicuri secara tidak sah dalam satu pelanggaran yang memberi kesan terhadap privasi keluarganya.

article_content: An Oklahoma couple, Brenda Mettler, 42, and her husband Robert Mettler, 44, were arrested last Thursday after police found videos on their devices showing their dog engaging in sexual acts with Brenda. The Rogers County Sheriff’s Office executed a search warrant at their home in Claremore and discovered multiple videos depicting various dogs performing sexual acts on women. The couple was charged with crimes against nature/sodomy, cruelty to animals, and distributing obscene material. In interviews, Brenda admitted that she and her husband filmed one video years ago featuring their white boxer performing oral sex on her. She stated it was a one-time occurrence and that the dog has since passed away. Brenda claimed she was unaware her husband had shared the video online. Robert initially denied knowing the video had been uploaded, suggesting his account had been hacked. However, investigators confirmed through digital forensics that the video found on a bestiality forum matched footage recovered from his personal cellphone. Deputies described the content as 'detestable and abominable crimes against nature.' The couple was released on $60,000 bail on Friday and is scheduled to appear in court on November 7.

article_content: Amid a wave of doping scandals shaking athletics and Jamaican sports, Usain Bolt has issued a clear statement: 'I'm clean.' The six-time Olympic gold medalist and world record holder in the 100m and 200m spoke publicly for the first time since fellow Jamaican sprinter Asafa Powell and U.S. star Tyson Gay tested positive for banned substances. Speaking ahead of the Diamond League meet in London, Bolt reflected on his career: 'If you’ve followed me since 2002, you’d know I’ve been achieving phenomenal things since I was 15. I was the youngest to win the world junior title at 15, set the world junior record at 18, and the world youth record at 17. I’ve broken every record possible in every event I’ve competed in. I’ve proven myself since I was 15. I’ve always known I was meant to be great.' 'I was made to inspire people and to run. I was given a gift — and that’s what I do. I trust myself and my team. I know I am clean.' Powell became the second prominent Jamaican sprinter to fail a drug test in recent weeks. Earlier, triple Olympic champion Veronica Campbell-Brown received a provisional suspension. All — Powell, Campbell-Brown, Gay, and fellow Jamaican Sherone Simpson — deny knowingly using banned substances. Bolt revealed he sent Powell a supportive text message: 'Stay strong and focused.' He added, 'There are still many details to uncover. I’m just waiting to see what happens. There’s a lot that hasn’t been said yet.' 'As an athlete, you have to be extremely careful. The banned list keeps changing. It’s hard to stay updated — but that’s why you have a team to help you.' Beyond track and field, Jamaican football faced its own scandal when an unnamed player tested positive after Jamaica’s World Cup qualifier against Honduras on June 11, 2013. The Jamaican Football Federation (JFF) confirmed the adverse finding was made by FIFA, stating: 'The player has been informed, and the process is now under FIFA’s jurisdiction. The JFF has taken this matter seriously and initiated a full investigation led by its Medical Committee.'

article_content: A 20-year-old woman, Sophie Mattes, was misdiagnosed with anorexia after dropping from a size 12 to a size 4 within a year. Despite consuming only a handful of boiled sweets and three squares of chocolate daily, she insisted she was not suffering from an eating disorder. She reported constant fullness and bloating—even with minimal food intake—and struggled to finish meals due to severe stomach pain. Her concerns were dismissed by multiple doctors, who assumed her weight loss stemmed from anorexia simply because she was a young woman. Only her parents believed her and insisted on further testing. In April 2012, she was correctly diagnosed with gastroparesis, a condition where the vagus nerve controlling stomach emptying is paralyzed. She was hospitalized and tube-fed for three weeks, then continued home tube feeding for 14 hours daily. After months of suffering, she received a gastric pacemaker in October 2012—a device designed to stimulate stomach contractions and aid digestion. Six months post-surgery, Sophie regained her appetite, now weighs 7st 10lb, wears a size 6–8, and eats normally again. She now speaks out to challenge the harmful stereotype that rapid weight loss in young women automatically indicates an eating disorder.

Kekhawatirannya diabaikan oleh pelbagai doktor, yang menganggap penurunan berat badannya disebabkan oleh anoreksia semata-mata kerana dia seorang remaja perempuan. Hanya ibu bapanya yang percaya padanya dan meminta ujian lanjutan. Selepas berbulan-bulan menderita, dia menerima pacemaker gastrik pada Oktober 2012—sebuah alat yang direka untuk merangsang kontraksi perut dan membantu pencernaan. Enam bulan selepas pembedahan, Sophie mendapat semula nafsu makan, kini beratnya 7st 10lb, memakai saiz 6–8, dan boleh makan seperti biasa lagi. Dia kini berbicara untuk menentang stereotaip berbahaya yang menganggap penurunan berat badan pantas pada remaja perempuan sebagai tanda gangguan makan.

article_content: Egyptian President Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi has firmly stated he will not override the court’s decision to sentence three Al-Jazeera journalists to seven years in prison — a ruling that has drawn fierce international backlash. Despite appeals from the U.S., Australia, the UK, and human rights groups urging him to use his constitutional power to pardon them, Sisi insisted that judicial independence must remain untouched. Speaking at a military graduation ceremony broadcast nationwide, he told the justice minister: 'We will not interfere in judicial matters — the Egyptian judiciary is independent and exalted.' He also urged citizens and foreign critics alike to stop questioning court outcomes, warning that such criticism undermines state institutions. The journalists — Australian Peter Greste, Canadian-Egyptian Mohamed Fahmy, and Egyptian Baher Mohamed — were convicted on charges of aiding a terrorist organization (the Muslim Brotherhood) and spreading false news to incite civil unrest. Their legal team and supporters argue they were simply reporting on mass protests following the 2013 military ouster of President Morsi, with little to no credible evidence presented in court. Families of the accused described the trial as a farce, with Fahmy’s brother saying, 'Everything is corrupt,' and Greste’s family calling the verdict devastating. In addition to the three jailed reporters, two British and one Dutch journalist received 10-year sentences in absentia. One defendant was acquitted, and others — mostly students — were charged with supplying footage or membership in the Brotherhood. The trial has become a flashpoint in global debates over press freedom versus national security. UK Foreign Secretary William Hague summoned Egypt’s ambassador, U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry called the sentences 'chilling and draconian,' and British MPs questioned continuing financial aid to Egypt. Meanwhile, Sisi framed his refusal to act as a necessary stand for rule of law — even as critics see it as complicity in silencing dissent.

Walaupun ada seruan daripada AS, Australia, UK, dan kumpulan hak asasi manusia agar beliau menggunakan kuasa perlembagaannya untuk memaafkan mereka, Sisi menegaskan bahawa kemerdekaan kehakiman mesti dikekalkan. Dalam ucapan di upacara kelulusan tentera yang disiarkan secara nasional, beliau memberitahu menteri kehakiman: 'Kita tidak akan campur tangan dalam perkara kehakiman — kehakiman Mesir adalah merdeka dan mulia.' Beliau juga mendesak rakyat dan pengkritik asing untuk berhenti mempertikaikan keputusan mahkamah, memperingatkan bahawa kritikan sedemikian melemahkan institusi negara. Tiga jururakam itu — Peter Greste dari Australia, Mohamed Fahmy dari Kanada-Mesir, dan Baher Mohamed dari Mesir — didakwa kerana membantu organisasi teroris (Ikhwah Muslimin) dan menyebarkan berita palsu untuk merangsang huru-hara sivil. Peguam dan penyokong mereka berpendapat bahawa mereka hanya melaporkan demonstrasi besar-besaran selepas penggulingan Presiden Morsi oleh tentera pada 2013, dengan sedikit atau tiada bukti kredibel yang dibentangkan di mahkamah. Keluarga terdakwa menggambarkan kes ini sebagai sebuah sandiwara, dengan adik Fahmy berkata, 'Semuanya rosak,' dan keluarga Greste memanggil keputusan itu sebagai malapetaka. Selain tiga jururakam yang dipenjarakan, dua jururakam British dan seorang jururakam Belanda dihukum 10 tahun penjara secara in absentia. Satu terdakwa dibebaskan, manakala yang lain — kebanyakannya pelajar — didakwa kerana menyediakan rakaman atau menjadi ahli Ikhwah Muslimin. Kes ini menjadi titik api dalam perbincangan antarabangsa mengenai kebebasan pers berbanding keselamatan negara. Menteri Luar UK William Hague memanggil duta Mesir, Menteri Luar AS John Kerry memanggil hukuman itu 'menakutkan dan kejam,' dan ahli parlimen British mempertikaikan terusannya bantuan kewangan kepada Mesir. Sementara itu, Sisi menggambarkan penolakannya bertindak sebagai langkah penting untuk menegakkan undang-undang — walaupun para pengkritik melihatnya sebagai kerjasama dalam membungkam perbezaan pendapat.

article_content: Former West Indies cricket icon Chris Gayle, famously dubbed the 'Universe Boss,' has voiced strong support for Indian captain Rohit Sharma and veteran Virat Kohli taking charge of their own international futures. Speaking during a media session at the Legends League Cricket (LLC), where he represents the Gujarat Giants, Gayle argued that players of their caliber — especially after their standout displays in the recent ODI World Cup — deserve the right to decide whether they continue playing for India. 'They’ve given so much to the game. If they still feel they can contribute, why shouldn’t they play?' he told IANS. Gayle, who once held the record for the most sixes in international cricket, applauded Rohit Sharma for surpassing his milestone, praising his fearless, attacking approach. 'I love how Rohit goes after bowlers — that’s the kind of aggression that changes games. He’s one of the few who truly dominates the attack,' he said. He also celebrated Virat Kohli’s historic 50th ODI century, a feat that eclipsed Sachin Tendulkar’s long-standing record. 'Breaking Sachin’s record? That’s something out of a dream. Fifty centuries — no one else is even close to matching that. It’s beyond remarkable,' Gayle added. Beyond the stats, Gayle shared his heartfelt joy at being part of the Legends League Cricket. For him, cricket isn’t just a sport — it’s a lifelong passion. 'It’s in my blood. Every time I step onto the field, even in a league like this, it feels like home.' He particularly relished opening the innings alongside South African great Jacques Kallis, calling it a childhood fantasy realized. 'Playing with legends like him? That’s the kind of magic that keeps me going. I’m grateful for every moment.'

article_content: At the Chinese Grand Prix, despite a string of setbacks, I managed to finish second — and honestly, it felt like a victory. Qualifying in the rain was messy: I made a few mistakes, and then our car had technical glitches that dropped me to fourth. But the real challenge came during the race: total loss of telemetry. That meant no live data from the car — no tyre pressures, no fuel readings, no brake balance updates. My engineers were flying blind. I was alone out there, forced to rely entirely on instinct and feel. Without knowing my tyre pressures — which are critical for grip and performance — I was essentially racing with one hand tied behind my back. And because the clutch settings couldn’t be adjusted remotely, my start was awful. I dropped to seventh by the first corner. From there, I clawed my way back, lap by lap, trusting my instincts. Finishing second under those conditions? That’s a testament to how strong our car is and how brilliant our team is, even when things go sideways. Now, heading into Spain, I’m feeling confident. Barcelona is my home track — I’ve tested here every winter for years. I know every curb, every braking point. Last year, I took pole here. With the team working hard during the break, and me spending time in the simulator, I believe we’re ready to fight. My teammate Lewis has won three races in a row — Malaysia, Bahrain, China — so breaking his streak is top priority. I’m all in. Off-track, I had a surreal moment driving Juan Manuel Fangio’s 1954 Mercedes W196 at Hockenheim — and yes, I took a selfie behind the wheel. No one’s ever done that before! It hit me how deep the roots of this sport run. I also spent time with my fiancée, trained, and played football with German star Lukas Podolski by the Rhine. He’s a great guy. We talked about Arsenal’s FA Cup final and his excitement for the World Cup. I’ll meet the German national team after Monaco — can’t wait. And while we celebrate victories, we mustn’t forget the past. This week marked 20 years since Ayrton Senna’s death — a tragedy that changed motorsport forever. But let’s not forget Roland Ratzenberger, who died the day before. Senna’s legacy is huge, but Ratzenberger’s story matters too. That weekend led to massive safety reforms — and we’re still reaping those benefits today. Safety must keep evolving. Finally, the money I earn from writing this column goes to the Grand Prix Mechanics’ Charitable Trust — supporting the unsung heroes who keep these machines running. Thank you to every mechanic, past and present.
translated_content: Di Grand Prix Cina, walaupun menghadapi beberapa kegagalan, saya berjaya menamatkan perlumbaan di tempat kedua — dan jujur, ia terasa seperti kemenangan. Kelayakan dalam hujan memang kacau: saya membuat beberapa kesilapan, dan mobil kami mengalami gangguan teknikal yang menjadikan saya bermula dari petak keempat. Tetapi cabaran sebenar datang semasa perlumbaan: kehilangan sepenuhnya data telemetri. Itu bermakna tiada maklumat langsung dari kereta — tiada tekanan tayar, tiada bacaan bahan api, tiada kemasan brek. Jurutera saya benar-benar buta. Saya sendirian di atas trek, terpaksa bergantung sepenuhnya pada insting dan rasa. Tanpa mengetahui tekanan tayar saya — yang sangat penting untuk cengkaman dan prestasi — saya seolah-olah berlumba dengan satu tangan di belakang punggung. Dan kerana tetapan klutch tidak boleh disesuaikan dari jauh, permulaan saya sangat buruk. Saya terjun ke tempat ketujuh selepas tikungan pertama. Daripada situ, saya berjuang balik, litar demi litar, mempercayai insting saya. Menamatkan perlumbaan di tempat kedua dalam keadaan begini? Ini bukti betapa kuatnya kereta kami dan betapa cemerlangnya pasukan kami, walaupun segala perkara tidak berjalan lancar. Sekarang, menjelang Sepanyol, saya merasa yakin. Barcelona adalah trek rumah saya — saya telah menguji di sini setiap musim sejuk selama bertahun-tahun. Saya tahu setiap batu, setiap titik brek. Tahun lepas, saya ambil pole di sini. Dengan pasukan bekerja keras semasa rehat, dan saya menghabiskan masa di simulator, saya percaya kami bersedia untuk bertarung. Teman sepasukan saya, Lewis, telah menang tiga perlumbaan berturut-turut — Malaysia, Bahrain, Cina — jadi mematahkan momentumnya adalah keutamaan utama saya. Saya benar-benar bersungguh-sungguh. Di luar trek, saya mengalami momen yang luar biasa apabila memandu Mercedes W196 tahun 1954 milik Juan Manuel Fangio di Hockenheim — dan ya, saya mengambil swafoto di belakang kemudi. Belum pernah ada yang melakukan ini sebelumnya! Ia membuat saya sedar betapa dalam akar olahraga ini. Saya juga meluangkan masa bersama tunang saya, berlatih, dan bermain bola sepak bersama bintang Jerman, Lukas Podolski, di tepi Sungai Rhine. Dia orang yang baik. Kami bercakap tentang perlawanan akhir FA Cup Arsenal dan kegembiraannya menyambut Piala Dunia. Saya akan bertemu pasukan Jerman selepas Grand Prix Monako — tak sabar! Dan walaupun kita merayakan kemenangan, kita tidak boleh lupakan sejarah. Minggu ini menandai 20 tahun kematian Ayrton Senna — sebuah tragedi yang mengubah dunia motorsport selamanya. Tapi jangan lupa Roland Ratzenberger, yang meninggal sehari sebelumnya. Warisan Senna besar, tetapi kisah Ratzenberger juga penting. Tragedi itu membawa kepada reformasi keselamatan besar — dan kita masih mendapat manfaat darinya sehingga hari ini. Keselamatan mesti terus berkembang. Akhirnya, wang yang saya hasilkan daripada menulis kolom ini disumbangkan kepada Grand Prix Mechanics’ Charitable Trust — menyokong para hero tanpa nama yang menjaga mesin-mesin ini. Terima kasih kepada semua juruteknik, dahulu dan sekarang.

article_content: The BBC's decision to delay the broadcast of a documentary about the Royal Family—days before its scheduled airing—is being labeled 'sinister censorship' by critics. The documentary, titled 'Reinventing The Royals,' is said to critically examine Prince Charles’s efforts to rebuild his public image and foster greater sympathy for Camilla Parker Bowles following the death of Princess Diana in 1997. Members of Parliament have accused the Royal Family of 'gross interference,' alleging that lawyers representing Charles and the Duchess of Cornwall contacted the BBC to raise objections to the program. Critics argue the BBC failed to 'stand firm' under pressure, raising concerns about editorial independence. The film reportedly details a PR strategy known as 'Operation Mrs PB,' designed to improve the public perception of Charles and Camilla after Diana’s death. Informed sources within the Royal Family claim the production was initially framed as a general exploration of media-monarchy relations but evolved into a hostile exposé. Welsh Labour MP Paul Flynn told MailOnline: 'It seems to be gross interference with the BBC in their role to tell their paymasters—the British public—the truth. The Royals have used their expensive PR operation to influence the BBC. People are right to believe this is sinister censorship. This is not Moscow—the BBC should be fearless and free to broadcast.' Jim Sheridan, a senior MP on the Commons Culture, Media and Sport Committee, told the Daily Mirror: 'We cannot now have the Royal Family deciding what can and cannot be shown on our national broadcaster. That is a dangerous precedent to set.' The documentary, presented by former Panorama editor Steve Hewlett, was pulled from the 9 p.m. Sunday slot on BBC Two. Hewlett previously led the landmark 1995 Panorama interview in which Diana famously said, 'There were three of us in this marriage, so it was a bit crowded.' According to reports, the documentary suggests that Prince William felt 'used' to advance his father’s interests after details of his first meeting with Camilla—ten months after Diana’s death—were leaked to a journalist. Hewlett wrote in the Radio Times that Charles hired Mark Bolland from the Press Complaints Commission to manage his media rehabilitation, focusing on portraying him as a caring single father and normalizing Camilla’s role in his life. A BBC spokesperson stated: 'The BBC is delaying broadcast of the documentary Reinventing The Royals, due to be shown on BBC Two on January 4, until later in the New Year while a number of issues—including the use of archive footage—are resolved.' A source confirmed the delay is temporary and the program is 'certain to air soon.' Graham Smith of Republic, which advocates abolishing the monarchy, said: 'The BBC has a responsibility to the public to show no fear or favor in its reporting. Prince Charles is in line to be Britain's head of state—he must be subjected to the same standards of media scrutiny as any politician.' It is understood the Royal Family initially cooperated with the production but grew concerned about its tone and direction. Sources say Clarence House believes the filmmakers were disingenuous from the outset, claiming the project shifted from a balanced overview to a targeted attack on the Prince of Wales.

Hewlett menulis dalam Radio Times bahawa Charles mempekerjakan Mark Bolland dari Press Complaints Commission untuk mengurus rehabiltasi media beliau, dengan fokus pada penggambaran dirinya sebagai seorang bapa tunggal yang penyayang dan melegitimasi peranan Camilla dalam hidupnya. article_content: In a major food safety move, King Nut Companies has recalled all of its peanut butter products after a widespread salmonella outbreak tied to the brand. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirmed 399 infections across 42 U.S. states, with one suspected fatality in Minnesota. Health officials traced the contamination to a 5-pound tub of King Nut peanut butter, which was manufactured by the Peanut Corporation of America — a company based in Lynchburg, Virginia, with processing plants in Georgia and Texas. King Nut emphasized that its product was never sold in stores; instead, it was distributed exclusively through restaurants, schools, and other food service providers. 'We’re deeply sorry this happened,' said President Martin Kanan. 'Customer safety is our top priority.' The CDC reports that most cases emerged between October and December, with California leading in infections (55), followed by Ohio (53) and Massachusetts (39). Around 18% of those infected required hospital care, and ages ranged from infants to seniors over 90. While most people recover on their own, young children, older adults, and those with weakened immune systems face the greatest risks. King Nut stressed that none of its other products are involved in the recall. Salmonella, often spread through undercooked food, causes fever, diarrhea, and stomach cramps — and some strains are resistant to antibiotics.

Pusat Kawalan dan Pencegahan Penyakit mengesahkan 399 kes jangkitan di 42 negeri AS, dengan satu kes kematian yang disyaki di Minnesota. Pegawai kesihatan mengesan pencemaran kepada satu bekas 5 paun selai kacang King Nut, yang dikeluarkan oleh Peanut Corporation of America — syarikat yang beribu pejabat di Lynchburg, Virginia, dengan pabrik pemprosesan di Georgia dan Texas. King Nut menekankan bahawa produknya tidak pernah dijual di kedai; sebaliknya, ia diedarkan secara eksklusif melalui restoran, sekolah, dan penyedia perkhidmatan makanan lain. 'Kami sangat menyesal ini berlaku,' kata Presiden Martin Kanan. 'Keselamatan pelanggan adalah keutamaan utama kami.' CDC melaporkan bahawa kebanyakan kes muncul antara Oktober dan Disember, dengan California memimpin dalam jumlah kes (55), diikuti oleh Ohio (53) dan Massachusetts (39). Sekitar 18% pesakit memerlukan rawatan di hospital, dan umur mangsa berkisar dari bayi hingga warga emas lebih 90 tahun. Walaupun kebanyakan orang pulih tanpa rawatan, kanak-kanak kecil, orang tua, dan mereka yang mempunyai sistem imun lemah menghadapi risiko paling tinggi. King Nut menegaskan bahawa tiada produk lainnya terlibat dalam penarikan balik ini. Salmonela, sering disebarkan melalui makanan yang tidak dimasak dengan baik, menyebabkan demam, diare, dan kekejangan perut — dan sesetengah strain kebal terhadap antibiotik.

article_content: In a horrifying act of violence, 29-year-old Canadian hairdresser Tanya St-Arnauld was critically injured after her boyfriend, 27-year-old Nikolas Stefanatos, threw a highly corrosive household chemical onto her face and body. The attack, which occurred early Sunday morning outside her Montreal apartment, left her with severe burns covering nearly 70% of her skin, prompting doctors to place her in a medically-induced coma. Police responded to the scene around 5 a.m. after neighbors reported screams. According to authorities, the substance used was an undiluted cleaning product known to cause devastating skin damage. Stefanatos reportedly fled immediately afterward but was apprehended hours later. Prior to this incident, witnesses say he had thrown orange juice at her in a parking lot, and in another altercation, allegedly sprayed her with ketchup and mustard during an argument — behavior that friends describe as increasingly erratic. Tanya awoke from her coma on Wednesday evening. Her brother, Maxime Gosselin, spoke emotionally about her condition, saying she had lost all her hair and that her skin had literally melted away. 'She was screaming. She hid in the bathroom. It fell off,' he recounted. He urged for the harshest possible punishment, calling the attack a brutal act of domestic abuse. Stefanatos now faces a charge of aggravated assault, classified under Canadian law as conjugal violence — a term equivalent to domestic violence.

Serangan itu berlaku awal pagi Ahad di luar apartmen Montrealnya, meninggalkannya dengan luka bakar teruk meliputi hampir 70% kulitnya, menyebabkan doktor memasukkannya ke dalam keadaan koma yang dirangsang secara perubatan. Polis dipanggil ke tempat kejadian sekitar jam 5 pagi selepas jiran mendengar jeritan. Menurut pihak berkuasa, bahan yang digunakan adalah produk pembersih tidak dicairkan yang diketahui menyebabkan kerosakan kulit yang parah. Stefanatos dilaporkan melarikan diri segera selepas itu tetapi ditangkap beberapa jam kemudian. Sebelum kejadian ini, saksi mengatakan dia pernah melempar jus oren kepadanya di tempat letak kereta, dan dalam insiden lain, didakwa menyemburkan sos tomato dan mustard kepadanya semasa pertengkaran — tingkah laku yang disifatkan rakan-rakan sebagai semakin tidak stabil. Tanya sedar dari koma pada hari Rabu petang. Adik lelakinya, Maxime Gosselin, berucap dengan emosi tentang keadaannya, berkata bahawa dia kehilangan semua rambutnya dan kulitnya benar-benar meleleh. 'Dia berteriak. Dia bersembunyi di bilik mandi. Ia gugur,' katanya. Beliau mendesak hukuman paling berat, memanggil serangan itu sebagai tindakan keganasan domestik yang kejam. Stefanatos kini dihadapkan kepada tuduhan serangan teruk, diklasifikasikan di bawah undang-undang Kanada sebagai keganasan perkahwinan — istilah yang setara dengan keganasan domestik.

article_content: By Kerry McQueeney. Last updated at 6:19 PM on December 27, 2011. Astronomers worldwide were awestruck by Comet Lovejoy’s remarkable close approach to the Sun, passing just 87,000 miles from its surface last week. Following its near-miss, the comet’s path across Earth’s night sky was captured in stunning detail by amateur astronomer Alex Cherney, a 36-year-old IT consultant from Cape Schanck, Victoria, on Australia’s southern coast. Using a simple digital camera with long-exposure settings to gather more light, Cherney photographed the comet blazing through the heavens — its luminous tail stretching across the dark sky. Experts had predicted the 1,600-foot-wide icy body would disintegrate upon entering the Sun’s scorching corona. Instead, it emerged intact, having lost its original tail but regenerating a new one. The commander of the International Space Station, Dan Burbank, observed and photographed the comet from 240 miles above Earth, calling it 'the most amazing thing I have ever seen in space.' NASA’s Solar Dynamics Observatory recorded the comet’s dramatic passage, later tweeting: 'Breaking News! Lovejoy lives!' Discovered on November 27, 2011, by Australian amateur astronomer Terry Lovejoy, the comet belongs to the Kreutz sungrazer family — fragments of a massive comet that shattered centuries ago. Three major space agencies — NASA, ESA, and JAXA — immediately began tracking its trajectory. Scientists expected total vaporization, but Lovejoy’s survival revealed greater structural resilience than anticipated. Robert Massey of the Royal Astronomical Society noted: 'It was an extraordinary event. Lovejoy came closer to the Sun than the Moon is to Earth. Its survival suggests it was far tougher than models predicted.' Similar sightings were reported globally — from Santiago, Chile, to the Atacama Desert, and beyond — underscoring the event’s international significance.

Ahli astronomi di seluruh dunia terpesona oleh pendekatan luar biasa Komet Lovejoy kepada Matahari, yang melintas hanya 87,000 batu dari permukaannya minggu lalu. Menggunakan kamera digital biasa dengan eksposur panjang untuk menangkap lebih banyak cahaya, Cherney merekam komet itu menyala di angkasa — ekornya yang bersinar membentang di langit gelap. Para pakar menduga badan es berukuran 1,600 kaki itu akan pupus apabila memasuki korona Matahari yang sangat panas. Namun, ia muncul utuh, selepas kehilangan ekor asalnya tetapi membentuk ekor baru. Pemimpin Stesen Angkasa Antarabangsa, Dan Burbank, memerhatikan dan mengambil gambar komet itu dari ketinggian 240 batu di atas Bumi, menyebutnya sebagai 'perkara paling menakjubkan yang pernah saya lihat di angkasa.' Observatori Dinamik Surya NASA merekam perjalanan dramatik komet itu, kemudian mengeluarkan tweet: 'Berita Terkini! Lovejoy masih hidup!' Tiga agensi angkasa utama — NASA, ESA, dan JAXA — segera memantau lintasannya. Penglihatan serupa dilaporkan secara global — dari Santiago, Chile, hingga Gurun Atacama — yang menegaskan signifikansi antarabangsa peristiwa ini.

article_content: In the quiet Belgian town of Dendermonde, a horrific attack unfolded at Fabeltjesland, a local nursery school, leaving three dead and more than a dozen others injured — most of them very young children. The suspect, a 20-year-old man named Kim D., was apprehended roughly 90 minutes after the violence began. According to officials, he entered the facility through a side entrance meant for late pickups, wearing a bulletproof vest and with his face painted white, accented by dark circles around his eyes. Armed with a knife, an axe, and a replica firearm, he moved through multiple rooms before being stopped by law enforcement. Among the victims was the school’s beloved director, a woman in her 60s deeply known in the community, along with two toddlers under the age of three. Two more knives were discovered at the scene, though it remains unclear if they were used. Kim D., who has no criminal history and is unemployed, has remained silent since his arrest. His home was searched, but no findings have been disclosed. A judge has ordered three medical professionals to assess his mental state, even though he had never been registered with any psychiatric service. The nursery, nestled near a park and difficult to locate from the street, now stands closed, surrounded by candles, stuffed animals, and handwritten notes from grieving families.

Suspek, seorang lelaki berumur 20 tahun bernama Kim D., ditangkap kira-kira 90 minit selepas keganasan bermula. Menurut pihak berkuasa, beliau memasuki kemudian melalui pintu sampingan yang ditujukan untuk ibu bapa yang datang lewat, memakai rompi peluru dan muka dilukis putih dengan bulatan hitam di sekeliling mata. Dipersenjatai dengan pisau, kapak, dan senjata replika, beliau bergerak melalui beberapa bilik sebelum dihentikan oleh pihak berkuasa. Di antara mangsa ialah pengarah sekolah yang disayangi, seorang wanita berusia 60-an yang dikenali luas di komuniti itu, bersama dua bayi di bawah umur tiga tahun. Dua pisau lagi ditemui di tempat kejadian, walaupun belum pasti sama ada ia digunakan dalam serangan itu. Kim D., yang tiada rekod jenayah dan tidak bekerja, tetap diam sejak penangkapan beliau. Rumahnya telah disiasat, tetapi tiada maklumat dikeluarkan. Hakim telah mengarahkan tiga profesional perubatan untuk menilai keadaan kesihatan mental beliau, walaupun beliau tidak pernah didaftarkan di mana-mana perkhidmatan psikiatri. Sekolah tadika itu, yang terletak berdekatan taman dan sukar ditemui dari jalan raya, kini ditutup, dikelilingi oleh lilin, mainan plush, dan nota tulisan tangan dari keluarga yang berdukacita.

article_content: Gunshots rang out inside a Nevada hospital this afternoon, leaving the gunman dead from a self-inflicted wound and at least three others injured, one fatally. The shooting occurred at approximately 2:15 p.m. on the third floor of the Center for Advanced Medicine B at Renown Regional Medical Center in Reno. Reno Police Deputy Chief Tom Robinson stated just before 3:40 p.m. local time that two people were dead — including the gunman — and at least two others were being treated for gunshot wounds. The gunman, whose identity has not been released, turned the weapon on himself after opening fire. The hospital was placed on lockdown. Witness Kandy Hall, who was in the waiting room, described seeing a casually dressed, tall white man enter with a gun at his side. 'He pointed it at me, then brandished it at everyone else seated against the wall and said something like, 'Everybody get out of here' or 'You'd all better get out of here.' Then he walked back toward where the doctors and nurses were,' she told the Reno Gazette-Journal. Eyewitness Daranda Cone, on her way to a medical appointment, recalled seeing a woman covered in blood being rushed past her to the emergency room. According to local news reports, at least two people — including a female doctor — sustained serious injuries and were listed in critical condition. They were undergoing surgery Tuesday evening. Deputy Chief Robinson confirmed at a press briefing that no law enforcement officers fired their weapons during the incident and that the building had been declared 'safe and secure.' East 2nd Street near the hospital was closed as police flooded the area in response to the shooting. Nevada Governor Brian Sandoval tweeted: 'Kathleen and I send our thoughts and prayers to those affected by today's tragedy @renownhealth. My staff and I are monitoring the situation.' The gunman's motives remain unknown.

Kejadian itu berlaku pada kira-kira 2:15 petang di tingkat ketiga Pusat Perubatan Lanjutan B di Pusat Perubatan Renown Regional di Reno. Timbalan Ketua Polis Reno, Tom Robinson, menyatakan pada jam 3:40 petang masa tempatan bahawa dua orang telah mati — termasuk penembak — dan sekurang-kurangnya dua orang lagi dirawat atas luka tembak. Penembak, yang identitinya belum dikeluarkan, memutar senjata ke arah dirinya sendiri selepas membuka tembakan. Hospital diletakkan dalam keadaan penguncian. Saksi Kandy Hall, yang berada di ruang tunggu, menggambarkan melihat seorang lelaki kulit putih tinggi berpakaian kasual masuk dengan senjata di sisi tubuhnya. 'Dia menunjuk ke arah saya, kemudian mengacungkan senjata terhadap semua orang yang duduk di sepanjang dinding dan berkata sesuatu seperti, 'Semua orang keluar dari sini' atau 'Kamu semua lebih baik keluar dari sini.' Kemudian dia pergi ke belakang ke arah di mana doktor dan jururawat berada,' katanya kepada Reno Gazette-Journal. Saksi Daranda Cone, yang sedang dalam perjalanan ke temujanji perubatan, ingat melihat seorang wanita yang diselubungi darah dibawa lalui ke unit kecemasan. Mereka menjalani pembedahan pada malam Selasa. article_content: Hurricane Sandy has already left a devastating mark on the U.S. East Coast, with torrential rains, powerful winds, and widespread evacuations. Forecasters agree the worst is yet to come. Though currently a Category 1 storm, Sandy is moving slowly northeastward, parallel to the shoreline — and its effects are being felt even before landfall. Coastal areas in North Carolina, Virginia, and Maryland are already experiencing dangerous conditions, including flooding and power outages. If, as predicted, Sandy turns toward the mainland early Monday, it could collide with a cold front from the west, forming a massive 'superstorm.' This hybrid system may linger along the Eastern Seaboard for days, bringing prolonged high winds, extensive flooding, and extended power disruptions. The National Hurricane Center warns of life-threatening storm surges affecting Long Island, New York Harbor, and the entire Mid-Atlantic coast, with water levels projected to rise 6 to 11 feet in some areas. Before reaching the U.S., Sandy claimed at least 67 lives — 51 in Haiti and 16 across other Caribbean nations — as it swept through the region. Now, as it approaches the U.S., cities from Delaware to Maine are mobilizing. New York City has begun halting subway service; schools across New York, Philadelphia, Boston, and Baltimore have canceled classes for over two million students; federal offices are closing; and thousands of flights and Amtrak routes have been scrapped. What makes Sandy especially dangerous isn’t just its wind speed — 75 mph sustained — but the enormous reach of its hurricane-force winds, extending 175 miles from the center. This means hundreds of miles of coastline will face destructive conditions, even far from the eye. A full moon on Monday will elevate tides further, increasing flood risks during peak surge times, particularly around 8:30 p.m. Residents are preparing as best they can: sandbagging homes, boarding windows, evacuating low-lying neighborhoods like Coney Island and coastal Delaware, and moving valuables to higher floors. Business owners like Yvette Cafaro in Sea Bright, New Jersey, plead for mercy: 'Be kind to us, Sandy.' Others, like Jim Brady of Cape May, have fled inland, unsure if their homes will still stand when they return. Government leaders, from governors to the U.S. Coast Guard, describe Sandy as potentially historic. Pennsylvania Governor Tom Corbett called it 'a hurricane wrapped in a nor’easter.' With power outages, road closures, and transit shutdowns expected to last days, the storm’s impact could redefine emergency response in the region. Campaign trails have gone quiet as politics yields to survival.

Apa yang membuat Sandy sangat berbahaya bukan hanya kecepatan anginnya — 75 mph terus-menerus — tetapi jangkauan luas angin badai kategori hurikan yang membentang 175 mil dari pusatnya. article_content: Asia has emerged as the global leader in renewable energy, with annual investments in wind, solar, and clean vehicles surging at 23%—reaching a total of $345 billion by 2022. According to Zero Carbon Analytics, the region now accounts for 52.5% of the world’s renewable energy capacity, driven largely by China, India, and Vietnam. The electric vehicle market in Asia has seen explosive growth, particularly in two-wheelers: electric motorbike and scooter sales jumped 3,000% between 2015 and 2022. Despite this progress, Asia remains responsible for 51% of global greenhouse gas emissions, reflecting the continued dominance of coal in India and China—both of which have pledged long-term net-zero goals. The findings were released in the report 'A Driving Force: Asia's Energy Transition,' coinciding with a major gathering of government officials, businesses, and civil society groups in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. The event focused on strengthening regional cooperation to tackle climate change across Asia and the Pacific. Key highlights from the report include Asia’s wind and solar capacity growing at 35% annually since 2015—the fastest pace globally. In 2022 alone, Asia invested $532 billion in renewables, making up 65% of global spending. India’s renewable energy expansion is now outpacing its coal growth, while China leads the world in deploying wind and solar technology since 2000. Home to 4.3 billion people, the Asia-Pacific region is among the most vulnerable to climate impacts—including rising seas, extreme weather, and ecosystem collapse. Experts stress that integrating clean energy into economic development is critical not only for climate stability but also for energy security and public health. Aarti Khosla of Carbon Copy underscored the vital role of major Asian economies like India, China, and Japan in shaping the global energy future. Li Shuo of the Asia Society Policy Institute praised China’s clean energy momentum and called for bolder international climate agreements. Amit Bhatt from the International Council on Clean Transportation highlighted how electric two- and three-wheelers are revolutionizing urban mobility in India, offering a low-cost, sustainable path forward.

Menurut Zero Carbon Analytics, kawasan ini kini menyumbang 52.5% daripada kapasiti tenaga boleh baharu dunia, yang didorong terutamanya oleh China, India, dan Vietnam. Pasaran kenderaan elektrik di Asia telah mengalami pertumbuhan pesat, terutamanya dalam kenderaan roda dua: jualan motosikal dan skuter elektrik melonjak sebanyak 3,000% antara 2015 dan 2022. article_content: Victor Matfield has issued a stark warning to South Africa following their defeat to Ireland in Dublin. Despite dominating the line-out and overpowering Ireland at the scrum, the Springboks were undone by a string of costly handling errors that squandered multiple clear scoring opportunities. Captain Jean de Villiers called the mistakes 'basic, grade-one' errors, while head coach Heyneke Meyer acknowledged that the November tour would largely determine his 2015 Rugby World Cup squad. Matfield, visibly dejected after the loss, urged his teammates to respond strongly against England on Saturday—or risk major changes. 'This is a wake-up call,' he said. 'We need to adjust, especially in wet conditions. The World Cup is still a year away, and remember, after our big loss to France in 2006, we still won the title.' He added, 'Last month, everyone praised us after beating the All Blacks. Now, one match later, we’re under immense pressure heading to Twickenham.' Ireland’s mastermind coach Joe Schmidt executed a brilliant game plan, nullifying South Africa’s driving maul and stifling their rhythm. Johnny Sexton kicked 16 points, while Tommy Bowe and Rhys Ruddock scored decisive tries. On the Irish side, new centre pairing Robbie Henshaw and Jared Payne—filling the void left by retired legend Brian O’Driscoll—said their victory was a strong start to life without their icon. JP Petersen scored for the Springboks, but Matfield conceded they must improve drastically to compete at the highest level.

article_content: In Los Angeles, finding the latest culinary sensation might require nothing more than a smartphone and a Twitter feed. The Kogi BBQ food trucks — named Verde and Roja — roam the city daily from noon until 2 a.m., serving up bold fusion tacos that blend Korean flavors with Mexican street food. Their ever-changing locations, announced in real time via Twitter, draw crowds that often wait over two hours, rain or shine. For first-timer Robert Rabis and his wife, Tiffany Tang, the hunt was worth it. 'The tacos were insanely good,' Rabis said. 'By tomorrow, everyone at my hospital will know about it.' Founded in November 2008 with just one truck and zero customers, Kogi’s rise has been meteoric. Today, it boasts over 25,500 Twitter followers and feeds thousands daily. The secret? Fresh, high-quality ingredients — all-natural beef short ribs, pork, chicken, and house-made sauces — prepared daily by chef Roy Choi, a veteran of Le Bernardin and Trader Vic’s. Priced at just $2 for tacos and $5 for burritos and kimchi quesadillas, Kogi offers gourmet food at street prices — a rare draw during economic hardship. Customers like Katherine Clouet, who drove 30 minutes and waited an hour, say it’s not just about the food — it’s the experience. 'You meet strangers who share your hunger,' she said. 'It feels like a community.' The team behind Kogi — including Mark Manguera, who conceived the idea after a late-night craving; Eddie Gonzales, who runs operations; Alice Shin, who tweets from New York; and Caroline Shin-Manguera, who manages finances — embrace the chaos. 'We make people wait in the rain. No seats. No reservations. We’re late all the time,' Shin-Manguera laughs. 'But we must be doing something right.' To some, Kogi is culinary graffiti — rebellious, vibrant, and alive. Parking lot owners either welcome them or shut them down. Yet the crew remains unfazed. 'Some see graffiti as art,' says Choi. 'Others see vandalism. We’re just serving food.' With two new trucks set to join the fleet in Southern California and serious interest from New York, Kogi’s next chapter may be even bigger. But for now, they stay true to their roots: serve the best food possible, at the lowest price, and let the people decide where they show up next.

Lokasi mereka yang selalu berubah diumumkan secara real-time melalui Twitter, menarik kerumunan yang sering menunggu lebih dari dua jam, hujan atau tidak. Didirikan pada November 2008 dengan hanya satu truk dan tanpa pelanggan sama sekali, keberhasilan Kogi sangat pesat. Hari ini, ia memiliki lebih dari 25.500 pengikut di Twitter dan melayani ribuan orang setiap hari. Rahasianya? Bahan-bahan segar dan berkualitas tinggi — daging sapi short rib, babi, ayam alami, serta saus buatan sendiri — yang disiapkan setiap hari oleh koki Roy Choi, mantan koki Le Bernardin dan Trader Vic’s. Dihargai hanya $2 untuk taco dan $5 untuk burrito serta kimchi quesadilla, Kogi menawarkan makanan gourmet dengan harga jalan — daya tarik langka selama masa resesi. Pelanggan seperti Katherine Clouet, yang berkendara 30 menit dan menunggu satu jam, mengatakan ini bukan hanya soal makanan — tapi pengalaman. 'Anda bertemu orang asing yang punya hasrat sama,' katanya. 'Rasanya seperti komunitas.' 'Sebagian orang melihat grafiti sebagai seni,' kata Choi. 'Yang lain melihatnya sebagai vandalisme. Kami hanya menyajikan makanan.' Dengan dua truk baru yang akan bergabung di wilayah Southern California dan minat serius dari New York, babak selanjutnya Kogi mungkin akan lebih besar lagi. Tetapi sampai saat ini, mereka tetap setia pada akarnya: sajikan makanan terbaik yang mungkin, dengan harga terendah, dan biarkan orang-orang yang memutuskan di mana mereka akan muncul selanjutnya.
