article_content: The internet craze for selfies has often been branded as the ultimate expression of vanity, with public figures like David Cameron and Barack Obama criticized for posting self-portraits online. But now, selfies are being put to good use — celebrities are using them to campaign against oil exploration off the coast of Ibiza, the Mediterranean haven for the wealthy and famous. Stars including Kate Moss, singer Sophie Ellis-Bextor, DJ Fatboy Slim, and his wife Zoe Ball have posted selfies holding homemade banners reading 'Ibiza Says No' and signed a petition urging the Spanish government not to grant oil exploration rights to Cairn Energy. Others joining the effort include singer James Blunt, model Laura Bailey, makeup artist Charlotte Tilbury, and designer Alice Temperley. The petition, now with 60,000 signatures, will be submitted this week by the Ibiza Preservation Fund, a coalition of local businesses and residents. Though best known as a party destination, Ibiza is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its surrounding deep waters are home to endangered species such as the bluefin tuna, striped dolphin, long-finned pilot whale, and sperm whale. 'We were horrified to discover that the Spanish government quietly passed a law on Christmas Eve granting Cairn Energy the right to explore for oil just 15 miles from our coast,' says actress Lisa Bilton, who is helping lead the campaign under the hashtag #IbizaSaysNo. Jade Jagger, daughter of Sir Mick Jagger and a resident of Ibiza, stated: 'We've been ignoring the environment for too long — now it's time to speak out.' Sophie Ellis-Bextor, a frequent visitor to the island, added: 'It's about having a conscience about the world we live in.' This marks the first time in Ibiza’s history that the Spanish government has leased its territorial waters to an oil company for exploration. Environmentalist Ben Goldsmith, founder of the Ibiza Preservation Fund, commented: 'People complain about NIMBYism — but if not us, then who?'

Tetapi kini, selfie sedang digunakan dengan cara yang baik — selebriti menggunakan mereka untuk kempen menentang eksplorasi minyak di tepi pantai Ibiza, tempat persinggahan orang kaya dan terkenal di Mediterania. article_content: Rowena He, a respected historian and former associate professor at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, no longer holds her position after her work visa was not renewed. Known for her award-winning teaching—recognized in both 2020 and 2021—and her influential 2014 book, Tiananmen Exiles: Voices of the Struggle for Democracy in China, He has spent decades studying China’s pro-democracy movements. CUHK confirmed her departure was due to the failure to secure a new employment visa, noting it has no authority over immigration decisions. Currently, she is on leave, supported by a fellowship from the U.S.-based National Humanities Center. While the university remains neutral on visa matters, critics like Sophie Richardson of Human Rights Watch call the decision part of a wider trend of silencing dissent in Hong Kong’s academic spaces. Over recent years, Hong Kong has systematically dismantled public remembrances of the 1989 Tiananmen Square events: monuments like the Pillar of Shame were removed, museums closed, and books relocated. This shift followed the 2020 imposition of Beijing’s National Security Law, which curtailed freedoms once tolerated under 'one country, two systems.' Foreign voices critical of Beijing—including journalists from the Financial Times and activist Benedict Rogers—have also been blocked from renewing their visas. Before joining CUHK, He taught at Harvard, Wellesley, and Saint Michael’s College, and remains affiliated with Harvard’s Fairbank Center for Chinese Studies.

Dikenali kerana pengajarannya yang memenangi anugerah—dihargai pada tahun 2020 dan 2021—serta bukunya yang berpengaruh pada tahun 2014, Tiananmen Exiles: Voices of the Struggle for Democracy in China, He telah menghabiskan puluhan tahun mengkaji pergerakan demokrasi di China. CUHK mengesahkan bahawa kepergiannya disebabkan kegagalan mendapatkan visa pekerjaan baharu, dengan menekankan ia tidak mempunyai kuasa atas keputusan imigres. Semasa ini, beliau sedang cuti, disokong oleh persatuan dari Pusat Humaniti Amerika Syarikat. Walaupun universiti tetap netral terhadap perkara visa, para kritik seperti Sophie Richardson daripada Human Rights Watch mempertimbangkan keputusan itu sebagai sebahagian daripada trend yang lebih luas untuk membungkam perbezaan pendapat dalam ruang akademik Hong Kong. Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, Hong Kong telah secara sistematik menghapuskan peringatan awam tentang peristiwa Tiananmen Square 1989: monumen seperti Pillar of Shame telah dipindahkan, muzium ditutup, dan buku-buku dipindahkan. Perubahan ini berikutan penerapan Undang-Undang Keselamatan Kebangsaan Beijing pada 2020, yang mengurangkan kebebasan yang dahulunya diterima di bawah 'satu negara, dua sistem'. Suara asing yang kritis terhadap Beijing—termasuk wartawan daripada Financial Times dan aktivis Benedict Rogers—juga telah diblok daripada memperbaharui visa mereka. Sebelum menyertai jabatan sejarah CUHK, He pernah mengajar di Harvard, Wellesley, dan Saint Michael’s College, dan masih berhubung dengan Pusat Fairbank untuk Kajian China di Harvard.

article_content: In March 2013, 21-year-old British Army Ranger Michael Maguire lost his life during a routine training exercise at Castlemartin in Wales — not in combat, but while sitting down to eat lunch in a zone declared safe. He had removed his helmet to enjoy a sandwich when a stray bullet, fired from over a kilometer away, struck him in the temple. The bullet, traveling at 680 miles per hour, had missed its intended target and ricocheted across sand dunes, killing him instantly. An official inquest revealed a cascade of errors: targets had been placed in dangerously misaligned positions, facing north instead of west, directly toward the lunch area. The officer in charge, Lieutenant Jonathan Price, had been flagged by his instructors just nine months earlier for lacking sufficient understanding of safety procedures — yet he was still certified to run live-fire drills. He later admitted he was unaware of these warnings and left the course feeling confident. Eyewitnesses described the moment in chilling detail: one soldier recalled hearing live rounds crack nearby, watching Maguire turn toward the noise, then collapse. The shooter, Ranger Peter Jones, said he had no idea anyone was in the line of fire. No senior officer was present to oversee the operation, and no safety checks were properly enforced. The jury delivered a verdict of unlawful killing, condemning the planning, setup, and execution of the exercise as deeply flawed. Michael’s family, devastated and bewildered, questioned how someone with documented deficiencies was entrusted with such responsibility — and why no one higher up intervened. They emphasized that their son and brother was a beloved soldier who had already survived dangerous deployments in Afghanistan, only to die needlessly on home soil. While investigations by the Royal Military Police and the Health and Safety Executive continue, the Maguire family is now campaigning for sweeping changes across the British Army. 'Nothing can bring Mike back,' said his brother Jimmy. 'But if we can stop this from happening to another family, then his death won’t have been in vain.'
translated_content: Pada Mac 2013, Ranger Tentera British berusia 21 tahun, Michael Maguire, kehilangan nyawanya semasa latihan rutin di Castlemartin, Wales — bukan dalam pertempuran, tetapi ketika duduk makan tengah hari di kawasan yang diisytiharkan selamat. Beliau telah menanggalkan topinya untuk menikmati sandwich apabila sebiji peluru tersasar, ditembak dari jarak lebih daripada satu kilometer, menghantam pelipisnya. Peluru itu, bergerak pada kelajuan 680 batu sejam, terlepas sasaran dan melintasi bukit pasir sebelum membunuhnya secara serta-merta. Sidang penyiasatan rasmi mengungkap satu rantai kesilapan: sasaran diletakkan dalam kedudukan yang salah, menghadap ke utara bukannya ke barat, terus ke arah kawasan makan tengah hari. Pegawai yang bertanggungjawab, Leftenan Jonathan Price, telah ditandakan oleh pensyarahnya sembilan bulan sebelum itu kerana kurang memahami prosedur keselamatan — namun beliau masih dikelayaki untuk mengendalikan latihan tembakan langsung. Beliau kemudian mengaku tidak mengetahui amaran ini dan meninggalkan kursus dengan rasa yakin. Saksi mata menerangkan momen itu dengan terperinci: seorang askar mengingat mendengar bunyi peluru hidup meletup berdekatan, memperhatikan Maguire berpaling ke arah bunyi, lalu roboh. Penembak, Ranger Peter Jones, berkata dia tidak tahu ada orang di garisan tembakan. Tiada pegawai kanan hadir untuk mengawasi operasi itu, dan tiada pemeriksaan keselamatan dilakukan dengan betul. Juri mengeluarkan keputusan pembunuhan tidak sah, mengutuk perancangan, persediaan, dan pelaksanaan latihan itu sebagai sangat cacat. Keluarga Maguire, hancur dan bingung, mempertanyakan bagaimana seseorang dengan kelemahan yang terdokumentasi boleh dipercayakan dengan tanggungjawab sedemikian — dan mengapa tiada siapa yang lebih tinggi turun tangan. Mereka menekankan bahawa anak dan abang mereka adalah askar yang disayangi yang telah selamat daripada penghantaran berbahaya di Afghanistan, hanya untuk mati secara sia-sia di tanah air sendiri. Sementara penyiasatan oleh Pasukan Penyiasatan Khas Tentera Diraja dan Eksekutif Kesihatan dan Keselamatan berterusan, keluarga Maguire kini mengadvokasi perubahan menyeluruh di seluruh Tentera British. 'Tiada apa-apa yang boleh membawa Mike kembali,' kata abangnya, Jimmy. 'Tetapi jika kita boleh menghentikan ini berlaku kepada keluarga lain, maka kematian beliau tidak akan sia-sia.'

article_content: Sgt. Robert Bales stands accused of murdering 16 unarmed Afghan civilians — men, women, and children — in the dead of night. Before this, he had completed three deployments in Iraq and was reportedly on his fourth. His legal team has suggested he may have been grappling with post-traumatic stress disorder or a traumatic brain injury, both common among veterans. But psychiatrists caution that while these conditions can lead to mood swings, irritability, or impaired judgment, they rarely, if ever, trigger mass slaughter. In fact, thousands of service members endure similar traumas without ever committing violent atrocities. The real question isn’t whether he was mentally ill — it’s why someone who seemed like a kind, respected member of his community could suddenly snap in such a horrific way. Some point to mania — a state of uncontrolled agitation — as a more plausible trigger than brain damage. Even rarer is the possibility of an undetected brain tumor, like the one found in Charles Whitman, who killed 16 people in 1966. Yet even that case was extraordinary. More telling may be the emerging details about Bales’ private life: reports of financial fraud and dishonest business practices. This paints a troubling picture — a man admired publicly, yet hiding darker behaviors behind closed doors. The tragedy forces us to confront a painful truth: sometimes, evil doesn’t come from illness. Sometimes, it comes from a person we thought we knew — but never really did.
translated_content: Sgt. Robert Bales didakwa membunuh 16 orang awam Afghanistan yang tidak bersenjata — lelaki, wanita, dan kanak-kanak — pada waktu malam. Sebelum kejadian ini, beliau telah menyelesaikan tiga penghantaran di Iraq dan dilaporkan sedang menjalani penghantaran keempat. Tim peguamnya mencadangkan beliau mungkin mengalami gangguan tekanan pasca-trauma atau cedera otak traumatis, kedua-duanya biasa di kalangan veteran. Tetapi pakar psikiatri berhati-hati bahawa sambil keadaan ini boleh menyebabkan perubahan suasana hati, mudah marah, atau penurunan penghakiman, ia jarang, jika ada pun, memicu pembunuhan beramai-ramai. Sebenarnya, ribuan anggota perkhidmatan mengalami trauma serupa tanpa pernah melakukan keganasan kejam. Pertanyaan sebenarnya bukan sama ada beliau sakit mental — tetapi mengapa seseorang yang kelihatan seperti ahli komuniti yang baik dan dihormati tiba-tiba bertindak dengan cara yang mengerikan? Sesetengah pihak menunjuk kepada mania — keadaan agitasi tanpa kawalan — sebagai pencetus yang lebih munasabah daripada cedera otak. Kemungkinan tumour otak yang tidak terdeteksi, seperti yang ditemui dalam kes Charles Whitman yang membunuh 16 orang pada tahun 1966, pula masih lebih jarang. Namun, kes itu sendiri adalah luar biasa. Lebih penting lagi adalah butiran yang muncul tentang kehidupan peribadi Bales: laporan mengenai penipuan kewangan dan amalan perniagaan yang tidak jujur. Ini melukiskan gambaran yang menggelisahkan — seorang lelaki yang dihormati secara awam, tetapi menyembunyikan tingkah laku gelap di sebalik pintu tertutup. Tragedi ini memaksa kita menghadapi kebenaran yang menyakitkan: kadang-kadang, kejahatan tidak datang dari penyakit. Kadang-kadang, ia datang dari seseorang yang kita sangka kita kenali — tetapi sebenarnya tidak pernah benar-benar kenali.

But experts say it’s far more likely he hid darkness beneath the surface. #TruthIsComplicated #PTSDNotAnExcuse #WarAndItsCosts

article_content: Peruvian authorities have arrested Jonathan Giraldo, 38, after he openly promoted himself as a hitman on his Facebook page — using his own face, real weapons, and photographs of cash. Adopting the alias 'Tony Garcia' and the nickname 'Anthrax,' Giraldo believed these personas would shield his identity. Instead, they made him easier to trace. His profile featured multiple videos and images of him holding firearms, including a silenced handgun, alongside stacks of money. In his bio, he proudly declared, 'On the streets, you learn more than in school,' and labeled himself 'The Most Wanted.' Police traced him to his home in Miraflores, a neighborhood in Lima, and apprehended him mid-update, as he added new claims about his alleged criminal exploits. According to police spokesman Leonidas Menendez, Giraldo is currently detained for illegal firearm possession. Authorities are still determining whether he is a dangerous assassin or merely someone living out a fantasy. Ballistic tests are underway on the seized weapons, and investigators are reviewing his financial records for any signs of illicit transactions.

Menggunakan nama samaran 'Tony Garcia' dan gelaran 'Anthrax', Giraldo percaya persona ini akan melindungi identitinya. Sebaliknya, ia menjadikan dia lebih mudah dilacak. Profilnya menampilkan beberapa video dan gambar dirinya memegang senjata api, termasuk senapang dengan alat peredam suara, bersama tumpukan wang. Dalam bio beliau, dia dengan bangga menyatakan, 'Di jalan raya, anda belajar lebih banyak daripada di sekolah,' dan menggelar dirinya 'Yang Paling Dicari'. Polis melacaknya ke rumahnya di Miraflores, sebuah kawasan di Lima, dan menangkapnya semasa dia sedang mengemas kini profil dengan dakwaan baru tentang ekspedisi kriminalnya. Menurut jurucakap polis Leonidas Menendez, Giraldo kini ditahan atas kesalahan kepemilikan senjata api secara tidak sah. Pihak berkuasa masih menentukan sama ada dia seorang pembunuh berbahaya atau hanya seseorang yang hidup dalam fantasi. Ujian balistik sedang dijalankan terhadap senjata yang dirampas, dan penyiasat sedang mengkaji rekod perbankannya untuk mencari tanda-tanda transaksi mencurigakan.

article_content: Documentary filmmaker Michael Moore stirred controversy on Sunday with a tweet declaring, 'Snipers aren't heroes,' as 'American Sniper' — the Oscar-nominated biopic of Navy SEAL Chris Kyle — topped the weekend box office. In a follow-up post, Moore clarified his stance: 'If you're on the roof of your home defending it from invaders who've come 7,000 miles, you're not a sniper — you're brave, you're a neighbor.' A long-time advocate for gun control, Moore’s views often provoke strong reactions. His remarks quickly drew criticism, including from former U.S. House Speaker Newt Gingrich, who challenged Moore to spend time with terrorist groups overseas before commenting on the value of snipers. Meanwhile, 'American Sniper,' starring Bradley Cooper and directed by Clint Eastwood, earned $105 million in its opening weekend — the highest January opening ever — and garnered six Academy Award nominations, including Best Picture. The film's success continued into the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday Monday. Other Hollywood figures also weighed in: actor Seth Rogen compared the film to Nazi propaganda, as depicted in Quentin Tarantino’s 'Inglourious Basterds.' Based on Kyle’s bestselling memoir, the film portrays him as 'America's deadliest sniper.' However, Kyle’s legacy is complex: his book includes disputed claims, such as punching former Minnesota Governor Jesse Ventura — a claim later ruled defamatory in a 2017 civil trial — and killing two armed carjackers. Kyle was fatally shot by a veteran suffering from PTSD in 2013.

Dalam posting seterusnya, Moore mengklarifikasikan pandangannya: 'Jika awak berada di atas atap rumah awak mempertahankannya daripada penjajah yang datang sejauh 7,000 batu, awak bukan penembak jitu — awak berani, awak tetangga.' Sebagai penyokong lama keselamatan senjata yang lebih ketat, pandangan Moore sering memicu reaksi kuat. Komen beliau dengan cepat mendapat kritikan, termasuk daripada bekas Speaker Dewan Perwakilan AS Newt Gingrich, yang menantang Moore untuk menghabiskan masa bersama kumpulan pengganas di luar negara sebelum memberi ulasan tentang nilai penembak jitu. Sementara itu, 'American Sniper,' yang dibintangi oleh Bradley Cooper dan diarahkan oleh Clint Eastwood, menghasilkan $105 juta dalam akhir pekan pembukaannya — rekod tertinggi untuk pembukaan bulan Januari — dan menerima enam pencalonan Anugerah Akademi, termasuk Filem Terbaik. Kejayaan filem ini berterusan ke hari Isnin, hari cuti Martin Luther King Jr. Tokoh lain di Hollywood juga memberi pendapat: pelakon Seth Rogen membandingkan filem ini dengan propaganda Nazi, seperti yang digambarkan dalam 'Inglourious Basterds' arahan Quentin Tarantino. Berdasarkan memoar best-seller Kyle, filem ini menggambarkannya sebagai 'penembak jitu paling mematikan di Amerika.' Namun, warisan Kyle adalah kompleks: bukunya mengandungi tuntutan yang dipertikaikan, seperti memukul mantan Gubernur Minnesota Jesse Ventura — tuntutan yang kemudiannya diputuskan sebagai pencemaran nama dalam satu kes sivil tahun 2017 — dan membunuh dua orang yang mencuri kereta bersenjata. Kyle dibunuh secara mematikan oleh seorang veteran yang mengalami PTSD pada tahun 2013.

article_content: By Madlen Davies for MailOnline. Yvonne Pickford, 55, was struck by her daughter’s sledge during a family ski trip in Valmorel, France — and in checking herself for bruises, discovered lumps in her breasts that were later confirmed as malignant. A mother of three, Pickford, a theatre nurse at Birmingham’s Queen Elizabeth Hospital, credits her six-year-old daughter Jenii Quigley with saving her life. After Jenii crashed into her at the bottom of the slope, Pickford decided to examine her body for injuries. Though she usually performs self-checks, she had neglected them recently. That night, she felt unusual lumps on both breasts and contacted her GP immediately upon returning home. Tests revealed two malignant lumps on her right breast and one on her left. Doctors confirmed the cancer was advancing rapidly. Pickford, who was diagnosed in 2003, underwent chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Since then, she has raised more than £15,000 for Cancer Research UK. Now, she is fronting the charity’s new campaign, 'Stand Up For Cancer,' in collaboration with Channel 4. She has run marathons and cycled across India to support the cause. 'I believe wholeheartedly in research,' she says. 'Not everyone survives. That’s why I want to get people standing up to cancer right now.' The campaign includes a nationwide March on Cancer on October 11, with Birmingham among 15 selected cities, followed by a live TV fundraiser on October 17. For more information, visit www.standuptocancer.org.uk.

Seorang ibu kepada tiga orang anak, Pickford, seorang jururawat teater di Hospital Queen Elizabeth, Birmingham, menganggap anaknya yang berumur enam tahun, Jenii Quigley, telah menyelamatkan nyawanya. Selepas Jenii merempuhnya di bahagian bawah bukit, Pickford memutuskan untuk memeriksa tubuhnya bagi mencari kecederaan. Walaupun biasanya dia melakukan pemeriksaan sendiri, beliau telah melupakan perkara itu selama beberapa masa. Malam itu, beliau merasai benjolan tidak biasa di kedua-dua payudara dan menghubungi doktor perubatan umum segera apabila pulang ke rumah. Itu sebabnya saya ingin mendapat orang-orang bangkit melawan kanser sekarang.' Kampanye ini termasuk March on Cancer secara nasional pada 11 Oktober, dengan Birmingham antara 15 bandar yang dipilih, diikuti oleh pembiayaan langsung di televisyen pada 17 Oktober. article_content: On the evening of May 6, 2013, Amanda Berry—then 24 and a survivor of a decade-long captivity—managed to escape from a house on Seymour Avenue in Cleveland. She ran across the street, grabbed a neighbor’s phone, and dialed 911. Her voice, trembling and frantic, told the dispatcher: 'I’ve been kidnapped. I’ve been missing for ten years. I’m free now.' But instead of offering comfort or staying on the line, the dispatcher repeatedly responded with detached phrases like, 'Talk to the police when they get there,' and asked routine questions about her captor’s age, ethnicity, and clothing—even as Berry sobbed in the background and pleaded for immediate help. Within four minutes, police arrived at the scene. They found Berry, along with two other women—Gina DeJesus and Michelle Knight—who had also been held captive for nearly ten years. Berry’s six-year-old daughter was with them. All were rushed to the hospital. The 911 call, later made public, sparked national outrage. Experts and fellow dispatchers, including Sandy Zuerlein of Kenosha County, said the operator should have kept Berry on the line, calming her and gathering critical details while waiting for responders. 'If he came back, we could have warned the officers,' Zuerlein said. Though Cleveland officials emphasized that police arrived in under two minutes—a response time they called 'excellent'—they acknowledged the dispatcher failed to provide essential emotional support or follow best practices for crisis calls. The department announced a formal review, noting that while procedures were technically followed, humanity was not. Ariel Castro, the man who held the women captive, and his two brothers were arrested shortly after. The case exposed deep flaws in how emergency systems handle trauma survivors, even when the facts are unmistakably urgent.
translated_content: Pada petang 6 Mei 2013, Amanda Berry—yang ketika itu berumur 24 tahun dan seorang selamat daripada penahanan selama sepuluh tahun—berjaya melarikan diri dari sebuah rumah di Seymour Avenue, Cleveland. Dia berlari menyeberang jalan, mengambil telefon jiran, dan memanggil 911. Suaranya, bergoncang dan panik, berkata kepada operator: 'Saya telah diculik. Saya telah hilang selama sepuluh tahun. Saya bebas sekarang.' Tetapi, alih-alih memberi sokongan atau mengekalkan panggilan, operator itu berulang kali merespon dengan frasa yang dingin seperti, 'Bercakaplah dengan polis apabila mereka tiba,' dan bertanya soalan rutin mengenai umur, etnik, dan pakaian penculiknya—walaupun Berry menangis di latar belakang dan memohon bantuan segera. Dalam masa empat minit, polis tiba di tempat kejadian. Mereka menemui Berry, bersama dua wanita lain—Gina DeJesus dan Michelle Knight—yang juga telah ditahan selama hampir sepuluh tahun. Anak perempuan Berry yang berumur enam tahun turut ditemui. Semua mereka dibawa ke hospital. Panggilan 911 itu, yang kemudian dipaparkan secara awam, menimbulkan kemarahan nasional. Pakar dan operator lain, termasuk Sandy Zuerlein dari Kenosha County, berkata operator seharusnya mengekalkan Berry di talian, menenangkannya, dan mengumpul maklumat penting sambil menunggu responder tiba. 'Jika dia kembali, kita boleh beri amaran kepada pasukan polis,' kata Zuerlein. Walaupun pejabat Cleveland menekankan bahawa polis tiba dalam masa kurang daripada dua minit—jangka masa yang mereka anggap 'cemerlang'—mereka mengakui operator gagal memberi sokongan emosi penting atau mengikuti amalan terbaik untuk panggilan krisis. Jabatan itu mengumumkan tinjauan rasmi, mencatat bahawa walaupun prosedur secara teknikal dipatuhi, kemanusiaan tidak dipertimbangkan. Ariel Castro, lelaki yang menahan ketiga-tiga wanita itu, bersama dua saudaranya ditangkap tidak lama selepas itu. Kes ini mendedahkan kelemahan mendalam dalam cara sistem kecemasan menangani pesakit trauma, walaupun fakta-faktanya jelas sangat mendesak.

article_content: The U.S. State Department has advised Americans against traveling to the Libyan city of Benghazi—even after Britain, Germany, and the Netherlands urged their citizens to leave immediately due to what was described as an imminent threat against Westerners. The U.S. referenced a pre-existing travel advisory issued earlier this month and declined to elevate its warning, despite European nations describing the threat as specific and imminent—though none provided details about its nature. According to sources cited by the Independent, British officials linked the latest threats to Al-Qaida in the Islamic Maghreb (AQIM), an offshoot of the group responsible for last week’s hostage crisis in Algeria that ended with the deaths of 37 Westerners and 29 Islamists. The threat is also reportedly connected to one of AQIM’s offshoots in Libya, Ansar al-Sharia, which fled Benghazi following the September 11, 2012, attack on the U.S. consulate that killed Ambassador Chris Stevens. The warnings come a day after U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Rodham Clinton testified before Congress about the deadly 2012 attack, which claimed the lives of four Americans. They also coincide with ongoing French military operations against Al-Qaida-linked militants in Mali. While the State Department sought to downplay the threat, insisting there was 'no specific information pointing to specific, imminent threats against U.S. citizens,' it acknowledged that the risks of kidnapping and targeted violence remain 'significant.' The updated advisory urged Americans to review personal safety plans, remain aware of their surroundings—including local events—and monitor local news for updates. It also advised maintaining a high level of vigilance and taking appropriate steps to enhance personal security. Britain and Germany urged their nationals still in Benghazi to depart immediately. Dutch Foreign Ministry spokesman Thijs van Son stated that 'staying in this area is not advisable.' It was unclear how many people might be affected; the UK estimated 'dozens' of its citizens remained in the city, while the Netherlands confirmed four registered Dutch nationals in Benghazi, with possibly two more. Secretary of State Clinton testified yesterday regarding the September 11, 2012, attack that killed U.S. Ambassador Christopher Stevens and three others. Several countries have advised against all travel to Benghazi for months, particularly after the consulate attack. Local residents report that many foreigners have already departed in recent weeks. Benghazi, a city of approximately one million people, serves as a business hub hosting many Western professionals. It was also the birthplace of the 2011 Libyan uprising against longtime dictator Moammar Gadhafi, whose overthrow—backed by NATO—left Libya struggling with persistent instability. Al-Qaida-linked militants and other Islamist groups operate freely across the country. Adel Mansouri, principal of the International School of Benghazi, said British and other foreign nationals were warned two days ago of a potential threat. Although staff were offered the option to leave, most chose to remain. The school has around 540 students, mostly Libyan, with roughly 40% holding dual nationality. Fewer than 5% are British; 10–15 students have U.S.-Libyan dual citizenship, Mansouri said. Classes were scheduled to resume Sunday after a holiday. 'We told the British ambassador we are staying, and we’ll be in touch,' said Mansouri, a Libyan-British dual national. 'We don’t see a threat on the ground.' Saleh Gawdat, a Benghazi lawmaker, said French medical staff working in local hospitals have left, and the French cultural center has closed due to fears of retaliation over France’s military intervention in Mali, which began two weeks ago. Violence in Benghazi has targeted both foreigners and Libyan officials in recent months, including assassinations and bombings. Besides the 2012 consulate attack, militants fired on the car of Italian diplomat Guido De Sanctis earlier this month. Though uninjured, he was forced to evacuate as Italy suspended consular operations. Islamist extremists are often blamed for attacks on former Gadhafi-era security personnel, seen as retribution for past torture and imprisonment. Some residents also suspect Gadhafi loyalists are inciting violence to destabilize Libya’s new government. Ibrahim Sahd, a Benghazi-based politician, suggested the government’s plan to strengthen security may have alarmed Westerners fearing a backlash. Noman Benotman, a former Libyan jihadist turned analyst at London’s Quilliam Foundation, noted that nearly a dozen attacks against Western targets have occurred in Libya recently, driven by the same Al-Qaida ideology. However, he added that militants are unlikely to target oil or gas facilities, as doing so would alienate the local population they rely on for support. Oil companies operating elsewhere in Libya said they were aware of the warnings but had no immediate plans for evacuation.

AS merujuk pada nasihat perjalanan yang dikeluarkan awal bulan ini dan tidak memperkuat peringatannya, walaupun negara-negara Eropa menggambarkan ancaman itu sebagai spesifik dan segera—namun tanpa memberikan rincian tentang sifatnya. Menurut sumber yang dikutip oleh Independent, pejabat Britania Raya menghubungkan ancaman terbaru dengan Al-Qaida di Maghrib Islamik (AQIM), cabang dari kelompok yang bertanggung jawab atas krisis sandera minggu lalu di Aljazair yang berakhir dengan kematian 37 orang Barat dan 29 Islamis. Ancaman itu juga dilaporkan terkait dengan salah satu cabang AQIM di Libya, Ansar al-Sharia, yang melarikan diri dari Benghazi setelah serangan 11 September 2012 terhadap konsulat AS yang menewaskan Duta Besar Chris Stevens. Peringatan ini muncul sehari setelah Menteri Luar Negeri AS Hillary Rodham Clinton bersaksi di Kongres mengenai serangan mematikan tahun 2012 yang menewaskan empat orang Amerika. Peringatan ini juga bersamaan dengan operasi militer Prancis yang sedang berlangsung melawan militan yang terkait Al-Qaida di Mali. Nasihat terbaru menyarankan warga AS untuk meninjau rencana keselamatan pribadi, tetap waspada terhadap lingkungan sekitar—termasuk peristiwa lokal—and memantau stasiun berita lokal untuk pembaruan. Pemerintah juga menyarankan untuk menjaga tingkat kewaspadaan tinggi dan mengambil langkah-langkah tepat untuk meningkatkan keamanan pribadi. Tidak jelas berapa banyak orang yang terkena dampak; Kantor Luar Negeri Inggris memperkirakan 'puluhan' warganya masih berada di kota itu, sementara Kementerian Luar Negeri Belanda mengonfirmasi empat warga Belanda terdaftar di Benghazi, dengan kemungkinan dua lagi. Menteri Luar Negeri Clinton bersaksi kemarin mengenai serangan 11 September 2012 yang menewaskan Duta Besar AS Christopher Stevens dan tiga orang lainnya. Beberapa negara telah menyarankan agar semua perjalanan ke Benghazi dihindari selama berbulan-bulan, terutama setelah serangan terhadap konsulat. Penduduk setempat melaporkan bahwa banyak orang asing telah meninggalkan kota dalam beberapa minggu terakhir. Benghazi, kota dengan populasi sekitar satu juta orang, merupakan pusat bisnis tempat banyak profesional Barat bekerja. Kota ini juga menjadi tempat lahirnya pemberontakan Libya 2011 melawan diktator lama Moammar Gadhafi, yang penggulingannya—didukung NATO—meninggalkan Libya bergumul dengan ketidakstabilan yang berkelanjutan. Militan yang terkait Al-Qaida dan kelompok Islamis lainnya beroperasi secara bebas di seluruh negeri. Adel Mansouri, kepala Sekolah Internasional Benghazi, mengatakan bahwa warga asing Britania dan lainnya diberi peringatan dua hari lalu tentang potensi ancaman. Meskipun staf diberi pilihan untuk pergi, kebanyakan memilih untuk tetap tinggal. Sekolah ini memiliki sekitar 540 siswa, sebagian besar warga Libya, dengan sekitar 40% memegang kewarganegaraan ganda. Kurang dari 5% adalah warga Britania; 10–15 siswa memiliki kewarganegaraan ganda AS-Libya, kata Mansouri. Kelas dijadwalkan dimulai ulang pada Minggu setelah libur Kamis. 'Kami memberitahu duta besar Britania kami akan tetap tinggal, dan akan tetap berhubungan,' kata Mansouri, seorang warga negara ganda Libya-Britania. 'Kami tidak melihat ancaman di lapangan.' Saleh Gawdat, anggota parlemen Benghazi, mengatakan staf medis Prancis yang bekerja di rumah sakit Benghazi telah pergi, dan pusat budaya Prancis telah ditutup karena khawatir akan pembalasan atas intervensi militer Prancis di Mali, yang dimulai dua minggu lalu. Kekerasan di Benghazi telah menargetkan baik orang asing maupun pejabat Libya dalam beberapa bulan terakhir, termasuk pembunuhan dan pengeboman. Selain serangan 2012 terhadap konsulat AS, militan menembaki mobil duta besar Italia Guido De Sanctis awal bulan ini. Meski tidak terluka, ia dipaksa dievakuasi ketika Italia menangguhkan operasi konsuler mereka. Ekstremis Islamis sering disalahkan atas serangan terhadap personel keamanan era Gadhafi, yang dianggap sebagai balas dendam atas penyiksaan atau penahanan masa lalu. Sebagian penduduk juga menyalahkan para pendukung Gadhafi yang dituduh memicu kekerasan untuk melemahkan pemerintah baru Libya. Ibrahim Sahd, seorang politisi berbasis Benghazi, menyarankan bahwa rencana pemerintah untuk memperkuat keamanan mungkin membuat orang Barat khawatir akan reaksi balik. Noman Benotman, mantan jihadis Libya yang kini menjadi analis di Quilliam Foundation London, mencatat bahwa hampir selusin serangan telah terjadi terhadap target Barat di Libya baru-baru ini, didorong oleh ideologi Al-Qaida yang sama. Namun, ia menambahkan bahwa militan tidak mungkin menargetkan instalasi minyak atau gas, karena hal itu akan menjauhkan penduduk lokal yang mereka andalkan untuk dukungan. Perusahaan minyak yang beroperasi di bagian lain Libya mengatakan mereka menyadari peringatan pemerintah tetapi belum memiliki rencana evakuasi segera.

article_content: SpaceX’s Starlink and T-Mobile have teamed up to bring text messaging directly to mobile phones—no cell tower needed. Using a network of satellites in low Earth orbit, people in remote and rural areas will soon be able to send and receive texts even where traditional networks don’t reach. A limited beta test begins before the end of 2023, with full voice, data, and Internet of Things (IoT) services planned for 2025. More than half a dozen global carriers—including Canada’s Rogers, Australia’s Optus, New Zealand’s One NZ, Japan’s KDDI, and Switzerland’s Salt—are already on board to help roll out this service worldwide. The magic behind it? Each satellite carries a special modem called an eNodeB, which functions like a cell tower floating in space. It taps into existing wireless frequencies licensed in each country to deliver fast, low-delay connections right to your phone. Later this decade, SpaceX plans to switch from launching these satellites on Falcon 9 rockets to the much larger Starship, which can carry dozens more per flight—making global coverage faster and cheaper. Once in orbit, the satellites link to each other using high-speed laser beams, forming a seamless space-based internet backbone. Beyond texting and calling, the system will also support IoT devices like farm sensors, emergency trackers, and environmental monitors—all using standard LTE signals so no extra hardware is needed. This could transform how industries operate in isolated regions, from agriculture to disaster response. For millions living beyond the reach of fiber or cell towers, this isn’t just an upgrade—it’s a lifeline to the digital world.

Ujian beta terhad dibuka sebelum akhir 2023, dengan perkhidmatan suara, data, dan Internet of Things (IoT) penuh dirancang pada tahun 2025. Lebih daripada separuh lusin pembekal telekomunikasi global—termasuk Rogers dari Kanada, Optus dari Australia, One NZ dari New Zealand, KDDI dari Jepun, dan Salt dari Switzerland—sudah menyertai untuk membantu melaksanakan perkhidmatan ini secara global. Apakah rahsia di sebaliknya? Setiap satelit membawa modem khas bernama eNodeB, yang berfungsi seperti menara selular yang melayang di angkasa. Ia memanfaatkan frekuensi wayarles yang dilisensikan di setiap negara untuk memberikan sambungan pantas dan rendah latensi terus ke telefon anda. Pada dekad ini, SpaceX merancang untuk beralih dari melancarkan satelit-satelit ini menggunakan roket Falcon 9 kepada Starship yang jauh lebih besar, yang boleh membawa puluhan lagi per penerbangan—membuat cakupan global lebih pantas dan lebih murah. Selepas berada dalam orbit, satelit-satelit itu akan saling menghubungkan menggunakan sinar laser berkelajuan tinggi, membentuk tulang belakang internet angkasa yang lancar. Selain mesej teks dan panggilan suara, sistem ini juga akan menyokong peranti IoT seperti sensor pertanian, penjejak kecemasan, dan pemantau persekitaran—semuanya menggunakan protokol LTE piawai tanpa perlu peralatan tambahan. Ini boleh mengubah cara industri beroperasi di kawasan terpencil, dari pertanian hingga tindakan bencana. Bagi jutaan orang yang tinggal di luar jangkauan gentian atau menara selular, ini bukan sekadar peningkatan—ia adalah jalan hidup kepada dunia digital.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) — The family of a British soldier returning from Afghanistan has been forced to leave their home after a camel spider, believed to have stowed away on his belongings, allegedly caused the death of their pet dog. While camel spider bites are not fatal to humans, they can be lethal to small animals. Lorraine Griffiths and her three children — aged 18, 16, and 4 — have vacated their house in Colchester, southeast England, and refuse to return until the spider is found, according to the UK Press Association. Griffiths told the East Anglian Daily Times the spider appeared shortly after her husband, Rodney, completed a four-month deployment in Helmand Province, a volatile region in southern Afghanistan. 'My son Ricky was searching for his underwear in my bedroom drawer when something crawled across his hand,' she said. Their dog, Cassie, encountered the creature and fled, whimpering after it hissed. 'It feels like too much of a coincidence that she died right after we saw the spider,' Griffiths added. Though commonly called a camel spider, this creature is not a true spider but a solifuge — a desert-dwelling arachnid relative known for its speed (up to 25 km/h or 15 mph) and size (up to 15 cm or 6 inches). Its bite, while painful and dangerous to small pets, poses no serious threat to humans.

Gigitan laba-laba unta tidak mematikan kepada manusia tetapi boleh mematikan kepada haiwan kecil. Lorraine Griffiths dan tiga orang anaknya — berumur 18, 16, dan 4 tahun — telah meninggalkan rumah mereka di Colchester, England tenggara, dan menolak untuk kembali sehingga laba-laba itu ditemui, menurut UK Press Association. 'Anak saya Ricky sedang mencari seluar dalamnya di laci bilik tidur saya apabila sesuatu merangkak di atas tangannya,' katanya. Anjing mereka, Cassie, bertemu makhluk itu dan lari sambil mengilat setelah ia mendesis. 'Rasanya terlalu banyak kebetulan bahawa dia mati tepat selepas kami melihat laba-laba itu,' kata Griffiths. Walaupun biasa dipanggil laba-laba unta, makhluk ini bukan laba-laba sebenar tetapi solifugae — kerabat arakhnida yang hidup di padang pasir, dikenali dengan kelajuan (hingga 25 km/j atau 15 mph) dan saiz (hingga 15 cm atau 6 inci). Gigitannya, walaupun menyakitkan dan berbahaya kepada haiwan kecil, tidak membahayakan manusia.

article_content: Some call them a secret brotherhood; others see them as living mystics. The Mevlevis — widely known as Whirling Dervishes — describe their practice as a sacred crossing between the material and the divine. 'To die before you die,' says Celaleddin Loras, a Mevlevi Sheikh, 'is the real goal: to dissolve the ego. That’s why we wear white — the color of burial shrouds — and our tall hats? They’re shaped like tombstones.' Their ritual, called sema, dates back to the 1200s and was founded by the poet Rumi in Konya. It’s more than dance — it’s prayer in motion. With one hand raised to receive divine light and the other lowered to share it with the earth, the Dervishes believe they become conduits between heaven and humanity. Every Sunday, different branches of the order gather at the historic Galata Mevlevihanesi in Istanbul. On the day CNN visited, two teenagers — aged 14 and 15 — performed their first public sema. Unlike elders who wear traditional brown hats, these young initiates don white felt ones, marking their entry into lifelong spiritual discipline. Learning to whirl isn’t easy. 'It takes about half a year,' explains Sahin Naci Sair, the sema leader. 'And not everyone can do it. You need music, rhythm, and above all — true belief.' In 2005, UNESCO honored sema as a cultural treasure. Yet in Turkey, the Mevlevis operate under legal shadows. After the republic was founded in 1923, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk outlawed all Sufi groups under Law 677. Though public performances were quietly allowed in the 1950s, officials insist it’s for tourism — not religious expression. Private worship remains banned. Today, donations from visitors keep the tradition alive. The biggest gathering happens every December in Konya, at the Seb-i-Arus festival, where hundreds gather to witness the ritual. Tickets go on sale each year in November. At the start of each sema, participants stand with arms crossed and feet turned inward — a gesture of humility, echoing Rumi’s teaching that true transformation begins within. Ilyas Noyan Ozatik, who plays the ney (reed flute), says the music doesn’t just accompany the dance — it unites souls. 'We’re not moving our bodies,' he says. 'We’re aligning our spirits.' When asked about conflict in the Middle East, Loras quotes an old British proverb: 'If you want a clean street, every shopkeeper must clean his own doorstep.' For the Mevlevis, peace isn’t negotiated — it’s cultivated, one heart at a time. As they spin, eyes closed, robes swirling like clouds, they aren’t performing for spectators. They’re praying — silently, endlessly — for the world.
translated_content: Ada yang menyebut mereka persaudaraan rahasia; yang lain melihat mereka sebagai mistikus hidup. Para Mevlevi — dikenal luas sebagai Dervis Berputar — menggambarkan praktik mereka sebagai perlintasan suci antara dunia material dan ilahi. 'Untuk mati sebelum benar-benar mati,' kata Celaleddin Loras, seorang Sheikh Mevlevi, 'adalah tujuan sejati: melepaskan ego. Itulah sebabnya kami memakai warna putih — warna kain kafan — dan topi tinggi kami? Bentuknya seperti nisan.' Ritual mereka, disebut sema, berasal dari abad ke-13 dan didirikan oleh penyair Rumi di Konya. Ini lebih dari sekadar tarian — ini doa dalam gerakan. Dengan satu tangan terangkat untuk menerima cahaya ilahi dan tangan lainnya diturunkan untuk membagikannya ke bumi, para Dervis percaya mereka menjadi saluran antara surga dan manusia. Setiap Minggu, cabang-cabang berbeda dari ordo ini berkumpul di Galata Mevlevihanesi yang bersejarah di Istanbul. Pada hari CNN mengunjungi, dua remaja — berusia 14 dan 15 tahun — melakukan sema publik pertama mereka. Berbeda dengan orang tua yang memakai topi cokelat tradisional, para inisiator muda ini mengenakan topi felt putih, menandai dimulainya disiplin spiritual seumur hidup. Belajar berputar tidaklah mudah. 'Butuh sekitar enam bulan,' jelas Sahin Naci Sair, pemimpin sema. 'Dan tidak semua orang bisa melakukannya. Anda butuh musik, irama, dan yang paling penting — keyakinan sejati.' Pada 2005, UNESCO menghormati sema sebagai harta budaya takbenda. Namun di Turki, para Mevlevi beroperasi di bawah bayang-bayang hukum. Setelah republik didirikan pada 1923, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk melarang semua kelompok Sufi melalui Undang-Undang 677. Meskipun pertunjukan publik secara diam-diam diizinkan pada 1950-an, pejabat bersikeras bahwa itu demi pariwisata — bukan ekspresi agama. Ibadah pribadi tetap dilarang. Saat ini, sumbangan dari pengunjung menjaga tradisi ini tetap hidup. Pertemuan terbesar terjadi setiap Desember di Konya, pada festival Seb-i-Arus, di mana ratusan orang berkumpul menyaksikan ritual ini. Tiket mulai dijual setiap tahun pada bulan November. Di awal setiap sema, peserta berdiri dengan lengan terlipat dan kaki menghadap ke dalam — sikap kerendahan hati, mencerminkan ajaran Rumi bahwa transformasi sejati dimulai dari dalam. Ilyas Noyan Ozatik, yang memainkan ney (seruling buluh), mengatakan musik tidak hanya mengiringi tarian — ia menyatukan jiwa. 'Kami tidak hanya menggerakkan tubuh,' katanya. 'Kami menyelaraskan roh kami.' Ketika ditanya tentang konflik di Timur Tengah, Loras mengutip pepatah Inggris lama: 'Jika Anda ingin jalan yang bersih, setiap penjual toko harus membersihkan depan tokonya sendiri.' Bagi para Mevlevi, perdamaian bukanlah negosiasi — ia dibudidayakan, satu hati pada satu waktu. Saat mereka berputar, mata tertutup, jubah mereka bergelora seperti awan, mereka tidak sedang tampil untuk penonton. Mereka sedang berdoa — diam-diam, tanpa henti — untuk dunia.

article_content: For those committed to a low-carbohydrate lifestyle, bread has long been seen as the ultimate temptation — even the enemy. But a new product from Waitrose might change that. Introducing LivLife: a high-protein, low-carb bread designed to let calorie-conscious consumers enjoy sandwiches and toast without the guilt. Marketed as a groundbreaking innovation, LivLife replaces traditional wheat flour with natural protein sources like soya flour, seeds, and whole grains. According to Waitrose, this loaf contains 50% fewer carbohydrates than standard bread — just 14.6g per 100g in the Seriously Seeded variant, compared to the typical 42.7g. Each slice delivers 67 calories, undercutting Kingsmill 50/50 (103 cal) and Hovis Soft White (116 cal). Natalie McAdam, a nutritionist involved in developing LivLife, notes that while carbohydrates have been unfairly vilified, bread remains a staple in British households. 'We’re a nation of sandwich lovers,' she says. 'It’s the one carb people refuse to give up.' The trend resonates with high-profile followers: the Duchess of Cambridge reportedly followed a low-carb, high-protein diet ahead of her wedding, and actress Gwyneth Paltrow avoids giving bread to her children, citing health concerns. Nicholas & Harris, the company behind LivLife, estimates that 40% of UK adults are actively reducing carb intake. With Germany’s low-carb bread market valued at £65 million, the firm anticipates similar growth in Britain — and has already set sights on launching a low-carb pasta line next year. Still, the NHS advises that starchy foods — including bread, rice, pasta, and potatoes — should make up roughly one-third of daily meals for balanced nutrition.
translated_content: Bagi mereka yang berkomitmen kepada gaya hidup rendah karbohidrat, roti telah lama dilihat sebagai godaan terakhir — bahkan musuh. Tetapi produk baru dari Waitrose mungkin mengubahnya. Memperkenalkan LivLife: roti tinggi protein dan rendah karbohidrat yang direka untuk membolehkan pengguna yang prihatin dengan kalori menikmati sandwich dan roti panggang tanpa rasa bersalah. Dipasarkan sebagai inovasi revolusioner, LivLife menggantikan tepung gandum tradisional dengan sumber protein semula jadi seperti tepung soya, biji-bijian, dan bijirin utuh. Menurut Waitrose, roti ini mengandungi 50% lebih sedikit karbohidrat daripada roti biasa — hanya 14.6g per 100g dalam varian Seriously Seeded, berbanding 42.7g biasa. Setiap helaian memberi 67 kalori, lebih rendah daripada Kingsmill 50/50 (103 kal) dan Hovis Soft White (116 kal). Natalie McAdam, seorang pakar nutrisi yang terlibat dalam pembangunan LivLife, mencatat bahawa walaupun karbohidrat telah disalahkan secara tidak adil, roti tetap menjadi makanan asas dalam rumah tangga British. 'Kita adalah bangsa yang gemar sandwich,' katanya. 'Ia adalah satu-satunya karbohidrat yang orang enggan tinggalkan.' Trend ini selari dengan pengikut terkenal: Duchess of Cambridge dilaporkan mengikuti diet rendah karbohidrat dan tinggi protein sebelum perkahwinannya, dan pelakon Gwyneth Paltrow mengelakkan memberi roti kepada anak-anaknya, dengan alasan kesihatan. Nicholas & Harris, syarikat di sebalik LivLife, menganggarkan bahawa 40% orang dewasa di UK aktif mengurangkan pengambilan karbohidrat. Dengan pasaran roti rendah karbohidrat Jerman bernilai £65 juta, syarikat itu mengjangkakan pertumbuhan serupa di Britain — dan telah menetapkan matlamat untuk melancarkan barisan pasta rendah karbohidrat tahun depan. Namun, NHS menasihatkan bahawa makanan bertepung — termasuk roti, nasi, mi, dan ubi kentang — sepatutnya membentuk kira-kira sepertiga daripada jumlah makanan harian untuk nutrisi seimbang.

article_content: Former U.S. House Speaker Tom Foley has died at the age of 84, according to Democratic sources in Washington. A respected figure in American politics, Foley made history as the first Speaker of the House since the Civil War to lose re-election in his home district — a fate sealed during the 1994 Republican Revolution when he was defeated by Republican attorney George Nethercutt. A Democrat from Washington state, Foley served 30 years in the House of Representatives, including more than five as Speaker from 1989 to 1995. He never spent a single day in the minority before his 1994 defeat. After leaving Congress, he served as U.S. Ambassador to Japan under President Bill Clinton from 1997 to 2001. House Speaker John Boehner (R-OH) honored Foley with a heartfelt statement, calling him a 'beloved former colleague' and praising his integrity, warmth, and unwavering sense of fairness. 'He endeared himself not only to wheat farmers back home but also colleagues on both sides of the aisle,' Boehner said, quoting Republican Henry Hyde, who once remarked, 'I wish he were a Republican.' Foley, born and raised in Spokane, was first elected to Congress in 1964. His leadership roles included Chairman of the Agriculture Committee, Majority Whip, and Majority Leader before becoming the 57th Speaker. President Clinton and Vice President Al Gore shared memorable moments with him, including a 1993 joint address to Congress. Boehner extended condolences to Foley’s wife, Heather, a longtime friend of the House, and affirmed that Foley would be deeply missed by colleagues and the nation alike.

Seorang Demokrat dari negara bagian Washington, Foley melayani selama 30 tahun di Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat, termasuk lebih dari lima tahun sebagai Pembicara dari 1989 hingga 1995. Ia tidak pernah menghabiskan satu hari pun di minoritas sebelum kekalahan tahun 1994-nya. Setelah meninggalkan Kongres, ia menjabat sebagai Duta Besar AS untuk Jepang di bawah Presiden Bill Clinton dari 1997 hingga 2001. Pembicara Dewan John Boehner (R-OH) memuji Foley dengan pernyataan yang tulus, menyebutnya sebagai 'rekan tercinta yang sudah pensiun' dan memuji integritas, kehangatan, serta rasa keadilannya yang tak goyah. 'Ia menyenangkan hati tidak hanya para petani gandum di rumah tetapi juga rekan-rekannya di kedua sisi lorong,' kata Boehner, mengutip pengacara Republikan Henry Hyde, yang pernah berkomentar, 'Saya berharap dia menjadi Republikan.' Foley, yang lahir dan dibesarkan di Spokane, pertama kali terpilih ke Kongres pada tahun 1964. Peran kepemimpinannya mencakup Ketua Komite Pertanian, Wakil Mayoritas, dan Pemimpin Mayoritas sebelum menjadi Pembicara ke-57. Presiden Clinton dan Wakil Presiden Al Gore berbagi momen-momen kenangan dengannya, termasuk pidato bersama di Kongres pada tahun 1993. Boehner menyampaikan belasungkawa kepada istri Foley, Heather, seorang teman lama Dewan, dan menegaskan bahwa Foley akan sangat dirindukan oleh rekan-rekannya dan bangsa ini.

article_content: The scorer of the most important goal in Chelsea’s history — that’s how Jose Mourinho described Didier Drogba this week. On Friday, a deal was finalized to bring him back to his spiritual football home. Didier Drogba is a Blue once more. At 36, his physical powers may have diminished slightly, but Drogba remains invaluable to a manager with Mourinho’s ambitions. His leadership, experience, and winning mentality are assets that younger players can learn from. Drogba has signed a one-year contract, consistent with Chelsea’s policy for veteran players. He completed his medical and put pen to paper on Friday. Mourinho, who revealed his intent to re-sign Drogba in Austria on Thursday, said on Friday: 'He’s coming because he’s one of the best strikers in Europe. I know his personality very well — and I know that if he comes back, he’s not protected by history or what he’s done for this club before. He’s coming with the mentality to make more history.' Drogba helped Chelsea become the first London club to win the Champions League in 2012, scoring the decisive penalty in the final. His 157 goals in 341 appearances place him fourth on Chelsea’s all-time scoring list. In a statement, Chelsea celebrated his return: 'When he left in 2012, it was just weeks after he secured our historic European triumph. His earlier equalizer in that final was his 157th goal — a tally that still ranks him among the club’s greatest.' On signing, Drogba said: 'It was an easy decision. I couldn’t turn down the chance to work with Jose again. This club has always felt like home. My desire to win hasn’t changed — I’m excited for this next chapter.' Though he’ll serve as backup to new signing Diego Costa, Drogba’s record speaks for itself: 34 goals in European competition — a Chelsea record — and nine goals in nine cup finals. Over eight seasons, he won three Premier League titles, four FA Cups, two League Cups, and the Champions League. Last season, while playing for Galatasaray, Drogba faced Chelsea in the Champions League — and was reminded firsthand of his enduring popularity among Blues fans.

Pada Jumat, kesepakatan telah disepakati untuk membawanya kembali ke rumah sepak bola rohaninya. Didier Drogba kini menjadi seorang Blue sekali lagi. Di usia 36, kekuatan fisiknya mungkin telah sedikit berkurang, tetapi Drogba tetap sangat berharga bagi seorang pelatih dengan ambisi sebesar Mourinho. Kepemimpinannya, pengalaman, dan mentalitas menang adalah aset yang bisa dipelajari oleh pemain muda. Drogba telah menandatangani kontrak satu tahun, sesuai dengan kebijakan Chelsea untuk pemain senior. Dia telah menyelesaikan pemeriksaan medis dan menandatangani kontrak pada hari Jumat. Mourinho, yang mengungkapkan niatnya untuk merekrut kembali Drogba di Austria pada Kamis, mengatakan pada Jumat: 'Dia datang karena dia salah satu penyerang terbaik di Eropa. Saya tahu kepribadiannya sangat baik — dan saya tahu bahwa jika dia kembali, dia tidak dilindungi oleh sejarah atau apa yang telah dia lakukan untuk klub ini sebelumnya. Dia datang dengan mentalitas untuk membuat sejarah baru.' Drogba membantu Chelsea menjadi klub London pertama yang memenangkan Liga Champions pada 2012, mencetak tendangan penalti penentu di final. 157 golnya dalam 341 penampilan menempatkannya di peringkat keempat dalam daftar pencetak gol terbanyak sepanjang masa Chelsea. Dalam pernyataan resmi, Chelsea merayakan kedatangannya kembali: 'Ketika dia pergi pada 2012, itu hanya beberapa minggu setelah dia mengamankan keberhasilan Eropa kami yang bersejarah. Gol penyama kedudukan awalnya di final itu adalah gol ke-157nya — angka yang masih menjadikannya salah satu yang terhebat di klub ini.' Saat menandatangani kontrak, Drogba berkata: 'Ini keputusan yang mudah. Saya tidak bisa menolak kesempatan untuk bekerja lagi bersama Jose. Klub ini selalu terasa seperti rumah bagi saya. Hasrat saya untuk menang belum berubah — saya antusias menyambut babak baru karier saya.' Meskipun ia akan menjadi pendukung bagi penandatangan baru Diego Costa, rekam jejak Drogba berbicara sendiri: 34 gol dalam kompetisi Eropa — rekor Chelsea — dan sembilan gol dalam sembilan final piala. Selama delapan musim, ia memenangkan tiga gelar Premier League, empat FA Cup, dua League Cup, dan Liga Champions. Musim lalu, saat bermain untuk Galatasaray, Drogba bertemu Chelsea di Liga Champions — dan tersadar secara langsung tentang popularitas abadinya di kalangan para penggemar Blues.

article_content: An Egyptian court has sentenced Mohamed Badie, the leader of the Muslim Brotherhood, and 682 of his supporters to death, one year after the Islamist group was ousted from power in a military coup. Badie and the other defendants were convicted over an attack on a police station in Minya in 2013, during which a policeman was killed. If confirmed by Egypt’s Grand Mufti, this would mark the most senior Muslim Brotherhood figure sentenced to death since Sayed Qutb was executed in 1966. The announcement triggered emotional reactions outside the courtroom, with several relatives fainting and others crying out, 'Why? This is unfair!' However, the judge later commuted the death sentences of 492 other Muslim Brotherhood members to life imprisonment. These sentences are part of a series of mass trials that began in March, when 529 individuals were sentenced to death in a single case — a move widely condemned by human rights groups both inside and outside Egypt. The remaining 37 convicts from that trial remain on death row. Judge Said Youssef, presiding over the case, referred the death sentences to Egypt’s Grand Mufti, as required by Egyptian law. While the Mufti’s opinion is not legally binding, the referral allows for potential judicial reversal. The trials are linked to violent riots in Minya and elsewhere following the violent dispersal of Brotherhood sit-ins in Cairo in August 2013, which resulted in the deaths of three police officers and one civilian. Hundreds have died in the broader crackdown on Morsi supporters since his ouster in July 2013. Egypt’s interim, military-backed government has designated the Muslim Brotherhood a terrorist organization — a label the group firmly rejects. Since July 2013, over 16,000 people have been arrested, including most of the Brotherhood’s top leadership. Human Rights Watch criticized the proceedings, noting defendants were not given adequate time or opportunity to defend themselves. 'There is no more serious violation of the most basic right of due process and the right to a fair trial than that,' said Sarah Leah Whitson, Executive Director of HRW’s Middle East and North Africa Division. According to a judicial official involved in the investigation, evidence presented largely consisted of video footage showing defendants attacking and looting a police station and burning government buildings. The defendants faced 14 charges, five of which carried the death penalty. Badie was not present in the Minya courtroom; he is currently on trial in Cairo for murder and incitement to murder related to June 2013 protests outside the Brotherhood’s headquarters. Families of the condemned expressed disbelief. One woman claimed her brother and son were not even practicing Muslims, let alone Brotherhood members. Lawyers reported the hearing lasted only eight minutes, with security forces blocking access to media and relatives. While many mourned outside the court, some Egyptians in Cairo voiced support. 'Even if they sentence a million people to death, so what?' said Sadeek el-Moghazi, a newspaper vendor. 'This is the best ruling in the history of the Egyptian judiciary.' The final verdicts are scheduled to be issued on June 21, after the Grand Mufti completes his review.
translated_content: Mahkamah Mesir telah menghukum Mohamed Badie, pemimpin Ikhwanul Muslimin, dan 682 penyokongnya dengan hukuman mati, setahun selepas kumpulan Islamis itu diusir dari kuasa dalam satu kudeta tentera. Badie dan pesalah lain didakwa atas serangan terhadap sebuah stesen polis di Minya pada 2013, yang menyebabkan seorang polis terbunuh. Jika disahkan oleh Mufti Agung Mesir, ini akan menjadi kes pertama sejak Sayed Qutb, salah seorang pemikir utama kelompok itu, dihukum mati pada tahun 1966. Pengumuman itu memicu reaksi emosional di luar mahkamah, dengan beberapa ahli keluarga pingsan dan yang lain berteriak, 'Kenapa? Ini tidak adil!' Namun, hakim kemudian mengurangkan hukuman mati kepada penjara seumur hidup bagi 492 ahli Ikhwanul Muslimin lain. Hukuman ini adalah sebahagian daripada siri kes percubaan besar-besaran yang bermula pada Mac, apabila 529 individu dihukum mati dalam satu kes — tindakan yang dikutuk secara meluas oleh kumpulan hak asasi manusia di dalam dan luar negara. 37 pesalah yang tinggal daripada kes itu masih berada di barisan hukuman mati. Hakim Said Youssef, yang memegang kes ini, merujuk hukuman mati tersebut kepada Mufti Agung Mesir, seperti yang diwajibkan oleh undang-undang Mesir. Walaupun pendapat Mufti tidak mengikat secara undang-undang, rujukan ini memberi ruang untuk penghakiman semula. Kes-kes ini berkaitan dengan huru-hara berdarah di Minya dan tempat lain selepas penumpasan kejam terhadap perkemahan Ikhwanul Muslimin di Kairo pada Ogos 2013, yang menyebabkan tiga orang polis dan seorang awam terbunuh. Ratusan orang terbunuh dalam tindakan tegas yang lebih luas terhadap penyokong Morsi sejak penggulingannya pada Julai 2013. Kerajaan sementara Mesir yang disokong tentera telah menggelarkan Ikhwanul Muslimin sebagai organisasi teroris — label yang dinafikan oleh kumpulan itu. Sejak Julai 2013, lebih 16,000 orang telah ditangkap, termasuk kebanyakan pemimpin utama Ikhwanul Muslimin. Human Rights Watch mengkritik prosedur itu, menunjukkan bahawa pesalah tidak diberi masa atau peluang mencukupi untuk membela diri. 'Tiada pelanggaran yang lebih serius terhadap hak asasi paling asas — hak atas proses undang-undang yang adil dan hak atas perbicaraan yang adil — selain daripada ini,' kata Sarah Leah Whitson, Pengarah Eksekutif Bahagian Timur Tengah dan Afrika Utara HRW. Menurut seorang pegawai kehakiman yang terlibat dalam penyiasatan, bukti yang dibentangkan sebahagian besarnya terdiri daripada rakaman video yang menunjukkan pesalah menyerang dan merompak stesen polis serta membakar bangunan kerajaan. Pesalah dihadapkan kepada 14 tuduhan, lima daripadanya boleh mengakibatkan hukuman mati. Badie tidak hadir di mahkamah Minya; beliau kini sedang diadili di Kairo atas tuduhan pembunuhan dan hasutan pembunuhan berkaitan protes berdarah di luar markas Ikhwanul Muslimin pada Jun 2013. Ahli keluarga pesalah yang dihukum mati menyatakan ketidakpercayaan. Seorang wanita mengatakan abang dan anaknya bukanlah umat Islam yang beramal, apatah lagi anggota Ikhwanul Muslimin. Peguam melaporkan sidang itu hanya berlangsung lapan minit, dengan pasukan keselamatan menghalang akses media dan keluarga. Sementara ramai berduka di luar mahkamah, beberapa rakyat Mesir di Kairo menyokong hukuman itu. 'Sekalipun mereka menghukum sejuta orang mati, apa masalahnya?' kata Sadeek el-Moghazi, seorang penjual akhbar. 'Ini adalah keputusan terbaik dalam sejarah kehakiman Mesir.' Keputusan akhir dijadualkan untuk dikeluarkan pada 21 Jun, selepas Mufti Agung menyelesaikan ulasannya.

article_content: Police are searching the former home of convicted murderer Christopher Halliwell in Swindon as part of a renewed investigation into the 2002 murder of Becky Godden. Halliwell, who is serving a life sentence for the 2011 abduction and murder of Sian O'Callaghan, admitted to killing Godden and led officers to her remains in a field in Eastleach, Gloucestershire. However, a judge ruled his confession inadmissible because he was not properly cautioned at the time of arrest. Forensic teams and sniffer dogs are now conducting a meticulous search of Halliwell’s former semi-detached home. The current occupants, who have no connection to the case, have been temporarily relocated to allow for the investigation. Detective Chief Inspector Sean Memory stated that over 30 specialists are examining every part of the property—including floors, walls, and lofts—in hopes of uncovering evidence tied to Godden’s death. The operation is expected to last about a week. The case gained renewed attention after police discovered a pair of boots, a shotgun, and hundreds of other items beneath mud near a pond in Ramsbury, Wiltshire, earlier this year. Authorities believe these items may be connected to multiple unsolved crimes. Steve Fulcher, the former detective superintendent who led the original investigation, was suspended and later resigned after being found guilty of gross misconduct by the police watchdog. Despite this, Godden’s mother, Karen Edwards, continues to credit him as a 'hero' for helping uncover the truth about her daughter’s fate. Becky Godden, a 20-year-old woman struggling with addiction and sex work, was last seen alive on December 27, 2002. Her family did not report her missing, assuming she was in Bristol trying to rebuild her life. Halliwell has been informally linked to the disappearances of at least three other young women across the West Country—but has never been charged in those cases.
translated_content: Polis sedang menggeledah rumah lama penjenayah terhukum Christopher Halliwell di Swindon sebagai sebahagian daripada penyiasatan semula ke atas pembunuhan Becky Godden pada tahun 2002. Halliwell, yang sedang menjalani hukuman seumur hidup atas penculikan dan pembunuhan Sian O'Callaghan pada tahun 2011, mengaku telah membunuh Godden dan memimpin polis ke jenazahnya di sebuah padang di Eastleach, Gloucestershire. Namun, hakim memutuskan pengakuan beliau tidak boleh diterima kerana beliau tidak diperingatkan dengan betul ketika ditangkap. Pasukan forensik dan anjing pengesan sedang menjalankan pemeriksaan teliti terhadap rumah separa bersepadu lama Halliwell. Penghuni semasa, yang tidak ada kaitan dengan kes ini, telah dipindahkan sementara untuk membolehkan penyiasatan berjalan. Detektif Ketua Inspektor Sean Memory menyatakan bahawa lebih 30 pakar sedang mengkaji setiap bahagian rumah—termasuk lantai, dinding, dan ruang loteng—dengan harapan menemui bukti yang berkaitan dengan kematian Godden. Operasi ini dijangka berlangsung selama seminggu. Kes ini mendapat perhatian semula selepas polis menemui sepasang bot, senapang, dan ratusan benda lain di bawah lumpur berhampiran kolam di Ramsbury, Wiltshire, awal tahun ini. Pihak berkuasa percaya benda-benda ini mungkin berkaitan dengan beberapa kes tidak terselesaikan. Steve Fulcher, superintenden detektif lama yang memimpin penyiasatan asal, telah dilantik dan kemudian meletakkan jawatan selepas ditemui bersalah atas kelakuan tidak bertanggungjawab oleh agensi pengawasan polis. article_content: When people upgrade their phones, battery life tops the list of must-have features — and now, Nokia Networks says it has cracked a major code to extend it. In real-world trials on a European 3G network, their new software, High Speed Cell FACH, boosted battery efficiency by up to 49%. That’s nearly double the runtime for many users, depending on how they use their devices. The innovation doesn’t rely on bigger batteries. Instead, it smarterly manages tiny bursts of data — like those sent when you scroll through Instagram, send a WhatsApp message, check email, or load a webpage. These small data packets, often just hundreds of bytes, are handled far more efficiently by High Speed Cell FACH than older methods, reducing how hard the phone’s radio has to work — and thus, how much power it drains. The results? Up to 65% faster network response times, 21% quicker page loads, and consistent energy savings across common apps. Even the lowest recorded gain was 9%, meaning every user benefited. The tests ran on live networks using devices powered by Qualcomm Snapdragon chips — chips already built into popular flagships like the Samsung Galaxy Note 4 and Nexus 6. Nokia says the real-world outcomes even surpassed earlier lab tests and exceeded Qualcomm’s own projections. The software helps carriers serve more users smoothly and improves overall network quality without needing new hardware. Still, there’s no word yet on when this tech will roll out to the public — or even which European provider tested it. For now, it’s a promising step forward — especially for the billions still relying on 3G networks worldwide.

Dalam ujian sebenar di rangkaian 3G Eropah, perisian baharu mereka, High Speed Cell FACH, meningkatkan kecekapan bateri sehingga 49%. Itu hampir dua kali ganda tempoh penggunaan bagi banyak pengguna, bergantung kepada cara mereka menggunakan peranti. Inovasi ini tidak bergantung pada bateri yang lebih besar. Sebaliknya, ia menguruskan lonjakan data kecil dengan lebih bijak — seperti yang dihantar semasa menggulir Instagram, menghantar mesej WhatsApp, memeriksa e-mel, atau memuat laman web. Pakej data kecil ini, sering hanya beberapa ratus bait, ditangani dengan jauh lebih cekap oleh High Speed Cell FACH berbanding kaedah lama, mengurangkan beban radio telefon — dan dengan itu, penggunaan kuasa. Keputusannya? Masa tindak balas rangkaian lebih pantas sehingga 65%, muat turun laman web 21% lebih cepat, dan penjimatan kuasa konsisten di pelbagai aplikasi umum. Bahkan keuntungan terendah yang dicatat ialah 9%, bermakna setiap pengguna mendapat manfaat. Ujian dijalankan di rangkaian sebenar menggunakan peranti yang dikuasakan oleh prosesor Qualcomm Snapdragon — prosesor yang sudah terpasang dalam telefon unggul seperti Samsung Galaxy Note 4 dan Nexus 6. Nokia mengatakan hasil sebenar bahkan melebihi ujian makmal sebelumnya dan melampaui jangkaan Qualcomm sendiri. Perisian ini membantu penyedia perkhidmatan menyokong lebih ramai pengguna dengan lancar dan meningkatkan kualiti rangkaian secara keseluruhan tanpa memerlukan peralatan baru. Namun, tiada maklumat mengenai bila teknologi ini akan dilancarkan secara meluas kepada pengguna — atau pun penyedia Eropah mana yang menguji ia. Bagaimanapun, ini merupakan langkah maju yang menjanjikan — terutamanya bagi miliaran orang yang masih bergantung pada rangkaian 3G di seluruh dunia.

article_content: Chelsea have sent 21-year-old midfielder Josh McEachran to Dutch club Vitesse Arnhem on a one-season loan deal, as confirmed on Monday. A product of Chelsea’s famed academy since age eight, McEachran made his senior debut at 17 but never secured a regular spot in the first team. Over the years, he’s gained experience through loans at Swansea City, Middlesbrough, Watford, and most recently Wigan Athletic — where he played seven times this season. McEachran, who lifted the FA Youth Cup with Chelsea in 2010 and represented England U21 at the Toulon Tournament last May, announced the move himself via Twitter with a cheerful farewell. In a brief statement, Chelsea expressed their support: 'We wish Josh well for his time in the Netherlands.' This transfer marks the 14th loan move by Chelsea this season, continuing a long-standing relationship with Vitesse, which has served as a key development hub for young talents like Christian Atsu, Lucas Piazon, and Patrick van Aanholt in recent years.

article_content: Mexican boxer Juan Manuel Marquez is pushing for a third bout with Manny Pacquiao after successfully defending his WBA and WBO lightweight titles with a ninth-round technical knockout over Australia’s Michael Katsidis in Las Vegas. The 37-year-old improved his record to 52-5 with 38 knockouts. Marquez’s only previous draw with Pacquiao occurred in 2004, when he retained his WBA and IBF featherweight belts. He later lost his WBC super featherweight title in a controversial split decision to Pacquiao in 2008. Following his win, Marquez told reporters, 'We know Pacquiao has been avoiding us. A third fight is what the public wants to see.' He added that while Pacquiao has defeated older fighters, he himself has consistently beaten younger, stronger opponents like Juan Diaz and Katsidis. A major obstacle remains: Marquez insists the fight should take place at 140–142 pounds, whereas Pacquiao’s trainer, Freddie Roach, insists on 147. Marquez countered that Pacquiao previously made 144 pounds for his fight against Antonio Margarito, calling the 147-pound request an excuse. However, Pacquiao, speaking in Manila, questioned whether fans truly want the rematch. According to The Philippine Star, his business manager Eric Pineda said Pacquiao would accept the fight only if Marquez handled all promotion and guaranteed a purse—without involvement from Top Rank or MP Promotions. Pacquiao, who recently defeated Margarito to become the first boxer in history to win world titles across eight weight divisions, is also being linked to a potential bout with American veteran Shane Mosley.

article_content: Obesity places a burden on the global economy comparable to war and terrorism, costing an estimated $2 trillion annually, according to a new study by the McKinsey Global Institute. More than 2.1 billion people—around 30% of the global population—are currently overweight or obese, and the trend shows no sign of slowing. Experts predict that if current patterns continue, nearly half of the world’s adult population will be overweight or obese by 2030. A report by McKinsey & Company, which analyzed 44 different interventions to combat obesity, found the global economic impact of obesity rivals that of smoking and armed conflict. In the UK, the annual economic burden is £47 billion—greater than the cost of armed violence, war, and terrorism combined. In the US, it reaches $663 billion annually. Researchers have urged governments, healthcare systems, retailers, and food and beverage manufacturers to coordinate a comprehensive response. While individual responsibility and education are important, they are insufficient alone. Effective solutions require systemic changes to the environment—including smaller default portion sizes, stricter limits on advertising unhealthy foods, improved nutrition labeling, subsidized healthy school meals, and urban designs that encourage physical activity. The study found no single intervention can significantly reverse obesity trends. Instead, a sustained, large-scale portfolio of coordinated policies is essential. In the UK, obesity ranks second only to smoking in economic impact; in the US, it ranks second to armed conflict and terrorism. In 2012, the UK’s economic loss from smoking was £57 billion, while armed violence, war, and terrorism cost £43 billion. Obesity cost the US economy $663 billion that year. The report estimates that implementing all 44 interventions could return 20% of overweight or obese individuals in the UK to a healthy weight within five to ten years, saving £16 billion annually—including £766 million for the NHS. However, the UK currently spends less than £638 million per year on obesity prevention—just 1% of its social cost of obesity. Meanwhile, it spends £6 billion annually on treating overweight-related conditions and another £10 billion on diabetes. The NHS cost of obesity and diabetes already equals the combined budget for police, fire services, courts, and prisons. Projections indicate NHS obesity-related costs could rise from £6–8 billion in 2015 to £10–12 billion by 2030. Researchers warn that current prevention efforts are too fragmented and underfunded. They call for greater collaboration between public and private sectors, investment in research, and willingness to test and refine interventions through trial and error. Obesity prevalence is strongly linked to national wealth. Among G-20 nations with per capita GDP above $8,000, only Japan and South Korea have obesity rates below 16%. Most others exceed 20%. The report concludes that reversing this trend is possible—and cost-effective—but requires bold, systemic action. Richard Dobbs, Director of the McKinsey Global Institute, stated: 'Efforts to address obesity have been piecemeal. Yet obesity is a systemic issue, born of many interlocking factors, and only a systemic response will do.' Dr. Alison Tedstone, Chief Nutritionist at Public Health England, emphasized: 'There is no single silver bullet. Reducing obesity to 1993 levels—when 15% of the population was obese—could prevent five million disease cases and save the NHS £1.2 billion by 2034.' Professor Jimmy Bell of the University of Westminster argues the study underestimates the full cost of obesity. He highlights the need for infrastructure adaptations—stronger hospital beds, reinforced public transport seating, and wider doorways—as well as mandatory warning labels on high-sugar, high-fat foods, similar to tobacco packaging. He also warns that rising global food demand driven by obesity-linked consumption patterns is becoming unsustainable, particularly in emerging economies like those in Asia.
