Lebih dari 2,1 miliar orang—sekitar 30% dari populasi global—saat ini mengalami kelebihan berat badan atau obesitas, dan tren ini tidak menunjukkan tanda-tanda melambat. Para ahli memperkirakan bahwa jika pola saat ini berlanjut, hampir separuh populasi dewasa dunia akan mengalami kelebihan berat badan atau obesitas pada tahun 2030. Laporan oleh McKinsey & Company, yang menganalisis 44 intervensi berbeda untuk memerangi obesitas, menemukan bahwa dampak ekonomi global obesitas sebanding dengan merokok dan konflik bersenjata. Di Inggris, beban ekonomi tahunan adalah £47 miliar—lebih besar daripada biaya kekerasan bersenjata, perang, dan terorisme secara gabungan. Di AS, angkanya mencapai $663 miliar per tahun. Para peneliti mendesak pemerintah, sistem kesehatan, pedagang, dan produsen makanan dan minuman untuk mengkoordinasikan respons komprehensif. Meskipun tanggung jawab individu dan pendidikan penting, keduanya tidak cukup sendiri. Solusi yang efektif memerlukan perubahan sistemik terhadap lingkungan—termasuk porsi makanan yang lebih kecil secara default, pembatasan ketat terhadap iklan makanan tidak sehat, pelabelan nutrisi yang lebih baik, makanan sekolah yang sehat dengan subsidi, dan desain perkotaan yang mendorong aktivitas fisik. Studi ini menemukan bahwa tidak ada satu intervensi pun yang dapat secara signifikan membalikkan tren obesitas. Sebaliknya, portofolio kebijakan yang terkoordinasi, berkelanjutan, dan berskala besar sangat diperlukan. Di Inggris, obesitas menempati posisi kedua setelah merokok dalam dampak ekonomi; di AS, ia menempati posisi kedua setelah konflik bersenjata dan terorisme. Pada tahun 2012, kerugian ekonomi Inggris akibat merokok adalah £57 miliar, sementara kekerasan bersenjata, perang, dan terorisme berbiaya £43 miliar. Obesitas menyebabkan kerugian ekonomi AS sebesar $663 miliar pada tahun itu. Laporan tersebut memperkirakan bahwa penerapan semua 44 intervensi bisa mengembalikan 20% individu yang kelebihan berat badan atau obesitas di Inggris ke berat badan sehat dalam lima hingga sepuluh tahun, menghemat £16 miliar per tahun—termasuk £766 juta untuk NHS. Namun, Inggris saat ini menghabiskan kurang dari £638 juta per tahun untuk pencegahan obesitas—hanya 1% dari biaya sosial obesitasnya. Sementara itu, ia menghabiskan £6 miliar per tahun untuk mengobati kondisi terkait kelebihan berat badan dan £10 miliar lagi untuk diabetes. Biaya NHS akibat obesitas dan diabetes sudah sama dengan anggaran gabungan untuk kepolisian, layanan pemadam kebakaran, pengadilan, dan penjara. Proyeksi menunjukkan biaya NHS terkait obesitas bisa naik dari £6–8 miliar pada 2015 menjadi £10–12 miliar pada 2030. Para peneliti memperingatkan bahwa upaya pencegahan saat ini terlalu terfragmentasi dan kurang didanai. Mereka menyerukan kolaborasi yang lebih besar antara sektor publik dan swasta, investasi dalam penelitian, serta kesiapan untuk menguji dan menyempurnakan intervensi melalui percobaan dan kesalahan. Prevalensi obesitas sangat terkait dengan kekayaan nasional. Di antara negara-negara G-20 dengan PDB per kapita di atas $8.000, hanya Jepang dan Korea Selatan yang memiliki tingkat obesitas di bawah 16%. Kebanyakan lainnya melebihi 20%. Laporan tersebut menyimpulkan bahwa membalikkan tren ini dimungkinkan—dan hemat biaya—tetapi memerlukan tindakan sistemik yang berani. Richard Dobbs, Direktur McKinsey Global Institute, menyatakan: 'Upaya untuk mengatasi obesitas selama ini bersifat parsial. Namun, obesitas adalah masalah sistemik, yang lahir dari banyak faktor yang saling terkait, dan hanya respons sistemik yang akan berhasil.' Dr. Alison Tedstone, Ahli Nutrisi Utama di Public Health England, menekankan: 'Tidak ada solusi ajaib. Mengurangi obesitas ke tingkat 1993—ketika 15% populasi mengalami obesitas—dapat mencegah lima juta kasus penyakit dan menghemat NHS sebesar £1,2 miliar pada tahun 2034.' Profesor Jimmy Bell dari Universitas Westminster berpendapat bahwa studi ini meremehkan biaya penuh obesitas. Ia menyoroti perlunya adaptasi infrastruktur—tempat tidur rumah sakit yang lebih kuat, kursi transportasi umum yang diperkuat, dan pintu yang lebih lebar—serta pelabelan wajib pada makanan tinggi gula dan lemak, mirip dengan kemasan tembakau. Ia juga memperingatkan bahwa permintaan pangan global yang meningkat akibat pola konsumsi terkait obesitas menjadi tidak berkelanjutan, terutama di ekonomi berkembang seperti di Asia.

article_content: Malaysian filmmaker Amanda Nell Eu has publicly disassociated herself from the version of her critically acclaimed film, Tiger Stripes, set for a one-week theatrical release in Malaysia on October 19 as part of an Oscars-qualifying run. Although the film—selected as Malaysia’s official entry for the Best International Feature category at the Academy Awards and winner of the Critics’ Week Grand Prix at Cannes—is being shown locally, Eu insists it is not the film she created. She stated, 'The film that will be shown in local cinemas is not the film that we made.' Tiger Stripes follows a 12-year-old girl navigating the unsettling changes of early puberty, facing isolation from peers, and ultimately embracing her identity. While the story centers on hijab-wearing Malay girls, its themes—puberty, bullying, and generational miscommunication—are universal. Eu has declined to specify which scenes were removed but described the censored material as capturing 'the joy of being a young girl in Malaysia—someone different, misunderstood, or eager to express herself in ways that defy norms.' She emphasized that the film was made with Malaysian audiences as its primary focus, making its domestic release especially meaningful. Film censorship in Malaysia is regulated by the Ministry of Home Affairs, which evaluates content against political, religious, cultural, and moral standards. Filmmakers have no legal avenue to appeal these decisions. In a heartfelt public statement, Eu expressed sorrow over the cuts but affirmed her commitment to artistic integrity. She praised her team at Ghost Grrrl Pictures for enabling her to resist self-censorship and urged fellow artists to persist despite financial, emotional, and personal risks. 'Art’s purpose,' she wrote, 'is to spark honest dialogue, amplify diverse voices, and trust the audience’s capacity to think critically.' Though the altered version will screen in theaters, Eu and her team remain determined to one day bring the uncut, director’s cut to Malaysian audiences—within the bounds of the law.
translated_content: Penyanyi filem Malaysia, Amanda Nell Eu, telah secara terbuka menjauhkan dirinya daripada versi filemnya yang sangat diacungi jempol, Tiger Stripes, yang akan ditayangkan di pawagam Malaysia selama seminggu pada 19 Oktober sebagai sebahagian daripada siri tayangan kelayakan Oscar. Walaupun filem ini—yang dipilih sebagai wakil rasmi Malaysia untuk kategori Filem Bahasa Asing Terbaik di Anugerah Akademi dan memenangi Grand Prix Minggu Kritik di Cannes—akan ditayangkan secara tempatan, Eu menegaskan bahawa ia bukan filem yang dicipta olehnya. Beliau menyatakan, 'Filem yang akan ditayangkan di pawagam tempatan bukanlah filem yang kami buat.' Tiger Stripes mengikuti seorang budak perempuan berumur 12 tahun yang melalui perubahan mengejutkan semasa pubertas, menghadapi pengasingan daripada rakan-rakan, dan akhirnya menerima identitinya sendiri. Walaupun cerita ini berpusat kepada gadis-gadis Melayu yang memakai tudung, tema-temanya—pubertas, pengganasan sekolah, dan komunikasi yang lemah antara generasi—adalah universal. Eu enggan menyebut adegan spesifik yang dipotong tetapi menggambarkan bahan yang dipotong sebagai menangkap 'kegembiraan menjadi seorang gadis muda di Malaysia—seseorang yang berbeza, tidak difahami, atau ingin mengekspresikan diri dengan cara yang menentang norma.' Beliau menekankan bahawa filem ini dicipta dengan penonton Malaysia sebagai fokus utama, menjadikan tayangan tempatan sangat bermakna baginya. Sensor filem di Malaysia dikawal oleh Kementerian Hal Ehwal Dalam Negeri, yang menilai kandungan berdasarkan nilai politik, agama, budaya, dan moral. Pembikin filem tidak mempunyai jalan undang-undang untuk membuat rayuan terhadap keputusan ini. Dalam satu penyataan awam yang penuh perasaan, Eu mengungkapkan kesedihan atas potongan itu tetapi menegaskan komitmennya terhadap integriti seni. Beliau memuji pasukannya di Ghost Grrrl Pictures kerana membolehkannya menolak sensor diri dan mendesak seniman lain untuk terus gigih walaupun menghadapi risiko kewangan, emosi, dan peribadi. 'Tujuan seni,' tulisnya, 'adalah untuk mencetuskan dialog jujur, memperkuat suara pelbagai, dan mempercayai kapasiti penonton untuk berfikir secara kritis.' Walaupun versi yang diubah akan ditayangkan di pawagam, Eu dan pasukannya tetap bertekad untuk membawa versi asli, versi pengarah, kepada penonton Malaysia—dalam batas-batas undang-undang!

article_content: Tristram Hunt, Labour’s shadow education secretary and a former television historian, has sparked debate by suggesting that rising numbers of Eastern European immigrants may be contributing to lower academic achievement among white British boys. In an upcoming interview with The Fabian Society, Hunt argued that the UK’s education system needs urgent reform to equip young people with skills relevant to today’s job market. He pointed to areas like Lincolnshire, Norfolk, Suffolk, and parts of the Kent coast, where educational outcomes lag, and suggested that increased competition for jobs from EU migrants could be a factor. Hunt acknowledged that the previous Labour government misjudged the scale and impact of immigration, admitting their forecasts were 'badly wrong.' He also launched a sharp critique of Conservative education secretary Michael Gove, describing his approach as that of a 'zealot' pushing a high-pressure, finance-sector-inspired model of schooling. Reflecting on the late 1990s, Hunt recalled how Labour’s focus on expanding university access and assuming the knowledge economy would sustain itself indefinitely overlooked the need for vocational training and workforce adaptation.

Dalam satu temu bual yang akan diterbitkan oleh The Fabian Society, Hunt berhujah bahawa sistem pendidikan UK memerlukan reformasi segera untuk melengkapi generasi muda dengan kemahiran yang relevan dengan pasaran pekerjaan hari ini. Beliau menunjuk kepada kawasan-kawasan seperti Lincolnshire, Norfolk, Suffolk, dan sebahagian pantai Kent, di mana hasil pendidikan tertinggal, dan mencadangkan bahawa persaingan yang meningkat untuk pekerjaan daripada migran EU mungkin menjadi faktor. Hunt mengakui bahawa kerajaan Buruh sebelumnya salah menilai skala dan kesan imigresen, mengakui ramalan mereka 'salah teruk.' Beliau juga mengkritik tajam setiausaha pendidikan Parti Konservatif Michael Gove, menggambarkan pendekatannya sebagai 'seorang fanatic' yang mempromosikan model sekolah yang penuh tekanan dan terinspirasi sektor kewangan. Merujuk kepada akhir tahun 1990-an, Hunt ingat bagaimana fokus Buruh pada pengembangan akses universiti dan anggapan ekonomi ilmu akan berterusan selama-lamanya mengabaikan keperluan latihan vokasional dan penyesuaian tenaga kerja.

article_content: Ben Monksummers, a 22-year-old Team GB rifle shooter from Gillingham, Dorset, was stunned to see his £11,000 high-velocity rifles circulating on a public baggage carousel at Amsterdam’s Schiphol Airport. The incident occurred during his return flight to the UK after competing internationally. Monksummers, who uses the budget airline easyJet, expressed alarm, stating: 'Anyone could have walked out of that building with restricted firearms worth £11,000. This is a very serious offence.' This was not the first time Monksummers faced difficulties with easyJet. Earlier, he was fined €55 (approximately £44) for carrying his essential diabetes medication onboard — despite following standard procedures. He has since filed a formal complaint regarding both incidents, which took place at the end of October. easyJet responded by apologizing for the inconvenience and confirmed that it has established protocols for handling firearms as checked baggage. The airline is now investigating why those procedures were not followed in this case. According to easyJet’s policy, sporting firearms and ammunition may be transported as checked baggage only if passengers provide original documentation proving legal ownership and authorization — photocopies are not accepted. Firearms, explosives, and munitions are strictly prohibited in the cabin.

Insiden ini berlaku semasa penerbangan pulangnya ke UK selepas bersaing secara antarabangsa. Monksummers, yang menggunakan syarikat penerbangan bajet easyJet, menyatakan keterkejutan: 'Sesiapa sahaja boleh keluar daripada bangunan itu dengan senjata api terhad bernilai £11,000. Ini adalah kesalahan serius.' Ini bukan kali pertama Monksummers menghadapi masalah dengan easyJet. Sebelum ini, beliau didenda €55 (kira-kira £44) kerana membawa ubat diabetes penting ke dalam pesawat — walaupun telah mengikuti prosedur piawai. Beliau telah mengemukakan aduan rasmi mengenai kedua-dua insiden ini, yang berlaku pada akhir Oktober. easyJet menanggapi dengan memohon maaf atas ketidakselesaan tersebut dan mengesahkan bahawa mereka mempunyai protokol yang ditetapkan untuk mengendalikan senjata api sebagai bagasi daftar. Syarikat penerbangan sedang menyiasat mengapa prosedur ini tidak diikuti dalam kes ini. Menurut dasar easyJet, senjata api sukan dan peluru boleh diangkut sebagai bagasi daftar hanya jika penumpang memberikan dokumen asli yang membuktikan kepemilikan dan kebenaran undang-undang — salinan fotokopi tidak diterima. Senjata api, bahan letupan, dan peluru dilarang sepenuhnya di dalam kabin.

article_content: After accidentally breaking a wooden windmill souvenir belonging to passenger Hazel Lindley, taxi driver Kevin Gregg embarked on a 450-mile journey from Newcastle to Amsterdam to replace it. The delicate item, brought back from Hazel’s holiday, was crushed when Gregg placed a heavy object on her bag during transit. Devastated and apologetic, he couldn’t shake the guilt — especially after Hazel kindly offered to glue it herself. When EastCoast Taxis’ managing director, Paul Irwin, learned of the incident, he didn’t just offer an apology — he authorized Gregg to travel to Amsterdam and retrieve a replacement. 'We expect occasional mishaps with 70,000 weekly passengers,' Irwin said. 'But this wasn’t just a trinket — it was irreplaceable unless you were in Amsterdam.' Gregg, from Whitley Bay, took a bus to the Dutch capital, navigated unfamiliar streets using a printed map, and asked a local English-speaking passerby for directions. He found the shop quickly — despite having only a black-and-white photo to guide him. 'I guarded that windmill more than I guard my own kids,' he said. Upon returning, Gregg met Hazel again. The two embraced. 'She reminded me of my nana,' he recalled. 'She kept apologizing for the trouble, but I was just thrilled I could make it right.' Hazel, from Felton near Morpeth, was overwhelmed: 'I couldn’t believe the level of service. Most companies would’ve just said sorry and moved on.' Gregg joked he’d never let anything break in his cab again — 'unless I have to go to America!' The story has since become a symbol of human kindness and corporate integrity in an age where such gestures are rare.

Barang halus itu, yang dibawa pulang dari cuti Hazel, hancur apabila Gregg meletakkan objek berat di atas begnya semasa pengangkutan. Sangat sedih dan meminta maaf, dia tidak mampu melupakan rasa bersalahnya — terutamanya selepas Hazel dengan baik hatinya menawarkan untuk melekatkannya semula. Apabila pengarah urusan EastCoast Taxis, Paul Irwin, mendengar tentang insiden itu, beliau tidak hanya menawarkan permintaan maaf — tetapi memberikan kebenaran kepada Gregg untuk pergi ke Amsterdam dan mendapatkan pengganti. 'Kami mengharapkan kejadian kecil yang tidak dijangka dengan 70,000 penumpang mingguan,' kata Irwin. 'Tetapi ini bukan sekadar barang kecil — ia tidak boleh diganti kecuali anda berada di Amsterdam.' Gregg, dari Whitley Bay, menaiki bas ke ibu kota Belanda, menavigasi jalan-jalan asing menggunakan peta cetak, dan bertanya kepada seorang laluan tempatan yang berbahasa Inggeris untuk petunjuk. Setelah kembali, Gregg bertemu semula dengan Hazel. Keduanya berpelukan. 'Dia mengingatkan saya pada nenek saya,' kenangnya. 'Dia terus meminta maaf kerana merepotkan, tetapi saya sangat gembira dapat memperbaikinya.' Hazel, dari Felton berhampiran Morpeth, terkesan: 'Saya tak percaya tahap perkhidmatan yang diberikan. Kebanyakan syarikat hanya akan berkata maaf dan teruskan.' Gregg bercanda bahawa dia tidak akan membiarkan apa-apa pecah lagi dalam teksinya — 'kecuali jika saya perlu pergi ke Amerika!' Kisah ini telah menjadi simbol kasih sayang manusia dan integriti korporat di zaman di mana tindakan seperti ini jarang berlaku.

article_content: In a remote village in Liaoning Province, northeastern China, a newborn girl defied all odds after being buried for two hours — mistakenly thought to be stillborn by her own family. Her mother, Lu Xiaoyun, believed she was four months pregnant and experiencing a miscarriage when she went into labor while working on their farm. She delivered a baby girl who showed no signs of life. Overwhelmed and distraught, Lu was taken to a nearby hospital, while her husband, He Yong, instructed ambulance workers not to bother checking the infant. Meanwhile, his mother buried the child under a tree in their yard. Later, a hospital doctor questioned the assumption of death and urged the family to verify the baby’s condition. He Yong rushed home, dug up the tiny girl, and was stunned to find her breathing. Medical tests revealed Lu had actually been six months pregnant — not four — meaning the baby had been born alive all along. The infant spent three days receiving critical care, but the family, struggling financially, had no choice but to take her home. He Yong, the sole breadwinner, cares for his 7-year-old daughter and a mother-in-law with chronic illnesses, while Lu is unemployed. After local media covered their heartbreaking ordeal, an outpouring of public donations allowed them to return their daughter to the hospital, where she now rests safely in an incubator.

Ibunya, Lu Xiaoyun, mengira ia hamil empat bulan dan mengalami keguguran ketika melahirkan sambil bekerja di pertanian mereka. Ia melahirkan seorang bayi perempuan yang tidak menunjukkan tanda-tanda kehidupan. Dalam keadaan kacau dan sedih, Lu dibawa ke rumah sakit terdekat, sementara suaminya, He Yong, meminta petugas ambulans untuk tidak memeriksa bayi itu. Sementara itu, ibu mertuanya mengubur bayi itu di bawah pohon di halaman rumah. Kemudian, seorang dokter di rumah sakit mempertanyakan asumsi kematian dan mendesak keluarga untuk memastikan kondisi bayi tersebut. He Yong bergegas pulang, menggali kembali bayi kecil itu, dan terkejut menemukan bayi itu masih bernapas. Pemeriksaan medis mengungkapkan bahwa Lu sebenarnya hamil enam bulan — bukan empat bulan — artinya bayi itu sudah lahir hidup sejak awal. Bayi itu menjalani perawatan kritis selama tiga hari, tetapi keluarga, yang sedang mengalami kesulitan keuangan, tidak punya pilihan selain membawanya pulang. He Yong, satu-satunya pencari nafkah, merawat putri berusia tujuh tahun dan ibu mertua yang menderita penyakit kronis, sementara Lu tidak bekerja. Setelah media lokal memberitakan penderitaan mereka, banyak orang memberikan sumbangan sehingga mereka bisa kembali membawa putri mereka ke rumah sakit, di mana kini ia beristirahat dengan aman di dalam inkubator.

article_content: New College Pontefract, run by Principal Pauline Hagen, is seeking to open a new sixth-form in 2016 under the government’s Free Schools programme. As part of the initiative, the college plans to offer an academic scholarship of up to £500 to students predicted to achieve five or more A grades at GCSE level. The scholarship is not guaranteed to all high achievers — it will be means-tested and subject to both academic and socio-economic eligibility criteria. Support may be provided as cash, educational resources, or equipment, not solely as direct payment. Critics have labelled the incentive 'bribery' and questioned its ethical use of public funds. However, Principal Hagen clarified that similar schemes are common in UK universities, and the number of eligible students is expected to be fewer than ten. The college, which received an Ofsted 'Outstanding' rating in 2023, has already gathered the required 1,000 parent signatures and aims to enroll 500 students initially, growing to 1,200 within three years. Professor Stephen Gorard of Durham University expressed concern that such incentives could exacerbate social segregation by attracting only the highest-achieving students, potentially leaving other schools with fewer high performers. The Department for Education is expected to announce whether the proposal will advance to the next stage in the coming months.
translated_content: New College Pontefract, yang dikelola oleh Pengarah Pauline Hagen, sedang berusaha membuka sebuah kolej enam tahun pada 2016 di bawah program Sekolah Percuma kerajaan. Sebagai sebahagian daripada inisiatif ini, kolej tersebut merancang untuk menawarkan biasiswa akademik sehingga £500 kepada pelajar yang dijangka mencapai lima atau lebih gred A dalam SPM. Biasiswa ini tidak dijamin kepada semua pelajar berprestasi tinggi — ia akan dinilai berdasarkan keperluan sosioekonomi serta kriteria akademik. Sokongan boleh diberikan dalam bentuk tunai, sumber pendidikan, atau peralatan, bukan semata-mata pembayaran langsung. Kritikus telah menyamakan insentif ini sebagai 'suapan' dan mempertikaikan penggunaan dana awam secara etika. Namun, Pengarah Hagen menegaskan bahawa skema serupa adalah biasa di universiti-universiti UK, dan bilangan pelajar yang layak dijangka kurang daripada sepuluh. Kolej ini, yang menerima penilaian 'Cemerlang' Ofsted pada 2023, telah mengumpulkan 1,000 tanda tangan ibu bapa yang diperlukan dan bertujuan untuk mendaftarkan 500 pelajar pada permulaan, dengan pertumbuhan hingga 1,200 dalam tempoh tiga tahun. Profesor Stephen Gorard dari Universiti Durham mengungkapkan kebimbangan bahawa insentif seperti ini boleh memperburuk segregasi sosial dengan menarik hanya pelajar berprestasi tertinggi, yang mungkin meninggalkan sekolah-sekolah lain dengan lebih sedikit pelajar cemerlang. Jabatan Pendidikan dijangka mengumumkan sama ada cadangan ini akan dipindahkan ke peringkat seterusnya dalam beberapa bulan mendatang.

article_content: Bridget Anne Kelly never fit the stereotype of a cutthroat politician. A mother of four and active community member in Ramsey, New Jersey, she was known for her warmth, integrity, and dedication to her family — whether volunteering at her children’s Catholic schools or writing heartfelt letters advocating for children with heart conditions. Colleagues described her as pleasant, hardworking, and driven, but never as a vindictive power-seeker. Yet in 2013, she became the face of one of New Jersey’s biggest political scandals: Bridgegate. After emails surfaced revealing her role in orchestrating lane closures on the George Washington Bridge — a move intended to punish Fort Lee’s mayor for not endorsing Governor Chris Christie — Kelly was swiftly fired and publicly vilified. But those who know her best insist the narrative doesn’t add up. Her brother is an EMT; her father served veterans; her life revolved around helping others, not harming them. Former colleagues, including ex-Congressman Bill Pascrell Jr., argue she didn’t act alone — that she was following orders from Bill Stepien, Christie’s top political strategist, who allegedly designed the scheme to protect the governor’s reputation. ‘She didn’t wake up one day and decide to mess with traffic,’ Pascrell said. Friends say the real story is far more complex: a politically motivated cover-up where Kelly, a loyal aide with no history of malice, became the convenient sacrifice. Even as Christie’s administration distanced itself, community members rallied behind her, calling her a woman of honor. The leaked emails may show her name, but they don’t capture the full context — or the quiet, principled woman behind them.
translated_content: Bridget Anne Kelly tidak pernah sesuai dengan stereotaip seorang politikus kejam. Seorang ibu kepada empat orang anak dan anggota komuniti yang aktif di Ramsey, New Jersey, beliau dikenali kerana kehangatan, integriti, dan dedikasinya terhadap keluarga — sama ada sebagai sukarelawan di sekolah Katolik anak-anaknya atau menulis surat penuh perasaan untuk memperjuangkan kanak-kanak dengan masalah jantung. Rakan sekerja menggambarkan beliau sebagai orang yang mesra, rajin, dan bersemangat, tetapi tidak pernah sebagai pencari kuasa yang dendam. Namun pada tahun 2013, beliau menjadi wajah salah satu skandal politik terbesar di New Jersey: Bridgegate. Selepas e-mel mendedahkan peranan beliau dalam mengatur penutupan lorong di Jambatan George Washington — tindakan yang bertujuan menghukum bandaraya Fort Lee kerana tidak menyokong Gabenor Chris Christie — Kelly segera dipecat dan dipermalukan secara awam. Tetapi mereka yang mengenalnya dengan baik percaya naratif ini tidak masuk akal. Saudara lelaki beliau adalah seorang EMT; ayahnya pernah melayani veteran; hidup beliau berpusat pada membantu orang lain, bukan menyakitkan mereka. Rakan sekerja terdahulu, termasuk bekas ahli Kongres Bill Pascrell Jr., berpendapat beliau tidak bertindak sendirian — bahawa beliau hanya mengikut arahan daripada Bill Stepien, strategis politik utama Christie, yang disyaki merancang skema ini untuk melindungi reputasi gabenor. 'Dia tidak bangun satu hari dan memutuskan untuk mengganggu lalu lintas,' kata Pascrell. Rakan-rakan berkata kisah sebenarnya jauh lebih kompleks: satu penutupan politik di mana Kelly, seorang pembantu yang setia tanpa sejarah niat jahat, menjadi mangsa yang mudah. Walaupun pentadbiran Christie cuba menjauhkan diri, ahli komuniti bersatu mempertahankan beliau, memanggilnya wanita yang bermaruah. E-mel yang bocor mungkin menunjukkan namanya, tetapi ia tidak menceritakan konteks penuh — atau wanita tenang dan berasaskan prinsip di sebaliknya.

article_content: Graphic design student Ryan Howerter, 21, from Colorado State University, has built a fully functional pinhole camera using just a single black 2x2 Lego brick. The miniature device captures tiny black-and-white photographs measuring 0.16 square inches (1 square centimeter) by exposing photographic paper to light through a precisely drilled pinhole. To construct the camera, Howerter removed the internal support column inside the brick using a Dremel tool, inserted a brass sheet with a tiny aperture, and sealed the unit with black tape. Light enters through the pinhole, projecting an inverted image onto the photographic paper — a principle identical to how human eyes process visual information. Exposure lasts about ten seconds, after which the photographic paper is developed using standard darkroom techniques. Though the resulting images are slightly blurry, they have impressed viewers for their novelty and craftsmanship. Howerter, an avid Lego enthusiast, was inspired by a similar pinhole camera made from a pine nut. He completed the entire project in just 20 minutes. The camera is small enough to be held by a standard Lego figurine, adding to its whimsical charm.
translated_content: Pelajar reka bentuk grafik, Ryan Howerter, berusia 21 tahun, dari Universiti Negeri Colorado, telah membina kamera pinhole berfungsi penuh menggunakan satu batu Lego hitam 2x2. Peranti mini ini menangkap gambar hitam-putih kecil berukuran 0.16 inci persegi (1 sentimeter persegi) dengan mendedahkan kertas fotografi kepada cahaya melalui lubang pin yang dipahat dengan tepat. Untuk membina kamera ini, Howerter mengeluarkan tiang sokongan dalaman di dalam batu Lego menggunakan alat Dremel, memasukkan kepingan tembaga kuning dengan lubang kecil, dan menutupnya dengan pita hitam. Cahaya masuk melalui lubang pin, memproyeksikan imej songsang ke atas kertas fotografi — prinsip yang sama dengan cara mata manusia memproses maklumat visual. Masa pendedahan adalah sekitar sepuluh saat, selepas itu kertas fotografi dikembangkan menggunakan teknik gelap standar. Walaupun imej yang dihasilkan sedikit kabur, ia telah mengesankan penonton kerana keunikannya dan ketepatan pembuatannya. Howerter, seorang peminat Lego yang bersemangat, terinspirasi oleh kamera pinhole serupa yang dibuat daripada biji pinus. Beliau menyelesaikan keseluruhan projek dalam masa hanya 20 minit. Kamera ini cukup kecil untuk dipegang oleh figurin Lego biasa, menambah pesona lucunya.

article_content: WASHINGTON (CNN) — The U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has begun collecting scans of all ten fingerprints from international travelers entering the United States through Dulles International Airport, with plans to expand the system to all U.S. international airports by the end of next year. This upgrade is part of the US-VISIT program, formerly limited to two fingerprints, which now enables authorities to cross-reference travelers’ biometrics with criminal and terrorist databases maintained by the FBI, the Department of Defense, and other agencies. The enhanced 10-print system was launched in late November 2007 at Dulles. Speaking at the airport on Monday, DHS Secretary Michael Chertoff praised the technology: 'We rely on biometrics—unique physical traits like fingerprints—to keep dangerous individuals out of the U.S., while ensuring fast, convenient processing for legitimate travelers.' Chertoff noted that the previous two-fingerprint system, introduced in 2004, successfully identified nearly 2,000 criminals and immigration violators based solely on fingerprint matches. Canadians and Mexicans using government-issued identification cards remain exempt from the new requirement. However, privacy advocates—including the Electronic Privacy Information Center—warn that the system poses risks to personal data. A July 2007 Government Accountability Office (GAO) report found 'significant information security control weaknesses' in US-VISIT systems, increasing the risk of unauthorized access, modification, misuse, or destruction of sensitive data. DHS maintains there have been no privacy breaches in the program. Chertoff dismissed concerns, stating, 'Moving to 10 fingerprints is completely consistent with—and enhances—our ability to protect. We view privacy as a fundamental human right, and preserving it is integral to our mission.' Meanwhile, travel and tourism groups express concern that heightened screening could discourage international visitors. The Discover America Partnership, representing the U.S. tourism industry, cautiously supports the initiative but urges clearer public communication. 'While reasonable, we must recognize that the 10-finger scan may be perceived as a barrier to entry,' said Geoff Freeman, the group’s executive director. 'We must balance security measures with a welcoming message and transparent outreach.'

Chertoff merendahkan risiko tersebut, menyatakan, 'Perpindahan kepada 10 jari adalah sepenuhnya selaras dengan—dan meningkatkan—keupayaan kita untuk melindungi. Sementara itu, kumpulan perjalanan dan pelancongan mengeluarkan kebimbangan bahawa pemeriksaan yang lebih ketat boleh menghalang pelancong antarabangsa. Discover America Partnership, yang mewakili industri pelancongan AS, secara berhati-hati menyokong inisiatif ini tetapi mendesak komunikasi awam yang lebih jelas. 'Walaupun munasabah, kita mesti sedar bahawa imbasan 10-jari mungkin dilihat sebagai halangan masuk,' kata Geoff Freeman, pengarah eksekutif kumpulan itu. 'Kita mesti menyeimbangkan langkah-langkah keselamatan dengan mesej yang mesra dan penyampaian yang telus.'

article_content: At age 27, Rebecca Saxon was diagnosed with Stage Two thyroid cancer — a moment she thought would end her life. But in the midst of her darkest days, she found a powerful outlet: sketching wedding shoes with blue soles while recovering in the hospital. What began as a way to pass the time and cope with anxiety soon became the foundation of Something Blue Bridal Shoes, a thriving online business selling uniquely designed bridal footwear. Each pair features a signature blue sole, honoring the traditional wedding saying: 'something old, something new, something borrowed, something blue.' Rebecca, originally from London, was working as a marketing manager when she noticed a lump in her throat in 2010. After multiple tests and two surgeries — one to remove the tumor and part of her thyroid — she received the devastating diagnosis. Her treatment spanned a year and included radiation, hormone suppressants, and prolonged hospital stays. During this time, she withdrew from work and struggled mentally. To combat despair, she returned to a childhood passion — drawing. Inspired by friends’ upcoming weddings, she shifted from sketching gowns to footwear, focusing on comfort and style. The blue sole became her personal symbol of hope. In August 2011, Rebecca was declared cancer-free. Encouraged by her entrepreneur boyfriend, Mike Bandar, she launched SomethingBlueBridalShoes.com. Today, at 31, she runs the business with pride, grateful to be alive and doing work she loves. Though she’ll need lifelong medication, Rebecca credits her journey with giving her purpose. 'I don’t know if I’d be doing this today if I hadn’t gone through what I did,' she says. 'You never know where great ideas can come from — and I hope I can inspire others.'

article_content: Freddie Starr has categorically denied being the 'third man' implicated in sexual abuse allegations involving Jimmy Savile and Gary Glitter. His denial came one day after he lost a High Court bid to block the publication of claims linking him to the scandal. The allegations originate from Karin Ward, who told an ITV documentary that in the 1970s, she witnessed Glitter raping a 13-year-old girl in Savile’s BBC dressing room. Ward, who was 14 at the time, also claimed Savile touched her skirt and that Starr, visibly intoxicated, made unwanted advances toward her in the same setting. Starr, 69, insists he has never met Savile more than twice — once when Savile and his mother attended one of Starr’s comedy shows, and another when Savile briefly visited the men’s clothing store Starr co-owned in Leeds. He described Savile as a 'phoney' and a 'boring, boring man' who talked down to people. Regarding Glitter, Starr said he encountered him only once — at an England vs. Greece football match in the 1980s. He recalled being amused by Glitter’s wig and nearly pulling it off, but was stopped by his publicist, Max Clifford. Crucially, Starr emphasized he has never consumed alcohol — identifying as teetotal — and therefore could not have been drunk during the alleged incident. He stated he has never met the accuser, Karin Ward, and had no involvement in any party with Savile or Glitter. Starr expressed deep sorrow for the victims of Savile and Glitter, condemning pedophilia as his 'pet hate'. He urged authorities to investigate further, saying, 'I think there are more to come forward — and I think there should be a police investigation into it now.' His remarks followed the revelation that Metropolitan Police officers are reviewing testimonies from individuals who have come forward with claims against Savile, aiming to build a clearer picture of the scale of abuse.

article_content: Larry J. Cano, founder of the El Torito restaurant chain and a key figure in popularizing guacamole, fajitas, and margaritas across the United States, has died at age 90. He passed away from pancreatic cancer on Wednesday at his home in Corona del Mar. A former World War II fighter pilot, Cano took over a closed Polynesian restaurant in Los Angeles in 1954 and transformed it into the first El Torito. He introduced a milder version of Mexican cuisine tailored to mid-century American tastes, recognizing that spicier traditional dishes might have intimidated first-time diners. 'You have to do what you have to do,' he told OC Weekly in 2011. 'It would be ridiculous to serve spicy food to someone trying Mexican cuisine for the first time — you could scare them off.' By the time he sold the chain to New York-based W.R. Grace & Co. in 1978, El Torito had grown to 22 locations. Cano remained as president and oversaw the expansion to nearly 200 outlets before retiring in 1988. Fajitas and blended margaritas became staples in American restaurants largely due to his influence. 'He was iconic,' said Don Myers, owner of Cha Cha's Latin Kitchen in Brea, who worked alongside Cano in the early days. 'To me, he was the Colonel Sanders of Mexican food.' The Orange County Register first reported his death.

Beliau meninggal akibat kanser pankreas pada Rabu di rumahnya di Corona del Mar. Seorang bekas penerbang pejuang Perang Dunia II, Cano mengambil alih sebuah restoran Polinesia yang ditutup di Los Angeles pada 1954 dan mengubahnya menjadi El Torito pertama. Beliau memperkenalkan versi masakan Mexico yang lebih ringan, disesuaikan dengan selera orang Amerika pada abad ke-20, kerana beliau sedar bahawa hidangan tradisional yang lebih pedas mungkin akan menakutkan pelanggan baru. article_content: Daisaku Ikeda, former leader of Japan’s influential Buddhist group Soka Gakkai, has died at the age of 95. According to a statement on Soka Gakkai’s website, he passed away from natural causes at his home near Tokyo. Over several decades, Ikeda expanded the organization’s international presence and cultivated relationships with Japan’s ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP). Soka Gakkai, a lay Buddhist organization with an estimated 12 million members worldwide, is known for its connections to prominent figures—including Hollywood actor Orlando Bloom, US jazz musician Herbie Hancock, and retired Italian footballer Roberto Baggio. Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida praised Ikeda on X (formerly Twitter), stating he 'played an important role in promoting peace, culture, and education in Japan and abroad.' Ikeda became president of Soka Gakkai in 1960 and founded Soka Gakkai International in 1975 to promote the movement globally. He traveled extensively, meeting world leaders such as China’s then-prime minister Zhou Enlai and Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev. Soka Gakkai International noted that under Ikeda’s leadership, the movement entered an era of innovation and expansion, becoming deeply involved in cultural and educational initiatives around the world. The group practices Nichiren Buddhism, which emphasizes individual empowerment and inner transformation through chanting the phrase 'Nam-myoho-renge-kyo,' believed to unlock one’s innate capacity to overcome challenges. In 1964, Ikeda co-founded the Komeito political party, which currently serves as the LDP’s junior coalition partner in Japan’s parliament, holding 32 seats in the 465-member House of Representatives.

Perdana Menteri Jepun Fumio Kishida memuji Ikeda di X (sebelum ini Twitter), menyatakan bahawa beliau 'memainkan peranan penting dalam mempromosikan perdamaian, budaya, dan pendidikan di Jepun dan luar negara.' article_content: Boris Johnson has openly acknowledged making cash payments to cleaners and tradespeople — a practice now under fire from UK government officials. David Gauke, the Exchequer Secretary, recently argued that paying cash to avoid VAT or income tax is morally equivalent to aggressive tax avoidance, calling it 'morally wrong.' His comments sparked backlash, especially since Johnson, as London’s mayor, confirmed he’s done it often. While there’s no law against paying or receiving cash for services, officials stress that such deals often help workers evade taxes — costing the UK an estimated £35 billion annually. Critics, however, point out the hypocrisy: Gauke himself once claimed nearly £10,250 in parliamentary expenses to cover stamp duty on his second home — a legal loophole he never repaid. Meanwhile, Labour MP John Mann condemned the government’s approach as double standards, arguing it’s absurd to target pensioners paying £5 in cash to have their garden trimmed while letting wealthy individuals and corporations exploit complex offshore schemes. HMRC has begun cracking down on cash-based trades like plumbing and electrical work, but experts warn that without simplifying the tax code, enforcement will remain ineffective. Advocates from the TUC and TaxPayers’ Alliance agree: real change means fixing the system, not punishing ordinary people.

Ucapan beliau menimbulkan kemarahan, terutama kerana Johnson, sebagai bandar London, mengesahkan bahawa beliau sering melakukannya. Sementara itu, MP parti Buruh John Mann mengutuk pendekatan kerajaan sebagai standard ganda, berpendapat ia tidak masuk akal untuk menargetkan pesara yang membayar £5 secara tunai untuk memotong taman mereka sambil membiarkan individu kaya dan syarikat besar mengeksploitasi skema luar negara yang kompleks. article_content: At 75, Ian Brady—the man convicted of murdering five children alongside Myra Hindley in the 1960s—is no longer physically capable of violence. But in Ashworth Secure Hospital, he has found a different kind of retaliation: surreptitiously smearing jam and honey on a chair used by a fellow patient, and leaving bowls of spilled cereal outside room doors. These acts, described by his long-time psychiatrist Dr. James Collins as 'revenge by other means,' stem from his inability to lash out physically due to old age and declining health. Brady, who has refused to speak to Dr. Collins since beginning a hunger strike in 1999, is currently being force-fed. He insists he wants to be transferred to a Scottish prison—not for freedom, but to die by starvation, believing prison conditions will allow him to control his own end. His mental state, according to Dr. Collins, is marked by persistent paranoid schizophrenia. Brady believes he communicates with dead celebrities like Cilla Black and Indira Gandhi, and even claims to have conversed with a woman he believes is a reincarnated Nazi. He has also asserted he can alter the laws of physics and walk through locked doors at night. In the 1980s, his psychosis intensified—he began adding massive quantities of salt to his food, eating until he vomited, convinced his meals were being poisoned. He once held an uncapped pen like a weapon toward another patient, leading to its permanent ban. He also accuses others of making 'pig noises' and has tried to manipulate visitors, offering them money and photos in a failed bid to escape. Brady isolates himself, only leaving his room at night. He displays a profound sense of superiority, refuses to interact with anyone he deems beneath him, and lashes out verbally over minor slights. Despite his age, his narcissism and manipulative nature remain intact. He even accused a tribunal panel member of falling asleep during testimony. The tribunal, held behind closed doors at Ashworth but livestreamed to Manchester, is assessing whether Brady should be moved from psychiatric care to prison. His victims’ families, including the parents of Keith Bennett—whose body remains buried somewhere on Saddleworth Moor—are watching closely. Brady has never disclosed its location.

article_content: John McAfee, the multimillionaire software mogul and founder of McAfee antivirus, is hiding from Belizean authorities following the murder of his American neighbor, Gregory Viant Faull. McAfee claims authorities are planning an imminent raid to arrest him. Despite remaining in a secret location on an island off the coast of Belize, McAfee has maintained contact with American journalists, sharing his account of events and criticizing the Belizean government. On Thursday, a lone dog was photographed outside his former home — the same property where he says government agents poisoned several of his dogs. 'Rumors are rife of an imminent raid,' McAfee told Wired magazine editor Joshua Davis in an email. Earlier that day, Belizean Prime Minister Dean Barrow called McAfee 'bonkers' and urged him to surrender. McAfee stated he is unarmed, hiding with a young woman, and frequently changing locations and phones to evade what he believes is a police unit intent on killing him. Barrow insisted McAfee is only wanted for questioning and expressed concern over his mental state. Belizean police identify McAfee as a 'person of interest' in the fatal shooting of Faull, 52, whose body was found with a gunshot wound to the head in his home north of San Pedro on November 11. McAfee denied involvement, telling the Associated Press: 'I barely knew him. I barely spoke ten words to him in the last three years.' He admitted they had friction but dismissed the idea of murder over annoyance. Neighbors described Faull as peaceful and well-liked. Tensions reportedly stemmed from complaints about McAfee’s dogs, which Faull allegedly threatened to shoot. McAfee now believes government agents poisoned the animals. McAfee fears the Gang Suppression Unit (GSU), a paramilitary-style police force previously accused of brutality, will torture or kill him if he surrenders. He claims authorities have detained friends to pressure him into turning himself in. McAfee has lived in Belize for about three years to reduce his tax burden. He has a long history of unconventional behavior, including public advocacy of psychoactive substances like MDPV ('bath salts') and experimentation with alternative therapies. In recent communications, McAfee said he is attempting to evade capture by dyeing his salt-and-pepper hair and beard jet black. He fears police have planted evidence — such as firearms or drugs — in his abandoned properties. He insists Faull’s murder was meant for him, calling it a case of mistaken identity. 'They got the wrong house,' he said, accusing authorities of trying to silence him for months.

McAfee mendakwa pihak berkuasa merancang serangan segera untuk menangkapnya. Walaupun berada di lokasi rahsia di sebuah pulau di tepi pantai Belize, McAfee terus berhubung dengan wartawan Amerika, berkongsi versinya tentang kejadian tersebut dan mengkritik kerajaan Belize. Pada hari Khamis, seekor anjing sahaja dipotret di luar rumah lamanya — kawasan yang sama di mana dia mendakwa agen kerajaan meracuni beberapa ekor anjingnya. 'Bualan beredar tentang serangan segera,' kata McAfee kepada Joshua Davis, penyunting Wired, dalam e-mel. Pada awal hari itu, Perdana Menteri Belize, Dean Barrow, memanggil McAfee 'gila' dan mendesaknya menyerahkan diri. McAfee menyatakan bahawa dia tidak bersenjata, bersembunyi bersama seorang wanita muda, dan selalu menukar tempat serta telefon untuk mengelakkan unit polis yang menurutnya ingin membunuhnya. Barrow menegaskan bahawa McAfee hanya ingin ditanya, dan mengeluarkan keprihatinan terhadap keadaan mentalnya. Polis Belize mengenal McAfee sebagai 'individu yang menjadi perhatian' dalam kes tembakan mematikan terhadap Faull, 52, yang mayatnya ditemui dengan luka tembak di kepala di rumahnya di utara San Pedro pada 11 November. McAfee membantah sebarang keterlibatan, berkata kepada Associated Press: 'Saya hampir tidak mengenalinya. Saya hampir tidak berbicara sepuluh perkataan dengannya dalam tiga tahun terakhir.' Dia mengaku ada ketegangan tetapi menolak kemungkinan pembunuhan kerana kekesalan. Jiran-jiran menggambarkan Faull sebagai orang yang tenang dan disukai. Ketegangan dikatakan bermula daripada aduan mengenai anjing-anjing McAfee, yang menurutnya pernah diancam oleh Faull untuk ditembak. McAfee kini percaya agen kerajaan meracuni anjing-anjing itu. McAfee takut Unit Penekanan Geng (GSU), pasukan polis paramiliter yang sebelum ini didakwa kejam, akan menyeksa atau membunuhnya jika dia menyerahkan diri. Dia mendakwa pihak berkuasa telah menahan rakan-rakan dan kenalan untuk memaksa dia menyerah. McAfee tinggal di Belize selama lebih kurang tiga tahun untuk mengurangkan cukainya. Dia mempunyai sejarah tingkah laku tidak biasa, termasuk menyokong secara terbuka bahan psikoaktif seperti MDPV ('bath salts') dan eksperimen dengan terapi alternatif. Dalam komunikasi terkini, McAfee berkata dia cuba mengelakkan tangkapan dengan mewarnai rambut dan janggutnya yang berwarna kelabu-putih menjadi hitam pekat. Dia takut polis telah meletakkan bukti palsu — seperti senjata atau dadah — di properti-propertinya yang ditinggalkan. Dia bersikeras bahawa pembunuhan Faull sebenarnya ditujukan kepadanya, dan menyebutnya sebagai kes salah identiti. 'Mereka dapat rumah yang salah,' katanya, menuduh pihak berkuasa cuba membungkamnya selama berbulan-bulan.

article_content: MELBOURNE — A 12-year-old girl has been arrested and charged with murder following the fatal stabbing of a 37-year-old woman in Melbourne, Australia. According to Victoria Police, the woman was found deceased shortly before 2 a.m. on Thursday in Footscray, an inner-city suburb, at a residence on Barkly Street. Authorities have not disclosed the identities of either the victim or the suspect, nor confirmed whether they knew each other. No motive has been established at this time. The girl has been formally charged with one count of murder and will be remanded to appear before a children’s court at a later date, said Katherine McLeod of the Victoria Police Media Unit. The investigation remains active and ongoing.

article_content: Two former Royal Bank of Scotland (RBS) bankers, Andrew Ratnage, 50, and Raymond Pask, 54, were spared jail after a judge ruled they had already 'suffered enough' for orchestrating a £3 million mortgage fraud. Both earned over £100,000 annually but sought greater wealth through a scheme involving fake companies registered under Pask’s family members. They submitted fraudulent loan applications to NatWest — a subsidiary of RBS — to fund property renovations and resales for profit. Over five years, they fraudulently obtained nearly £3 million. The loans were approved without disclosure that the applicants were the beneficiaries. Documents were forged to inflate property valuations. Proceeds funded the purchase of five properties: two in Stoke Newington, north-east London; one near the sea in Whitstable, Kent; and two more in east London and Essex. At one point, Pask lived in a £1 million home and held a £1.2 million pension pot. Ratnage received bonuses up to £78,000 in 2008; Pask earned around £50,000 annually between 2006 and 2008. The fraud was uncovered in October 2010 after Ratnage took extended sick leave and colleagues reviewed his portfolio. Investigations traced the companies to Pask, who resigned from RBS in December 2010. Both were charged by the City of London Police in 2022. Judge Rebecca Poulet QC imposed suspended sentences: 20 months for Ratnage and 18 months for Pask, each subject to two years’ probation. They were also ordered to complete 300 and 250 hours of community service respectively. The judge noted that all loans were repaid, no financial loss occurred to RBS, and both men had endured significant personal hardship — including Pask’s collapsed marriage, reduced pension to £120,000, and loss of his home, and Ratnage’s severe health issues, including diabetes risking amputation. Pask admitted three counts of obtaining a service by deception and one of false accounting. Ratnage admitted three counts of obtaining a service by deception, one of fraud, and seven of false accounting. Pask was ordered to pay £2,500 in prosecution costs. Ratnage is currently unemployed. The case unfolded against the backdrop of RBS’s reckless expansion under former CEO Fred Goodwin, culminating in its 2008 taxpayer-funded bailout after the global financial crisis.

Keduanya memperoleh pendapatan melebihi £100,000 setahun tetapi ingin mendapat lebih banyak wang melalui skema yang melibatkan syarikat-syarikat palsu yang didaftarkan atas nama ahli keluarga Pask. Mereka mengemukan permohonan pinjaman yang menipu kepada NatWest — anak syarikat RBS — untuk membiayai pembaikan dan jual semula hartanah demi keuntungan. Dalam tempoh lima tahun, mereka memperoleh hampir £3 juta secara tidak sah. Pinjaman itu diluluskan tanpa pengumuman bahawa mereka sendiri merupakan penerima faedah. Dokumen-dokumen dipalsukan untuk menaikkan nilai hartanah. Hasilnya digunakan untuk membeli lima hartanah: dua di Stoke Newington, timur laut London; satu berhampiran pantai di Whitstable, Kent; dan dua lagi di timur London dan Essex. Pada satu ketika, Pask tinggal di rumah bernilai £1 juta dan memiliki dana pensyen sebanyak £1.2 juta. Ratnage menerima bonus sehingga £78,000 pada tahun 2008; Pask memperoleh sekitar £50,000 setahun antara 2006 dan 2008. Penipuan itu ditemui pada Oktober 2010 selepas Ratnage mengambil cuti sakit panjang dan rakan sekerja mengkaji portfolionya. Siasatan mengesan syarikat-syarikat itu kepada Pask, yang mengundurkan diri dari RBS pada Disember 2010. Keduanya dituntut oleh Polis Kota London pada tahun 2022. Hakim Rebecca Poulet QC mengenakan hukuman diampunkan: 20 bulan untuk Ratnage dan 18 bulan untuk Pask, masing-masing dengan tempoh percubaan dua tahun. Mereka juga diarahkan menjalankan 300 dan 250 jam perkhidmatan komuniti masing-masing. Hakim mencatat bahawa semua pinjaman telah dibayar balik, tiada kerugian kewangan berlaku kepada RBS, dan kedua-dua lelaki itu telah mengalami kesukaran peribadi yang besar — termasuk perkahwinan Pask yang runtuh, dana pensyen berkurang kepada £120,000, kehilangan rumah, serta masalah kesihatan serius Ratnage termasuk diabetes yang boleh menyebabkan amputasi kaki. Pask mengaku tiga tuduhan memperoleh perkhidmatan melalui penipuan dan satu tuduhan akaun palsu. Ratnage mengaku tiga tuduhan memperoleh perkhidmatan melalui penipuan, satu tuduhan penipuan, dan tujuh tuduhan akaun palsu. Pask diarahkan membayar kos penuntutan sebanyak £2,500. Ratnage kini tidak bekerja. Kes ini berlaku dalam konteks ekspansi ganas RBS di bawah bekas CEO Fred Goodwin, yang berakhir dengan penyelamatan kerajaan pada 2008 selepas krisis kewangan global.

article_content: Sam Bankman-Fried, the 31-year-old founder of the collapsed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, was convicted on Thursday on seven counts of fraud and conspiracy in a New York court. He pleaded not guilty but was found guilty of stealing at least $10 billion from customers to fund his hedge fund Alameda Research, purchase luxury property in the Bahamas, and donate to U.S. political campaigns. Prosecutors charged him with one count of wire fraud, two counts of conspiracy to commit fraud, and one count of money laundering conspiracy related to the misappropriation of customer funds. He also faced charges for misleading investors and lenders by concealing that Alameda had borrowed massive sums from FTX—funds that were used to create false financial statements to reassure stakeholders. Caroline Ellison, former CEO of Alameda, pleaded guilty and testified against Bankman-Fried, confirming that she was directed to deceive Alameda’s creditors about the extent of its debt to FTX. In his defense, Bankman-Fried admitted to serious management failures—including the lack of a risk control team—but insisted he never intended to defraud anyone and was unaware of the true scale of Alameda’s borrowing until FTX’s collapse. Originally facing 13 charges, five counts—including bank fraud and foreign bribery conspiracy—were separated into a second trial scheduled for March 2024. This conviction marks the dramatic fall of a figure once hailed as a crypto prodigy, whose ambitions included a potential presidential run and a Super Bowl ad.

Jaksa menuduhnya dengan satu dakwaan penipuan elektronik, dua dakwaan konspirasi melakukan penipuan, dan satu dakwaan konspirasi pencucian uang terkait penyalahgunaan dana pelanggan. Dia juga dianggap menyesatkan investor dan pemberi pinjaman dengan menyembunyikan bahwa Alameda telah meminjam jumlah besar dari FTX—dana yang digunakan untuk membuat laporan keuangan palsu demi meyakinkan para pemangku kepentingan. Caroline Ellison, mantan CEO Alameda, mengaku bersalah dan bersaksi melawan Bankman-Fried, mengonfirmasi bahwa dia diperintahkan untuk menipu kreditor Alameda mengenai besarnya utang mereka kepada FTX. Dalam pembelaannya, Bankman-Fried mengakui kegagalan manajemen serius—termasuk tidak adanya tim pengendalian risiko—tetapi bersikeras bahwa dia tidak pernah berniat menipu siapa pun dan tidak mengetahui skala sebenarnya utang Alameda hingga kebangkrutan FTX. Awalnya menghadapi 13 dakwaan, lima dakwaan—termasuk penipuan perbankan dan konspirasi suap asing—dipisahkan ke dalam persidangan kedua yang dijadwalkan pada Maret 2024. Hukuman ini menandai jatuhnya dramatis seorang tokoh yang dulunya dipuja sebagai jenius kripto, dengan ambisi yang mencakup kemungkinan pencalonan presiden dan iklan Super Bowl.

article_content: In a decisive victory, Senator Hillary Clinton claimed the Pennsylvania Democratic primary on Tuesday, defeating Senator Barack Obama after a grueling six-week contest. Speaking to supporters in Philadelphia, Clinton declared, 'It's a long road to 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue—and it runs right through the heart of Pennsylvania.' She pledged to stand firmly for voters in the White House, calling the win a testament to their trust in her leadership. Clinton praised Obama and his campaign, noting they are 'on this journey together,' even as her campaign highlighted the significance of her win in a key battleground state. Her victories in Ohio, New York, Texas, and California now position her as a formidable contender, raising questions within the party about Obama’s electability against Republican nominee John McCain. With 99% of precincts reporting, Clinton led Obama by 10 percentage points and secured a majority of Pennsylvania’s 158 delegates. On CNN’s 'American Morning,' she noted record voter turnout and stressed that Pennsylvanians had clearly chosen her as the stronger candidate to face McCain. Despite being outspent three-to-one, she called the outcome 'enormously exciting and gratifying.' Though Clinton celebrated the win, Obama still holds a substantial lead in total delegates—1,694 to her 1,556—as well as in the popular vote and number of states won. CNN analyst David Gergen observed that Obama’s campaign remains intact, stating, 'The wheels aren’t coming off the wagon.' Exit polls revealed stark demographic divides: Clinton dominated among white voters (60%-40%), voters aged 65 and older, and those who decided in the final week—particularly after the recent debate. Obama swept nearly 90% of Black voters, who comprised 14% of the electorate, and won 60% of new Democratic registrants, who made up one in seven voters. Clinton’s strength was concentrated in western Pennsylvania and the industrial northeast, while Obama drew strong support in urban areas like Philadelphia. Both candidates now turn toward the May 6 primaries in North Carolina and Indiana. Neither is projected to reach the 2,025-delegate threshold before the Democratic National Convention, leaving the final decision potentially to unpledged superdelegates.

Dia berjanji untuk berdiri tegak bagi para pemilih di Gedung Putih, menyebut kemenangan ini sebagai bukti kepercayaan mereka terhadap kepemimpinannya. article_content: Rozanne Duncan, a former UKIP councillor from Thanet South in Kent, was expelled from the party after being filmed stating she had 'a problem with people with negroid features' and expressed dislike for 'negroes'. Despite being ousted, Duncan insists she is not racist, claiming the term 'negroes' is merely a neutral descriptor—comparable to how one might refer to Jews, Muslims, or Chinese people—not an insult. She acknowledged her tendency toward bluntness, admitting her speech often violates social norms. Duncan attempted to contextualize her views by referencing her upbringing in 1940s–50s Kent, where racial diversity was rare, though she conceded this does not justify her position. The remarks appeared in the BBC documentary 'Meet the Ukippers', which also revealed that a local UKIP chair once belonged to the far-right National Front. Duncan, who remains in office as an independent councillor, has stated she regrets nothing and denied any association with extremist groups, highlighting her decades-long membership in the Conservative Party, as well as affiliations with Mensa, the Women’s Institute, and the Order of Women Freemasons. These events echo earlier controversies involving UKIP leader Nigel Farage, who defended a candidate who used the slur 'Chinky bird', arguing that such language is common in working-class communities and mischaracterized as racist by urban elites. Together, these incidents have intensified scrutiny over whether UKIP’s culture accommodates racially insensitive speech under the guise of regional identity or free expression.

Walaupun telah dikeluarkan, Duncan menegaskan bahawa dia bukan rasis, dengan berhujah bahawa istilah 'negroes' hanyalah satu penerangan neutral—serupa dengan bagaimana seseorang mungkin merujuk kepada orang Yahudi, Muslim, atau Cina—bukan satu penghinaan. Dia mengakui kecenderungannya untuk bersikap terus terang, mengaku perkataannya sering melanggar norma sosial. Duncan cuba menjelaskan pandangannya dengan merujuk kepada pertumbuhannya pada tahun 1940-an–50-an di Kent, di mana kepelbagaian kaum jarang wujud, walaupun dia mengiktiraf bahawa ini tidak membenarkan sikapnya. Ucapan itu muncul dalam dokumentari BBC 'Meet the Ukippers', yang juga mengungkap bahawa seorang ketua tempatan UKIP pernah menjadi ahli Front Nasional yang ekstrem kanan. Duncan, yang masih mengekalkan jawatannya sebagai ahli majlis bebas, menyatakan tiada penyesalan dan menyangkal sebarang hubungan dengan kumpulan ekstrem, menonjolkan keahliannya selama puluhan tahun dalam Parti Konservatif, serta keahlian dalam Mensa, Women’s Institute, dan Order of Women Freemasons. Peristiwa-peristiwa ini mengingatkan kontroversi sebelumnya yang melibatkan pemimpin UKIP Nigel Farage, yang membela seorang calon yang menggunakan perkataan 'Chinky bird', dengan berhujah bahawa bahasa sedemikian biasa dalam komuniti kelas pekerja dan disalahertikan sebagai rasis oleh elit bandar. Bersama-sama, insiden-insiden ini meningkatkan pemerhatian terhadap sama ada budaya UKIP mengakomodasi ucapan yang tidak sensitif secara kaum di bawah jubah identiti wilayah atau kebebasan percakapan.

article_content: In a dramatic courtroom showdown at Fort Meade, military prosecutors argued that former Army private Bradley Manning should spend at least 60 years in prison for leaking tens of thousands of classified documents related to the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan. Captain Joe Morrow described Manning as a 'determined insider' who acted out of arrogance, believing he alone could decide what secrets the public deserved to know — a move that, according to prosecutors, put lives at risk and damaged international diplomacy. On the other side, Manning’s defense attorney, David Coombs, painted a very different picture: a young man deeply troubled by the human cost of war, driven not by malice but by conscience. Coombs urged the court to see Manning as someone capable of change, arguing that locking him away indefinitely would be a failure of justice rather than its fulfillment. 'Perhaps his greatest crime,' Coombs said, 'was caring too much — and refusing to look away.' Judge Col. Denise Lind, who convicted Manning on multiple charges including espionage last July, now holds the power to decide his fate. While Manning avoided a potential life sentence after charges of aiding the enemy were dropped, he still faces a maximum of 90 years behind bars. Prosecutors also seek a $100,000 fine and the forfeiture of all military pay and benefits. The sentencing hearing has been paused until Tuesday, with no indication yet of when Lind will deliver her verdict.

Kapten Joe Morrow menggambarkan Manning sebagai 'penyusup yang gigih' yang bertindak atas kesombongan, percaya bahawa dia sahaja yang boleh menentukan rahsia apa yang patut diketahui awam — satu tindakan yang, menurut penuntut, membahayakan nyawa dan merosakkan diplomasi antarabangsa. Di sisi lain, peguam pertahanan Manning, David Coombs, melukis gambaran yang sangat berbeza: seorang pemuda yang sangat terganggu oleh kos manusia peperangan, didorong bukan oleh niat jahat tetapi oleh hati nurani. Coombs mendesak mahkamah untuk melihat Manning sebagai seseorang yang mampu berubah, berhujah bahawa memenjarakannya selama-lamanya akan menjadi kegagalan keadilan, bukan pencapaian keadilan. 'Mungkin kesalahan terbesarnya,' kata Coombs, 'adalah terlalu peduli — dan enggan berpaling.' Hakim Col. Denise Lind, yang menghukum Manning atas beberapa pertuduhan termasuk spionaj pada bulan Julai lepas, kini memegang kuasa untuk menentukan nasibnya. Walaupun Manning mengelakkan hukuman seumur hidup selepas pertuduhan membantu musuh dibuang, beliau masih menghadapi maksimum 90 tahun di balik jeriji. Penuntut juga meminta denda sebanyak $100,000 dan perampasan semua gaji dan faedah tentera. Sidang penghukuman telah ditangguhkan hingga Selasa, tetapi belum ada petunjuk bila Lind akan mengumumkan keputusannya.

article_content: The BBC’s new Director General, Tony Hall, has announced a £150,000 cap on redundancy and severance payments for senior managers, following public outrage over excessive exit packages. MPs have criticized the broadcaster for offering large payouts to departing executives, likening such departures to 'winning the lottery'. Notably, former Director General George Entwistle and former Chief Operating Officer Caroline Thomson received £450,000 and £670,000 respectively upon leaving last year. Speaking at his first appearance before the Culture, Media and Sport Select Committee, Hall stated that the cap was a 'really important matter of principle' and essential to ensure the BBC remains 'in tune with the times'. He noted that approximately 250 senior managers would be affected by the change. Under the new policy, senior managers will receive one month’s salary per year of service, up to a maximum of 12 months’ pay or £150,000—whichever is lower. The notice period for executive board members will also be reduced from 12 to six months. Critics argue that even £150,000 remains excessive. In recent years, 10 other executives received severance packages totaling £4 million, bringing the total for 11 senior figures to over £4 million, including Mark Byford, who received £949,000. Hall also faced scrutiny over appointments perceived as lacking transparency, particularly the hiring of former Labour culture secretary James Purnell. Some MPs accused him of appointing 'friends' rather than selecting through open competition. Similarly, Lord Patten, BBC Chairman, was questioned over his own role in selecting Hall without a competitive process. Lord Patten indicated he was open to revising Hall’s contract to remove the controversial non-disparagement clause, describing it as 'ceremonial' and not intended to be binding. Hall responded that he would still speak out if he felt something was wrong. The BBC will now consult with affected staff and unions, as the changes require amendments to existing contracts. Hall emphasized that past settlements 'can no longer be justified'. Hall also pledged to simplify the BBC’s structure, citing excessive bureaucracy as a barrier to program-making. While reforms were welcomed by organizations like the TaxPayers’ Alliance and the National Union of Journalists, many still view the £150,000 cap as insufficient.

article_content: Nursery costs in the UK have surged by 30% over the past three years — nearly five times faster than average wage growth. Labour leader Ed Miliband warned that many parents are now struggling to cope, with some working nearly the entire week just to cover childcare expenses. He has called for a new levy on banks to fund expanded free childcare for three- and four-year-olds, accusing the government of doing nothing to ease the burden on families. In 2010, the average cost of a part-time nursery place (25 hours per week) for a child aged two or older was £82. By this year, that figure had risen to £107. Meanwhile, average weekly earnings have increased by just 6%, from £449 to £477. Full-time care now costs up to £200 or more per week. Miliband emphasized that this forces many parents — particularly those in part-time roles — to work Monday through Thursday just to pay for childcare. During a visit to a nursery, Miliband met nursery manager Carol Yala-Hutchinson and three-year-old Alvise Cocquio to highlight his policy. He stressed that rising costs are matched by declining availability of places, deepening the childcare crisis. He criticized the Conservative government, saying, 'If it's bad for families, it's bad for Britain too.' He argued that enabling parents to work is essential for economic growth and reducing long-term welfare dependency. Miliband also addressed reports of tension with Shadow Chancellor Ed Balls, dismissing leaked emails as 'silly office messages' and affirming their strong working relationship. He praised Balls for his leadership on the cost-of-living crisis. Labour claims 576 Sure Start centres have closed since the last election, reducing childcare capacity. However, the Department for Education disputes this, stating only 45 centres have shut since 2010, with new ones opening and record numbers of families using services. Miliband’s policy proposes extending free childcare from 15 to 25 hours per week for working families, funded by a levy on banks making substantial profits. He estimates this would save families around £1,500 annually. Critics such as Harriet Waldegrave of Policy Exchange argue that universal subsidies disproportionately benefit higher-income households. She suggests capping tax-free childcare for families earning over £150,000, redirecting up to £238 million to improve quality and access in disadvantaged communities.

article_content: During the 2011 Kielder Marathon in Northumberland, runner Rob Sloan made a desperate and ultimately exposed attempt to cheat. After struggling through 20 miles of rain-slicked terrain, he flagged down a bus meant for spectators, rode six miles toward the finish, then jumped off, concealed himself behind a tree, and re-entered the race just before crossing the line in third place with a time of 2:51:01. He later told reporters he’d given it his all — a claim that rang hollow when others noticed inconsistencies. Race organizer Steve Cram, a former Olympic champion, immediately questioned the validity of Sloan’s performance. The most glaring anomaly? Sloan’s second half was faster than his first — something nearly impossible in endurance racing. Meanwhile, Steven Cairns, who had held third place since the start, was stunned when he crossed the finish line and heard he’d placed fourth. When he confronted Sloan, the latter claimed to have passed him after mile 15 — a timeline that didn’t add up, given Cairns had built a five-minute lead by then. Multiple witnesses reported seeing Sloan board and exit the bus, and later hide near the finish. Cairns reported the incident to officials, triggering an investigation. Facing mounting evidence, Sloan admitted to the deception. As a result, he was stripped of his bronze medal, officially disqualified, and is now under review by his club, Sunderland Harriers, and UK Athletics. Though initially calling the allegations ‘laughable,’ Sloan’s silence spoke louder than his words. His actions not only stole a podium spot but also robbed Cairns of recognition, media exposure, and the pride of a hard-earned achievement.

article_content: By Emily Davies. Published: 19:55 EST, 16 January 2014. | Updated: 19:57 EST, 16 January 2014. Author Hilary Mantel, the only woman to have won the Man Booker Prize twice, will make the late Margaret Thatcher the subject of her next book. The acclaimed writer of Wolf Hall will publish a collection of ten short stories centered on the former prime minister, who died in April 2013. The book, titled The Assassination of Margaret Thatcher, is set for release in September. Publishers at 4th Estate confirm that each story will feature Thatcher as the protagonist but will be set in contemporary contexts — a departure from Mantel’s earlier historical fiction. Nicholas Pearson, Publishing Director at 4th Estate, said: 'A new book from Hilary Mantel is a treat. Where her last two novels explored how modern England was forged, The Assassination of Margaret Thatcher shows us the country we have become. These stories are Mantel at her most observant.' Mantel rose to fame with Wolf Hall, a novel chronicling the 16th-century court intrigues of Thomas Cromwell, adviser to King Henry VIII. It won her the Booker Prize in 2009; its sequel, Bring Up the Bodies, earned her a second Booker in 2012. Both novels topped the UK bestseller lists, with Bring Up the Bodies making her the first author ever to debut at number one. In addition, Mantel received the Walter Scott Prize in 2010 and the Costa Book Award in 2012. The book’s provocative title has drawn attention, especially following Mantel’s controversial remarks about the Duchess of Cambridge. In a 2013 lecture at the British Museum, she described Kate as a 'shop-window mannequin' with no personality, suggesting she was chosen for her role because she posed no threat of emotional expression. Mantel contrasted this with Princess Diana, whom she portrayed as more authentic despite being 'awkward and emotionally incontinent.'

Buku itu, berjudul Pembunuhan Margaret Thatcher, dijadualkan dilancarkan pada September. Penerbit di 4th Estate mengesahkan bahawa setiap cerita akan menampilkan Thatcher sebagai protagonis tetapi akan ditempatkan dalam konteks semasa — sebuah perbezaan daripada fiksi sejarah sebelumnya Mantel. Nicholas Pearson, Pengarah Penerbitan di 4th Estate, berkata: 'Buku baru dari Hilary Mantel adalah satu keistimewaan. Di mana dua novel terakhirnya mengkaji bagaimana England moden dibentuk, Pembunuhan Margaret Thatcher menunjukkan kepada kita negara yang kita jadi. Cerita-cerita ini adalah Mantel pada paling pemerhatian.' Mantel menjadi terkenal dengan Wolf Hall, sebuah novel yang menceritakan intrik istana abad ke-16 tentang Thomas Cromwell, penasihat Raja Henry VIII. Ia memenangi Hadiah Booker pada tahun 2009; sekuelnya, Bring Up the Bodies, membawanya memenangi Booker kedua kali pada 2012. Kedua-dua novel itu menduduki tangga teratas senarai jualan terbaik UK, dengan Bring Up the Bodies menjadikannya penulis pertama yang debut di nombor satu. Selain itu, Mantel menerima Hadiah Walter Scott pada 2010 dan Hadiah Buku Costa pada 2012. Tajuk provokatif buku ini menarik perhatian, terutamanya selepas komen kontroversial Mantel terhadap Duchess of Cambridge. Dalam ucapan tahun 2013 di British Museum, beliau menggambarkan Kate sebagai 'manekin tetingkap' tanpa kepribadian, mencadangkan bahawa beliau dipilih untuk perannya kerana tidak menimbulkan risiko ekspresi emosi. Mantel membandingkan ini dengan Puteri Diana, yang digambarkannya lebih autentik walaupun 'tidak selesa dan tidak mampu mengawal emosi.'

article_content: By RFE/RL's Ukrainian Service October 14, 2023 Russian forces launched a devastating wave of attacks across eastern and southern Ukraine, killing at least 12 civilians and injuring over 50 in a single day, regional officials revealed on October 14, as fierce battles erupted around Bakhmut and Avdiyivka. The city of Beryslav in Kherson was pounded by relentless Russian artillery at dawn, with reports confirming 8 fatalities—including a 60-year-old woman crushed under debris and a 42-year-old mother struck mid-balcony during a surprise drone strike. 'They didn’t just attack—they erased entire neighborhoods,' said regional governor Oleksandr Prokudin on Telegram. Another barrage later that day claimed two more lives. In Donetsk, 28 civilians were wounded—26 in Pokrovsk alone—by precision-guided shells, according to acting governor Ihor Moroz. Meanwhile, Ukraine’s military reported 200 brutal close-combat engagements in Kharkiv, Donetsk, and Zaporizhzhya, with General Oleksandr Syrskiy warning that 'the frontlines are collapsing.' The situation near Avdiyivka has become apocalyptic, with Russian forces deploying 3,000 troops, tanks, and airstrikes in a full-scale assault. 'This is the beginning of the end,' said Avdiyivka’s military chief Vitaliy Barabash. At the UN, Russian envoy Vasily Nebenzya declared the Ukrainian counteroffensive 'utterly destroyed', calling it a 'historic defeat.' President Zelenskiy praised soldiers as 'heroes,' though no official updates on troop movements were given. The Ukrainian Navy claimed to have sunk a Russian frigate in Sevastopol, saying the 'Black Sea Fleet is now crippled.' Russia has remained silent, fueling speculation.
